jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details** **Division:** **Nucor Business Technology** **Location:** **Dallas, TX, United States** **Other Available Locations:** **N/A** **Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.** **Nucor supports its teammates with top\-tier benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance, 401K and Roth accounts, Profit sharing, Pay\-for\-performance bonuses, Paid parental leave, Tuition reimbursement, Stock program, Scholarships and more.** **Basic Job Functions:** ------------------------ **Nucor Business Technology (NBT)** is growing its Enterprise Software Engineering team and is seeking **AI Solutions Engineers** to design, build, and operate the internal AI\-enabled tools and platforms used by everyone at Nucor. This team builds at enterprise scale, creating the AI capabilities, developer tooling, and shared services that any team across Nucor can adopt. You will write production code alongside a team of developers building internal AI tools: deciding where AI belongs in a workflow, selecting models and integration patterns, grounding them in Nucor's enterprise data, and keeping them reliable and safe once real teams depend on them. Define and maintain standards for high\-quality AI\-generated output, including evaluation frameworks and quality practices that ensure AI\-assisted development is reliable, secure, and scalable across the enterprise. Travel (up to 25%) is expected to support benchmarking, knowledge sharing, and internal development sessions with teammates. **Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US (Nucor Business Technology (NBT) will not sponsor the need for a visa now or in the future). Due to federal security requirements applicable to this role, only U.S. citizens and lawful permanent residents are eligible for consideration.** Safety is the most important part of all jobs within Nucor; therefore, candidates must be able to demonstrate the ability to initiate, lead, and uphold safety policies, practices, procedures, and housekeeping standards at all times. **Responsibilities include but are not limited to:** ---------------------------------------------------- * Design, build, and operate AI\-enabled internal tools and platforms used broadly across the enterprise, from model and pattern selection through production. * Develop and maintain the AI code generation platform that developers across Nucor rely on to write, review, and ship code, evolving it as models, tooling, and best practices advance. * Write and review production code as part of a development team, following enterprise engineering standards for reliability, security and maintainability. * Ground AI capabilities in Nucor's enterprise data and business rules and integrate them into applications through governed interfaces and shared services. * Define evaluation criteria for AI\-generated output and build the methods that verify accuracy, reliability, and safety both before and after release. * Partner with Enterprise Architecture, internal engineering teams, and technical stakeholders to establish AI\-assisted development practices and quality standards, run discovery to surface high\-value AI use cases, and drive adoption across the broader engineering organization. * Apply responsible AI practices across the full lifecycle, from data handling and access control through ongoing monitoring. * Build and maintain the data pipelines and integrations that put enterprise AI solutions into production. **Minimum Qualifications:** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or similar, or equivalent practical experience. * 4\+ years of experience in a technical role such as Software Engineer, Solutions Engineer, AI/ML Engineer, Systems Analyst, or Technical Consultant. * Proficiency in Python and experience with at least one additional programming language (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C\#). * Proven ability to design and deploy production applications, integrations, and data/AI solutions end\-to\-end, including pipelines and operationalization. * Demonstrated experience building with LLMs or AI services in a production context at enterprise scale, not limited to prototypes or proofs of concept. * Working knowledge of enterprise systems, APIs and data flows. * Demonstrated success partnering with technical stakeholders across teams and business domains, running discovery, presenting findings, and driving adoption. * Familiarity with AI concepts such as prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, model evaluation, or agent\-based workflows. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Experience supporting or deploying AI\-enabled or advanced analytics solutions at enterprise scale. * Experience with Azure AI services, particularly Azure AI Foundry, and with identity\-based authentication patterns such as managed identity. * Experience creating and using MCP servers. * Experience working in an enterprise IT environment with complex, integrated systems. * Experience partnering with external vendors or solution providers. ***Nucor is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug\-free workplace***

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - PLA
jobs.description: **WHAT PHARIS DESIGN HAS TO OFFER** Pharis Design an LJA Company is offering an exciting opportunity that will allow you to reach your full career potential. The structure of our organization is designed to amplify your capabilities while gaining the benefits of being an employee\-owner. What truly sets this opportunity apart is the chance to collaborate every day with dedicated, skilled, and supportive leaders. Whether you are in the office, in the field, or behind the scenes, working at LJA gives you the chance to grow through hands\-on experience and exposure to a broad range of clients and services. **WHAT MAKES PHARIS DESIGN DIFFERENT** At Pharis Design an LJA Company, our employee\-owners take pride in their work and their workplace. We’re guided by leaders who foster a culture of respect, collaboration and a shared vision of success. Our difference is evident in the experiences and opportunities we provide: * Employee\-owned. Client\-focused * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) * Consistently ranked as a **Top Workplace** * Internal recruitment team, in\-house training, and a marketing department specific to our industry * We celebrate flexibility, allowing every team and office to lead with their proven approach * Our culture champions continuous learning and personal growth * We believe success comes through constant evolution and communication * We are passionate about having fun and making money, all while creating impact **POSITION OVERVIEW:** As a **Assistant Project Manager** at Pharis Design **Land Development** , you will be responsible for supporting the design planning and project management efforts of the firm. With a focus on creativity, design oversight, and project execution, you will work closely with the design team to ensure successful project outcomes. Your responsibilities will include design coordination, project management support, client communication, quality control, and creative problem\-solving. **A TYPICAL DAY MIGHT INCLUDE:** * Design Coordination: * Collaborate with the design team to develop creative and innovative design solutions that align with client objectives and project requirements. * Assist in the coordination of design activities, ensuring timely completion of deliverables and adherence to design standards. * Project Management Support: * Assist the Project Manager in project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation to ensure efficient project execution. * Contribute to the development of project scopes, budgets, and timelines. * Client Communication: * Serve as a point of contact for clients, providing updates on project progress, addressing concerns, and ensuring client satisfaction. * Effectively communicate design concepts and solutions to clients, incorporating their feedback and maintaining strong client relationships. * Quality Control: * Under the supervision of a Principal Planner, Associate Principal Planner, or Project Manager, conduct regular quality control reviews to ensure design deliverables meet the highest standards of excellence and align with project goals. * Identify and address design issues or discrepancies in a proactive and timely manner. * Creative Problem\-Solving: * Apply creative problem\-solving skills to overcome design challenges, proposing innovative solutions that balance aesthetics, functionality, and feasibility. * Collaborate with the design team to generate ideas and explore alternative design approaches. * Design Oversight: * Under the supervision of a Principal Planner, Associate Principal Planner, or Project Manager, provide design oversight and guidance to the design team, ensuring design integrity, adherence to project objectives, and compliance with regulatory requirements. * Review and provide feedback on design deliverables, offering constructive suggestions for improvement. * Project Documentation: * Assist in the preparation and maintenance of project documentation, including design plans, specifications, and project records. * Ensure accurate and up\-to\-date documentation throughout the project lifecycle. * Collaboration and Teamwork: * Foster a collaborative and supportive work environment, promoting effective communication, knowledge sharing, and teamwork among project team members. * Coordinate and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including landscape architects, engineers, and consultants, to integrate design elements seamlessly. * Continuous Learning and Development: * Stay updated with industry trends, design standards, and emerging technologies to enhance design capabilities and contribute to continuous improvement. * Seek opportunities for professional growth and skill enhancement. **REQUIRED EDUCATION/LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in urban planning, Landscape Architecture, or a related field. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Strong project management skills, with the ability to support multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. * Proficiency in design software, such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, or other relevant tools. * Excellent creativity and design sense, with the ability to develop innovative and visually appealing solutions. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with clients, team members, and stakeholders. * Attention to detail and commitment to delivering high\-quality design deliverables. * Problem\-solving skills and the ability to think critically to overcome design challenges. * Understanding of design principles, landscape architecture, and urban planning concepts. * Familiarity with zoning regulations, codes, and guidelines related to landscape architecture and urban planning. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize tasks in a dynamic work environment. * Adaptability and flexibility to adjust to changing project requirements and client preferences. **IDEALLY, YOU SHOULD ALSO HAVE:** * Effective communication skills, both oral and written * Effective interpersonal skills with coworkers **LEVEL UP WITH PHARIS DESIGN** At Pharis Design an LJA Company, we’re 100% employee\-owned. This drives results, rewards ambition and supports long\-term success for every team member. With almost 100 locations and 3,000\+ employee\-owners (and growing), we’re building something big! We want you to be part of it. **Your future grows here.** * **Generous Time Off:** PTO, paid holidays, and a full office closure between Christmas and New Year’s. * **Comprehensive Benefits:** Multiple plan options for health, dental, and pets. Along with mental health support. * **Family Support:** Paid maternity and parental leave to help you focus on what matters most. * **Education Support:** Tuition reimbursement and in\-house courses provided by our Learning and Development team. * **Referral Bonuses:** Know great talent? Get rewarded for helping us grow. * **Community Impact:** Company\-sponsored volunteer days and philanthropic initiatives. * **Professional Development:** Memberships to industry organizations to keep you connected and growing. * **Career Growth:** Great internal mobility opportunities to advance your career. * **Fun Culture:** LJA social events, employee sports teams, bring your kid to work day, etc. To Executive Search Firms \& Staffing Agencies: LJA Engineering, Inc. and its subsidiaries do not accept unsolicited resumes from any agencies that have not signed a service agreement. All unsolicited resumes will be considered LJA's property. This includes resumes submitted directly to hiring managers without contacting LJA's Human Resources Talent Department. Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: CNC Automation & Controls Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description: **What a great day looks like** ------------------------------- You step onto the floor and a multi\-axis VMC throws an axis alarm. Within minutes, you’ve parsed the control logic, traced a configuration fault, and restored production. Later, you run a vibration sweep and laser interferometer check on a 5\-axis mill, interpret the data, and schedule proactive work before downtime happens. In the afternoon, you coach a junior tech through precision alignment on a lathe, document findings in the CMMS, and wrap up with a continuous improvement review that saves hours on the next changeover. ### **What you’ll own** * Diagnose, repair, and prevent failures on complex mechanical, electrical, and control systems for CNC assets; design equipment improvements when needed. * Program, troubleshoot, and tune CNC/PLC/automation controls to resolve deep software, hardware, and configuration issues. * Use predictive tools—infrared thermography, ultrasonic testing, power quality analysis, laser interferometry, ball bar, and vibration analysis—to assess condition and plan proactive maintenance. * Lead and contribute to CI initiatives using proven methodologies to drive uptime, quality results, and cost savings. * Source parts and supplies, propose engineered alternatives, and implement reliability upgrades. * Execute maintenance independently to industry standards; uphold 5S and world‑class housekeeping. * Operate shop equipment as needed (lathe, drill press, grinder) to fabricate/repair parts; perform welding tasks when required. * Research new methods, tools, and technologies; standardize best practices across ATS sites and update documentation. * Provide input for cost analyses on new equipment, repair/rebuild proposals, savings, and innovations. * Keep thorough CMMS histories and analyze data to guide decisions. * Support sales with technical content for quotations and perform time‑and‑materials duties as required. * Train and mentor technicians; take on project management responsibilities when assigned. * Pursue on‑the‑job training and self‑study for ongoing development. * Follow all safety policies and technical instructions; maintain keen situational awareness to identify and correct unsafe conditions and behaviors. ### **What you bring** * High school diploma or GED. * Associate’s degree with a technical focus and 7\+ years in a relevant industry; or 10\+ years of directly related industry experience. * Hands‑on mastery of predictive technologies (e.g., vibration analysis, laser interferometer), precision alignment, and maintenance of CNC/process equipment. * Strong grasp of electrical, mechanical, fluid power, and control systems; able to analyze problems, develop options, and execute repairs. * Competent with hand and specialized tools; willing to travel as needed. * Six Sigma experience preferred. ### **Physical demands \& work environment** This role is active: standing and walking frequently; using hands/fingers; reaching; climbing ladders or lifts; balancing at height; and entering confined spaces to stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. Occasional sitting. At times you’ll lift and move 50\+ lbs. Close and color vision are regularly needed. Expect occasional exposure to outdoor weather and electrical hazards. Work occurs primarily in a loud factory setting with potential exposure to hazardous materials and greasy or slippery floors. ### **Proficiency** * Equipment Repair \& Maintenance ### **Technology you’ll tackle** * CNC Mill (3\-4 axis VMC) (Fanuc, Mazak, Haas, Okuma, Dmg Mori Seiki, Doosan) * CNC Lathe (2\-4 axis) (Mazak, Haas, Okuma, Doosan, Dmg Mori Seiki, Fuji, Nakamura) * CNC Mill (5\+ axis VMC) (Fanuc, Mitsubishi, Mazak, Okuma, Haas, Dmg Mori Seiki) * CNC Lathe (5\+ axis) (Mazak, Okuma, Dmg Mori Seiki, Samsung, Doosan, Eurotech, Hwachon, Nakamura) ### **Compensation \& benefits** We believe in fair, equitable pay. Actual salaries may land within, above, or below the posted range based on factors such as education, training, experience, professional achievements, business needs, and location. Our market‑leading benefits include Medical, Dental, and Vision plans; paid time off; a 401(k) with employer match; tuition reimbursement; and more. ### **Equal opportunity** ATS is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment to all applicants and employees without regard to age, color, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or other legally protected status. Review the privacy policy here.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - Healthcare Reporting
jobs.description: Join Carina Health Network and help us make Colorado communities healthier! Are you passionate about population health and interested in improving patient experience and outcomes? We support community health organizations across Colorado with technology, data, and resources that help people get the care they need, when and where they need it. If you're looking for a mission\-driven organization where your work has a real impact in real communities, Carina could be the right place for you. At Carina Health Network, we’re transforming community health by helping our members deliver proactive, data\-informed, and whole\-person care that drives measurable impact. Our work helps people with chronic conditions like diabetes and high blood pressure stay healthier, ensure older adults get regular check\-ups, and identify mental health needs early. We help reduce unnecessary emergency room visits by connecting people with the right care at the right time. Join us in reimagining the future of health care, where your work truly matters. **Job Summary** --------------- This role will report to Carina’s Population Health Director and will serve as the team’s representative to Carina’s Data Operations Team. The Healthcare Reporting Engineer will be responsible for all aspects of clinical data management and data source development for clinical report development that supports Carina’s Community Analytics Platform. Candidates must have experience in Microsoft SQL database development, Snowflake, clinical data integration, healthcare code systems, multiple healthcare data streams, reporting, and documentation. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to translate clinical report requirements into technical specifications. * Translate technical report specifications into high quality, clinical reporting data sources to be utilized by Carina Health Network business intelligence developers for production in the Community Analytics Platform. * Provide automated solutions whenever possible and proactively suggest alternative solutions. * Integrate standard healthcare code sets like LOINC, ICD\-9/10\-CM, CPT4, HCPCS, and SNOMED. * Collaborate with internal teams and external and other stakeholders to maintain, enhance, and troubleshoot existing health reporting across programs. * Ingest, normalize, and maintain population cohorts from a variety of input sources consistent with database management best practices. * Develop data validation reports and analyses where applicable. * Develop technical documentation of reports, processes, and automations. * Utilize up\-to\-date knowledge of databases and data quality best practices to deliver effective reporting. * Remain knowledgeable in healthcare data standards, measures, and code sets as well as applicable data privacy practices and legal requirements. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in data analytics, computer science, public health, or other health or technology\-related field preferred, or equivalent experience. * Works in a SQL environment, especially with data transformation, stored procedures, and query development. * Knowledge of data warehousing best practices, concepts, and processes. * Ability to work with multiple complex data sources and collaborate with internal teams to identify solutions to ensure project success. * Expertise in developing reporting for business intelligence solutions, knowledge of data structures, best practices, and health care related quality or performance measures. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with demonstrated change management experience. * Knowledge of common healthcare code sets like LOINC, ICD\-9/10\-CM, CPT4, HCPCS, and SNOMED. * Demonstrated ability to set and meet project timelines and deliverables. * Effective interpersonal and communications skills with the ability to interact with various levels of personnel using plain language. * Is flexible, organized, self\-directed, able to prioritize multiple tasks, and able to manage a full workload. * Experienced in Microsoft Office and Microsoft Operating Systems. * Ability to work with minimal supervision and maximum accountability. **Why You’ll Love Working Here** -------------------------------- * Insured group health, dental, and vison plans (Employer covers 100% of the cost for dental and vision) * Medical and dependent care flexible spending account options * Employer contributions $900 annually towards a Health Reimbursement Employer (HRA) or Health Savings Account (HSA), depending on the health plan selected * 401k retirement plan with up to a 4% employer contribution match * 100% employer\-paid life, AD\&D, short\-term, and long\-term disability plans paid for employees * Free 24/7 access to confidential resources through an employee assistance program (EAP) * Voluntary benefit plans to complement health care coverage, including accident insurance, critical illness, and hospital indemnity coverage * 17 days of paid vacation within one year of service * 12 paid sick days accrued by one year of service * 14 paid holidays (which includes two floating holidays) * One paid volunteer day * Employer\-paid programs/courses for professional growth and development * Cell phone and internet reimbursement * Competitive salary and full benefits * Annual, all expenses paid staff retreat * Flexible work (remote or hybrid) * Supportive, mission\-driven team * Opportunities to learn and grow **EEO Statement** Carina Health Network provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This job listing will be posted until 10/31/2026 or until filled.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: ### Our Mission Salt AI is building the intelligence layer for the enterprise, starting with life sciences, financial services, and the energy sector. In a world where AI is fragmented across models, tools, and data silos, Salt unifies them through a compliance\-first orchestration platform that lets regulated organizations deploy AI securely, at scale, and with confidence. We're creating the backend systems that power real\-world AI workflows across a multitude of industries where out\-of\-the\-box consumer tools don't cut it. Our platform turns complex, regulated environments into intelligent, adaptive systems where autonomous AI agents operate in harmony with existing infrastructure. ### About the Role As a Deployment Strategist, you own our most strategic enterprise deployments end to end — from initial scoping through production go\-live and customer self\-sufficiency. Reporting to the Chief Customer Officer, you'll work with leading pharma, biotech, investment banking, and energy enterprises deploying Salt into demanding SaaS, VPC, and on\-prem environments. This is a senior, judgment\-heavy role. You define what we're building, negotiate what we're not, direct the Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Solutions Engineers assigned to your accounts, and hold the line when a customer pushes to expand scope mid\-engagement. You'll keep engagement detail current in our existing AI\-first project management flow (Slack Notion Linear), where engineers groom their own tickets — so your time goes to scoping and direction, not ticket administration. You'll deliver highly technical projects on time, on budget, and above expectation. You'll guide customers through the process, manage expectations, manage internal resources to successful delivery, and collaborate with sales to guide them towards expansion opportunities. ### The Role (What You'll Be Doing) **Scope** * Scope engagements down to one or two named workflows with fixed timelines, and drive customer stakeholders to converge on them quickly. Define the engagement exit before work begins: what customer self\-sufficiency looks like, written down and agreed. * Own the SOW Approval Gate on new and expansion business — no contract or SOW goes to a customer without your sign\-off on scope, timeline, and capacity, including the authority to decline out\-of\-scope asks from senior customer stakeholders. * Partner with Sales on expansion: they lead the pursuit, you control what can be committed on scope, timeline, and capacity. **Execute** * Build and run the engagement plan: milestones, workstreams, owners, and dependencies across Salt and customer teams, with a weekly cadence that surfaces slippage early. * Drive customer\-side dependencies to closure — data access, security and IT reviews, environment provisioning, and stakeholder availability — where enterprise deployments most often stall. * Manage risks, issues, and escalations proactively, and escalate early, internally or to the customer sponsor. * Own delivery quality: acceptance criteria and evals agreed at scoping, testing and validation (including GxP where applicable), and production readiness through go\-live and hypercare. * Lead enablement: training, documentation, and change management so customer teams can run the workflows themselves. * Track effort, budget, and capacity across your accounts, and flag early when an engagement is at risk on timeline or cost. **Lead, Grow \& Build** * Provide leadership, prioritization, and technical direction to the Forward Deployed Engineers and Customer Solutions Engineers assigned to your accounts. * Lead executive communication with customer sponsors throughout the engagement lifecycle. * Stay engaged after go\-live on the technical outcome, adoption depth and scoping the next workflow. Sales owns the account relationship and review cadence. * Run post\-engagement debriefs and drive field learning back into product and platform priorities. * Build reusable delivery patterns — templates, integration components, and reference architectures that make each subsequent engagement faster. * Work with the account's Executive Advisor to bring domain expertise into scoping and validate outputs where correctness depends on it. ### Requirements \- Core Skills (Must Have) * 5\+ years owning complex enterprise technical deployments end to end — as a forward deployed engineer, technical program manager, solutions architect, or delivery lead at a technical consultancy or enterprise software company. * Delivery execution: a track record running multi\-workstream enterprise deployments to on\-time go\-live, where much of the critical path sat on the customer side. * Technical fluency: enough depth in cloud architecture, APIs, data pipelines, and integration patterns to scope work credibly and direct engineers without needing translation. Engineering or technical background required. * Scope discipline: demonstrated ability to hold a line against pressure from senior stakeholders, and the judgment to know when holding is right. * Written communication and document hygiene: scopes, exit criteria, and decisions live in writing, not in your head. * Executive presence: credible in the room with VP\- and C\-level customer sponsors at large enterprises. * Comfort with ambiguity: our customers often don't know their highest\-value use case when we arrive, and finding it is part of the job. * Willingness to travel as\-needed for client implementation work. ### Preferred/Bonus Skills (Nice To Have) * Experience with on\-premise, VPC, or air\-gapped deployments in regulated industries — pharma, life sciences, financial services, or government. * Familiarity with GxP, HIPAA, SOC 2, or similar compliance and validation frameworks. * Background at a company running a forward deployed engineering model. * Hands\-on experience with AI/ML workflows, model deployment, or agent orchestration. * Track record turning one\-off engagements into repeatable delivery motions. ### What Makes You A Great Fit * You measure success by whether the customer is actually using what you built — not whether it shipped. * You'd rather say no early than deliver a bloated engagement late. * You run a tight operating rhythm: everyone knows what's happening this week, what's at risk, and who owns it. * You're energized by walking into a messy enterprise environment and finding the one workflow that matters most. * You're comfortable being the most senior person in the room on delivery, and the person accountable when it goes sideways. * You want to build the function, not just work in it — this is the first Deployment Strategist at Salt, and the patterns you set become how we operate. * You're excited to apply your skills to AI in life sciences, financial services, and the energy sector where you can support teams doing high\-impact work. ### Perks And Benefits * Competitive salary based on location and experience. * Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, mental health. * Fully remote role, collaborating primarily within U.S. time zones. **Based in Southern California, Salt AI is pioneering the future of life sciences with advanced AI. Founded in 2024 by Aber Whitcomb and Jim Benedetto—veterans of MySpace, Jam City, Gravity, and Core Scientific—our leadership team brings over 15 years of collaboration. We’re not just building products, but transforming what’s possible in research and discovery. We value diverse perspectives and are committed to an inclusive team. If you’re excited about shaping the future of AI in life sciences, we'd love to connect with you.**

jobs.title: Director of Data
jobs.description: Rugiet was founded on the belief that men's health has been underserved by an industry too comfortable with mediocre results. We built Ready, a patented, clinician\-prescribed combination therapy that set a new standard for erectile dysfunction treatment \- and then we proved the model by scaling it to tens of thousands of patients without a single retail shelf. That success wasn't luck. It came from combining rigorous clinical science with a direct\-to\-patient model that removes the friction, the stigma, and the middlemen that have kept effective care out of reach for too long. Patients get better outcomes. We learn faster. The flywheel keeps spinning. Now we're applying that same formula to a broader vision of men's health \- sleep, hair loss, weight management, testosterone, and a supplements line built to the same standard as everything else we make. Each new category is an opportunity to do what we did in sexual health: find where the market is settling, build something better, and get it directly to the people who need it. We're a remote\-first team of builders, clinicians, marketers, and operators who move fast and take the work seriously. If you want to work on problems that matter, with people who hold themselves accountable, and at a company that's already proven its model \- this is the place. **Overview** ------------ The Director of Data \& Analytics is the architect and accelerator of Rugiet’s entire data ecosystem — infrastructure, analytics, attribution, forecasting, and personalization. You’ll lead a small, high\-impact team while driving the evolution of our stack as we migrate into Snowflake and build a scalable, ML\-ready foundation. You’ll report directly to the CGO and partner closely with Marketing, Product, Engineering, Operations, and Finance. This is a role for someone who can zoom between big\-picture strategy and hands\-on analytical depth without dropping a beat. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ ### **Data Strategy, Leadership \& Organizational Enablement** * Define Rugiet’s data strategy and lead the team executing it — from infrastructure to analytics to modeling. * Manage and develop 2 analysts/data engineers, raising the bar on analytical rigor, ownership, and output. * Create a transparent intake and prioritization system so stakeholders understand what’s happening, why, and when. * Introduce higher standards for what qualifies as a data request, focusing the team on analysis over mining. * Champion BI self\-service by training teams across the company and building intuitive, reliable dashboards that reduce dependency on analysts. ### **Infrastructure Ownership: Snowflake, ETL \& BI Tooling** * Lead Rugiet’s migration to Snowflake and design a warehouse optimized for speed, quality, and massive growth. * Optimize ETL pipelines (Segment Snowflake BI layer) that enable near\-real\-time reporting where it matters. * Shift the company away from one\-off dashboards and inconsistent models toward reusable, governed, version\-controlled assets. * Establish data governance standards — schemas, taxonomies, naming conventions — that prevent chaos as we scale. * Assess long term scalability of current BI tooling and build out more robust self\-service offerings for the organization to adopt for key decision making ### **ML, Personalization \& Product Partnership** * Partner with Product and Engineering to develop data inputs, segmentation logic, and feature sets used in personalization and ML\-driven experiences. * Translate behavioral and lifecycle data into algorithm\-ready structures that improve retention, engagement, and patient outcomes. * Ensure data pipelines and infrastructure support scalable training, monitoring, and continuous optimization of ML models. ### **Growth \& Retention Analytics (Attribution, LTV, Forecasting)** * Build LTV models and LTV curves sliced by acquisition channel, offer, audience, and treatment category. * Create daily multi\-touch attribution reporting and cut reliance on costly external tools by bringing core capabilities in\-house. * Build Rugiet’s retention OKRs and dashboards within BI tools — with intuitive views for the whole business. * Attribute cancellations and churn to specific lifecycle, email, and SMS campaigns with clarity and statistical rigor. * Architect and analyze A/B tests across the site, funnel, CRM, and product experience — unblocking high\-conversion opportunities. * Develop MMM (Marketing Mix Modeling) in Python to inform budget allocation across nine figures of annual spend. * Partner with Finance on forecasting models for demand, inventory, and revenue planning. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 7\+ years in Data \& Analytics with 2\+ years leading teams; strong preference for high\-growth DTC or telehealth experience. * Hands\-on mastery of modern data stacks: * + **Warehousing:** Snowflake (or equivalent) + **ETL/Pipelines:** Segment, Fivetran, dbt, or similar + **BI:** Domo (strong preference), Looker, Mode + **Analytics:** GA4, Segment, Mixpanel + **Attribution:** Northbeam, MTA structures, familiarity with MMM * Advanced SQL and strong data\-modeling discipline — you build scalable foundations, not just one\-off queries. * Proven ability to turn messy data into clean insights and communicate them clearly to executives. * Experience enabling BI self\-service and building stakeholder capability. * Strong understanding of data governance and privacy/security practices. ### **Nice to have** * Python or R experience for LTV modeling, churn prediction, MMM, forecasting, and ML feature engineering. * Experience with Blotout, Growthbook, or similar tools. * Background in healthcare, wellness, or subscription businesses. * Experience building or supporting personalization/ML systems in partnership with Product.

jobs.title: Engineer in Training-Dallas/Fort Worth, TX
jobs.description: Certerra is a growing national provider of testing, inspection, and certification services that support innovation in new product development, quality assurance, for project delivery, and engineered solutions for asset management. We are passionate about contributing to the sustainable development of the communities we serve. We are a national firm with a global reach serving national and international clients from 30\+ offices located in 10 states and are ranked on ENR’s Top 500 list alongside the nation’s top firms. With a 60\-year history, Certerra has a passion for high\-end services, constant innovation, and investment in the development of world\-class laboratory facilities, and interactive management technologies. Each member of our staff is committed to service, innovation, and the success of our clients. jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Product Manager
jobs.description: **About Onos Health** --------------------- Onos Health's mission is simple but ambitious: ensure every healthcare dollar goes toward delivering the highest quality care. Today, nearly 30% of U.S. healthcare spending is wasted due to ineffective care and administrative burden, driven by misalignment between providers and payers. This waste is a primary reason healthcare remains unaffordable for so many. Onos is addressing this by building the largest AI\-driven healthcare data platform. Our models enable payers to make faster, more accurate decisions across their populations. By guiding members to the right care, Onos channels more dollars to high\-quality care that drives outcomes while reducing waste and making healthcare more affordable. Onos is well\-funded by some of the best healthcare investors and is working with the nation’s largest health plans. Come join a category\-defining company and help reimagine healthcare for the better **Why Onos?** ------------- * Meaningful impact: Help fix what is fundamentally broken in healthcare * Direct collaboration: Work alongside experienced founders with deep healthcare and data expertise * Culture: Join a high\-performing, transparent, and results\-oriented team * Ownership: Significant responsibility and autonomy from day one * Opportunity: Play a pivotal role in building a fast\-growing, category\-defining healthcare AI company **The Role** ------------ We're seeking a Forward\-Deployed Product Manager who is motivated to fix how behavioral health care is managed, delivered, and paid for in the United States. This is a high\-ownership, client\-facing role at the intersection of product, account management, and implementation, built for someone who wants to be close to the problem, not just the roadmap. This is also our first product hire, so we’re looking for a strong add to the team who can help set the tone and lead by example. You will own a portfolio of 1\-2 health plan customers end\-to\-end: leading the day\-to\-day relationship, translating their clinical and operational needs into product direction, and working directly with your pod's engineer to ship. You'll be the person your customers trust, the person engineering relies on for clarity, and an early voice in shaping how Onos builds and delivers at scale. You will report directly to the Chief Product Officer. **What You'll Be Doing at Onos** -------------------------------- * Own the own the strategic relationship with the client, understand their pain points, and help guide to the product for their specific needs * Develop deep fluency in how health plans operate across utilization management, prior authorization, and clinical workflows so you can anticipate needs and drive real outcomes * Translate customer requirements into clear product specs and acceptance criteria that your engineering partner can execute against * Manage project timelines and delivery, holding the pod accountable and communicating proactively when things shift * Surface patterns across your accounts that inform the broader product roadmap * Help define the playbook for how Onos serves customers as we grow **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\-7 years of experience in product management and/or consulting * Strong communicator who can run a client meeting, write a clear spec, and follow up without being chased * Project management discipline; you track details, hit deadlines, and keep things moving * Comfortable working with technical teams and translating between business and engineering * Self\-directed and comfortable with ambiguity; we're early and the playbook is still being written * Ability to navigate complex situations across clients * Passionate about solving healthcare’s biggest challenges **Bonus Points If You Have** ---------------------------- * MPH, MHA, or other health policy or public health credential * Experience at a health plan, BHMO, managed care organization, or health plan vendor * Strategy consulting background **Benefits and Perks** ---------------------- * Flexible hybrid arrangement: 2\-3 days/week at San Francisco office (Financial District), remote\-first culture * Unlimited vacation policy * Paid parental leave * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Pre\-tax commuter benefits * 401(k) * Significant equity as an early employee * Direct mentorship from experienced founders * Ground\-floor opportunity to help build a team and culture * Regular team events and offsites * Company\-provided equipment and home office setup **Salary Range** ---------------- **$180,000 \- $220,000 base.** We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer (AI-Focused)
jobs.description: **About Secure Grid Technologies:** Secure Grid Technologies is a US\-based infrastructure company operating at the intersection of Bitcoin mining power operations and AI/data\-center infrastructure. As the company expands into AI and high\-performance computing infrastructure, we're building out our commercial team to identify, evaluate, and secure data\-center capacity across the US market. **The Role:** We're looking for a Full Stack Developer with hands\-on experience building **AI systems** using **OpenAI, Claude (Anthropic), or Grok**. Any modern tech stack is fine — what matters most is real, hands\-on AI experience. **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and maintain full\-stack web applications (frontend \+ backend) * Build AI\-powered features and systems using OpenAI, Claude, or Grok APIs * Build and maintain APIs, databases, and backend services * Collaborate directly with the CEO and team on product requirements and technical decisions * Own projects end\-to\-end — from architecture through deployment and maintenance * Troubleshoot, optimize, and scale existing systems as the company grows **What We're Looking For:** **Required** * Proven experience as a Full Stack Developer (any modern stack) * **Hands\-on experience building AI systems with OpenAI, Claude (Anthropic), or Grok** * Experience with databases and API design * Based in the United States * Comfortable working independently in a fast\-paced startup environment **Preferred** * Experience building AI agents or autonomous workflows in production * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) * Experience in early\-stage startups or building products from scratch **What We Offer:** * Remote role, US\-based * Full\-time or contract engagement, depending on fit * Direct working relationship with the CEO and leadership team * Opportunity to build core technical products from the ground up at a fast\-growing AI infrastructure company. !!! Hands\-on experience building AI systems with OpenAI, Claude, or Grok is required — candidates without this experience will not be considered. **Apply now and help build the technical backbone of Secure Grid Technologies!** Pay: Up to $200,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: IT Specialist III - Servicedesk Technician
jobs.description: **Posting Title** ================= IT Specialist III \- Servicedesk Technician . **Location** ============ CO \- Golden . **Position Type** ================= Regular . **Hours Per Week** ================== 40 . **Working at NLR** ================== NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development. Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world\-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth. At NLR, you'll find a mission\-driven environment supported by state\-of\-the\-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well\-being. **Job Description** =================== This position is for endpoint and account management support. Knowledge and ability to provide installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, operation and coordination of workstation computers and associated IT equipment and applications is also required. Responsibilities will include Service Desk (Tier I) phone, self\-service, chat, and walkup support, while working under minimal supervision. A mid\-level technical understanding of account administration for Active Directory, YubiKey, AppleID, Windows 365, and other technologies employed in our environment are required. A working knowledge of Windows operating systems and macOS is also required. Working knowledge of Outlook and Exchange email services Experience with Mac OS (current versions), working knowledge of Macintosh systems in an Active Directory Domain environment, Exchange, DNS/DHCP/IP/File Sharing, hard drive encryption software, hardware/software troubleshooting, and Microsoft Office for Mac. * Answer phones and conduct technical support in a call center environment. * Document customer contacts, communicate service information to users, and record action using system of record. Working knowledge of network operating systems and protocols. General understanding of network infrastructure and administration. jobs.title: Implementation Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ You will own how Cascade actually works for each customer. This is a build\-heavy, customer\-facing engineering role: you take a signed customer from kickoff to a live, production implementation, and you keep it working. You're the person who understands both the product internals and the customer's real environment well enough to make them fit together. Because you build the implementations, you're also the most credible person to talk about them. You'll join late\-stage sales calls to show prospects exactly what we've built for customers like them — what the setup looked like, what was hard, and how it delivered value. This is not a pre\-sales support role bolted onto engineering; it's an engineer who can carry the technical story into the room. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own customer implementations end to end — scoping, integration, configuration, data setup, testing, and launch — and stay accountable for them in production. * Work directly with each customer's team to understand their systems, constraints, and goals, then translate that into a working Cascade deployment. * Write and ship the code, integrations, and custom configuration required to make each implementation succeed. * Debug and resolve issues in customer environments, and feed recurring problems back to product and engineering. * Join late\-stage sales calls to present real customer implementations to prospects — walking through what we built, the outcomes, and how it maps to their situation. * Build reusable tooling, templates, and playbooks so each new implementation is faster than the last. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Strong engineering fundamentals — you can build and ship production integrations independently, not just configure a UI. * Direct customer\-facing experience: you're comfortable running a technical conversation, on a working call and in front of prospects on a sales call. * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership — you can walk into a messy customer environment and drive to a working outcome without a fully spec'd plan. * Clear communicator who can explain technical work to non\-technical stakeholders and tell a compelling "here's what we did" story. * Bias for shipping and for making the next implementation easier than the last. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, implementation engineer, founding/solutions engineer, or early implementation hire at a startup. * Experience integrating with HR, benefits, payroll, or HRIS systems. * Comfort working closely with sales and being measured partly on customer outcomes and deal support. **Why This Role Matters** ------------------------- Delivery is where Cascade proves its value. You'll be the person who makes customers successful and the proof point that closes the next deal — a rare seat where what you build directly drives revenue. *Cascade is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team.* Compensation Range: $90K \- $125K

jobs.title: Project Management / Sales
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * Free uniforms * Health insurance * Competitive salary * Employee discounts **Project Management / Sales** **Position Overview** We are seeking a highly motivated, organized, and results\-oriented **Flooring Project Manager / Sales** with a strong background in the flooring and/or construction industry. This position combines project management, flooring sales, design, customer service, estimating, and installation coordination. The ideal candidate is confident, professional, detail\-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple projects and priorities. This individual will work closely with residential and builder clients, installers, tradespeople, vendors, architects, engineers, and internal team members to ensure projects are properly estimated, sold, scheduled, executed, and completed on time and within budget. The position requires a consultative approach to sales, strong communication and organizational skills, and the ability to take ownership of projects from the initial customer interaction through final completion and billing. **Key Responsibilities** **Project Management \& Installation Coordination** * Manage flooring, remodeling (kitchen \& bath) projects from initial sale through installation, completion, and final billing. * Take overall responsibility for the successful initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, control, and closure of assigned projects. * Develop project schedules and coordinate installation activities to ensure deadlines are met. * Schedule installers and allocate responsibilities based on project requirements. * Create clear and accurate work orders for every project and review the scope of work with installers. * Supervise and coordinate installers, laborers, mechanics, and other trades as necessary. * Conduct site visits and job checks to monitor progress, quality, and adherence to project requirements. * Attend client and job meetings and provide accurate project updates and progress reports. * Coordinate with architects, engineers, builders, general contractors, and other trades to resolve project issues and ensure proper sequencing of work. * Review project scope and identify changes, discrepancies, or potential issues before they affect schedule or budget. * Monitor materials, equipment, samples, and product availability and proactively address shortages or delays. * Evaluate project progress and maintain accurate documentation. * Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and according to customer and company requirements. * Ensure compliance with applicable health and safety standards and report issues promptly. * Identify potential project risks and take proactive steps to minimize delays, errors, and additional costs. **Estimating, Orders \& Administration** * Prepare accurate estimates, proposals, work orders, and customer documentation. * Enter and maintain accurate project and customer information in RFMS. * Create accurate orders in RFMS and manage related processes, including job costing. * Maintain current project information and documentation throughout the life of each project. * Monitor open quotes and follow up on outstanding opportunities. * Review sample check\-out logs and maintain accurate records. * Complete billing promptly upon project completion. * Maintain accurate records related to project scope, pricing, materials, labor, changes, and completion. * Develop and maintain proficiency in RFMS and other company software systems. * Prepare daily task lists and delegate responsibilities as appropriate. * Organize and lead regular team meetings as needed. * Communicate project changes and update requirements to all appropriate parties. **Sales, Design \& Customer Service** * Greeting customers promptly and provide knowledgeable, professional assistance. * Answer incoming calls and return customer calls in a timely manner. * Assess customer needs and recommend appropriate flooring products and solutions. * Assist residential and builder clients with flooring selections, product specifications, and design decisions. * Provide complimentary estimates to retail customers. * Conduct measurements and prepare accurate quotes within established timelines. * Follow up on quotes, customer questions, and outstanding opportunities to secure deposits and move projects forward. * Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, builders, contractors, designers, and other industry professionals. * Demonstrate strong negotiation and closing skills while maintaining a customer\-focused approach. * Maintain showroom appearance, displays, samples, and sample check\-out records. * Communicate with customers throughout the project to ensure expectations are clearly understood and met. * Send customer satisfaction communications and address concerns promptly and professionally. **Qualifications, Skills \& Experience** * Proven experience in flooring, construction, project management, sales, design, or a related industry. * Experience managing construction or flooring projects from start to finish preferred. * Ability to read and understand blueprints, plans, specifications, and project documentation. * Knowledge of general construction methodologies and the ability to coordinate flooring installations with other trades. * Strong understanding of flooring products, installation methods, and/or design principles preferred. * Strong sales, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills. * Excellent verbal, written, telephone, and interpersonal communication skills. * Strong customer service and relationship\-building abilities. * Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail. * Strong prioritization, problem\-solving, and time\-management skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adapt to frequent changes. * Ability to strategize, anticipate potential issues, and remain proactive throughout a project. * Ability to exercise sound business judgment and make decisions independently. * Strong leadership skills and the ability to effectively coordinate and motivate installers and other team members. * Computer proficient, including internet, email, Microsoft Word, Excel, databases, and other business software. * Proficiency with graphic design tools or design software is preferred. * Willingness and ability to become proficient in RFMS. * Minimum 1–2 years of experience in sales, marketing, flooring, construction, project management, or a related field preferred. * Associate degree from an accredited two\-year college or equivalent combination of education and work experience preferred. **General Responsibilities** * Manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment. * Stay ahead of potential problems and proactively develop solutions. * Exercise sound business judgment when making decisions related to customers, projects, scheduling, materials, and costs. * Collaborate effectively with team members and empower others to successfully complete their responsibilities. * Maintain a professional, positive, and customer\-focused demeanor. * Take on additional responsibilities as needed to support the company and team. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate is a **self\-motivated, ambitious, and highly organized professional** who enjoys working with people and taking ownership of projects. They are equally comfortable assisting a customer in selecting products, preparing an estimate, coordinating installers, resolving a job\-site issue, and ensuring the project is completed successfully. This person should be confident working independently while also functioning as a strong team player. They should be comfortable in a customer\-facing environment, possess strong business judgment, and must have the ability to balance sales objectives with exceptional customer service and successful project execution. **Compensation** Starting at $1200\. weekly

jobs.title: SFC Developer / Manufacturing Systems Developer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are looking for an experienced **SFC Developer / Manufacturing Systems Developer** to develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance our manufacturing SFC/MES systems. This is a **developer\-level position**. The primary focus is **code\-level analysis, software development, database changes, API development, system\-logic analysis, debugging, and permanent resolution of complex SFC issues**. The ideal candidate has strong **Java, Oracle/PLSQL, software troubleshooting, and logical problem\-solving skills**, with the ability to understand the relationship between manufacturing processes, application logic, and database data. The position will work closely with the SFC development team, onsite IT, IE, PE, QA, manufacturing, and other technical teams. **Chinese\-speaking ability is preferred**. **Key Responsibilities** **1\. SFC Development \& Troubleshooting*** Develop, maintain, enhance, and support SFC/MES applications. * Perform **source\-code analysis, debugging, and system\-logic analysis** to identify root causes. * Troubleshoot complex production issues using application logs, source code, APIs, database records, and manufacturing\-process analysis. * Implement **permanent software fixes** rather than temporary workarounds. * Develop new functions and modify existing SFC functionality. * Support the continued development of the SFC platform, with a primary focus on **Java\-based technologies**. **2\. Database \& API Development*** Develop and maintain **Oracle SQL/PLSQL**, including: + Stored procedures + Functions + Packages + Queries * Analyze production data and perform controlled data corrections when required. * Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot **REST APIs and system integrations**. * Analyze application, API, and database interactions to resolve system issues. **3\. Manufacturing System Knowledge** Develop a strong understanding of SFC/MES processes, including:* Work orders and routing * Station/process control * Serial number tracking * Material traceability * Quality control * Repair/rework * Production tracking and testing * Packing and shipment Understand how manufacturing processes are translated into **application logic, database transactions, and system controls**. **4\. Collaboration \& Deployment*** Work closely with the SFC development team to resolve complex technical issues. * Collaborate with IT, IE, PE, QA, manufacturing, and other technical teams. * Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment, and production validation. * Document system logic, root causes, corrective actions, and permanent fixes. * Support production issues when software\-level intervention is required. **Required Qualifications*** Strong professional experience in **Java software development**. * Strong **Oracle Database and SQL/PLSQL** experience. * Experience with one or more of: + Spring Boot + MyBatis + Java Web / Servlet + REST APIs + Backend development * Strong source\-code analysis, debugging, and troubleshooting skills. * Strong logical thinking and structured problem\-solving ability. * Ability to understand complex application logic and unfamiliar source code. * Good understanding of relational databases, transactions, stored procedures, and data integrity. * Ability to work independently and collaborate with distributed development teams. * Strong ownership and responsibility for production system stability. * **Chinese\-speaking ability strongly preferred.** **Education \& Certifications*** **Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field preferred.** * Equivalent education combined with strong relevant software development experience may be considered. * Relevant certifications in **Java, Oracle/SQL/PLSQL, Spring/Spring Boot, software engineering, database development, Linux, MES, or SFC technologies** are a plus. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with **SFC, MES, manufacturing execution, or shop\-floor systems**. * Experience in electronics or high\-volume manufacturing. * Understanding of SMT, assembly, testing, repair/rework, and packing processes. * Experience with manufacturing databases and production data analysis. * Experience with REST APIs and system integrations. * Experience with Git/version control and software deployment. * Linux and/or Windows application experience. * **Delphi/Pascal experience is a plus**, particularly for supporting legacy SFC modules, but is not a primary requirement. Future SFC development will primarily be Java\-based. **Key Candidate Profile** The ideal candidate is a **software engineer**, not simply an onsite support specialist. The candidate should be able to:* Read and understand existing source code. * Analyze application architecture and system logic. * Trace issues from the manufacturing process through application code and database transactions. * Identify root causes using logs, source code, APIs, and database data. * Make appropriate code, database, or API changes. * Test, deploy, and validate permanent solutions. * Quickly learn complex SFC functionality. * Take ownership of an issue through final resolution. **Position Scope \& Development Expectations** Complex SFC issues may require **source\-code review, system\-logic analysis, database procedure changes, API changes, data correction, or code\-level debugging**. These responsibilities are beyond the normal scope of traditional onsite support and cannot be fully transferred through a short\-term handover. The successful candidate will progressively develop a deep understanding of the **SFC source code, architecture, database structure, manufacturing processes, and system dependencies** through hands\-on experience and close collaboration with the SFC development team. This position is intended for someone seeking to build **long\-term expertise in SFC/MES software development** and become a fully capable SFC software engineer. **Core Technical Skills** **Required:*** Java * Oracle / SQL / PL/SQL * Software development * Source\-code analysis * Debugging and troubleshooting * System\-logic analysis * Database analysis * Strong logical thinking **Preferred:*** Spring Boot * MyBatis * Java Web / Servlet * REST API * SFC / MES * Manufacturing systems * Git / version control * Linux / Windows * Software deployment * Delphi / Pascal * Chinese language **Success in This Role** The goal is to independently support the full technical resolution process: **Production Issue System Analysis Source\-Code Review Root Cause Database/API Analysis Code/Data Correction Testing Deployment Permanent Fix** The long\-term objective is to develop a **fully capable SFC software engineer** who can independently analyze complex SFC issues and work closely with the SFC development organization to maintain and continuously improve the manufacturing system. jobs.title: Security Engineer III
jobs.description: **Position Summary** This role owns the firewall estate, security architecture, and standards for all six properties, the documentation library behind them, and the posture roadmap that sequences the work, and personally implements the hardest parts of it. This is a senior individual contributor role, not a management position. Expect to be writing a standard in the morning, converting a property to it that night, and presenting the result to the Risk Committee the following week. **Position Title**: Security Engineer III **Location**: Remote (within driving distance of a Schurz property, see locations below) **Rate:** $108,000 \- $138,000 annually **Reports to**: VP, Business Technology **Position Type**: Full\-time **Essential Responsibilities** **Firewall Estate Ownership — Primary Responsibility** * Own the firewall estate for all six properties: the standard, the platform strategy, the refresh roadmap, and the vendor relationship. This is the accountability that does not move. * Define the firewall reference architecture — platform selection, high\-availability model, management topology, zone model, and the policy standard every property implements. * Decide whether the estate consolidates onto one vendor and drive that conversion, or document why a mixed estate is the right answer and how it will be managed consistently. * Own the multi\-year refresh and capacity plan as a budget line, and defend it. * Personally execute the high\-risk conversions, migrations, and cutovers rather than delegating them. * Hold final approval on every firewall change that deviates from standard and on every exception that stays open. **Architecture and Standards** * Define the access\-control and segmentation reference architecture for all six properties, replacing six locally grown conventions with one standard plus a documented deviation list. * Author the hardening baselines platform by platform, and the method for measuring drift against them. * Own the standards library itself: versioning, review cadence, ownership, approval path, and retirement of standards that no longer hold. * Own the rule lifecycle governance model — naming, ownership, review cadence, expiration, exception register. * Lead the conversion of each property onto the standard. * Review and approve designs produced by Tier II; approve or reject deviations. **Internal Network Understanding** * Hold the authoritative picture of how all six networks actually work — edge, core, plant, subscriber, and management planes — including where they differ and why. * Maintain the trust\-boundary and data\-flow model that segmentation decisions are made against, and keep it accurate as platform consolidation moves things. * Be the person who can answer, without research, what is exposed where and what would happen if a given control failed. **Documentation as a Deliverable** * Own the documentation standard: what must exist for every property, in what form, reviewed how often, and who is accountable when it drifts. * Ensure current security architecture documentation, diagrams, standards, runbooks, and decision records exist for all six properties, and enforce that they stay current rather than decaying between audits. * Write the decision records that explain why a standard is what it is, so the next engineer does not relitigate settled questions. **Posture, Compliance, and Evidence** * Maintain a security posture roadmap mapped to NIST CSF and CIS Controls, with a defensible current\-state assessment behind it, and sequence the work against it. * Own the cybersecurity and supply chain risk management plans required for broadband grant programs. BEAD subgrantees must attest to a cybersecurity risk management plan reflecting the NIST framework and Executive Order 14028, plus a separate supply chain plan based on NISTIR 8276 and NIST SP 800\-161, reevaluated periodically and resubmitted within 30 days of any substantive change. * Support FCC CPNI obligations, lawful\-process handling, and breach notification analysis across a multi\-state footprint where notification clocks differ by state. * Produce the evidence pack that satisfies auditors and cyber insurance underwriters without a fire drill each renewal. * Define and report the metrics that go to the Risk Committee and executive leadership. **Internal Program Leadership and Vendors** * Lead major internal security initiatives end to end — zero\-trust network access, privileged access management, out\-of\-band access resilience, internal endpoint protection consolidation, internal log platform decisions — including the implementation, not only the selection. Initiatives belonging to the managed services line are out of scope. * Run vendor evaluations with real cost modeling sized to a mid\-tier budget. The enterprise answer is frequently the wrong answer; knowing when to buy the smaller product is part of the job. * Scope and govern third\-party security engagements the company commissions, and own remediation t ways of doing the same thing. * Regulated\-data experience: CPNI, PCI DSS scope reduction, CALEA\-adjacent handling. * Grant compliance exposure, particularly BEAD or state broadband program security requirements. * Prior ownership of a security budget or vendor portfolio. **Authority and Self\-Direction** Sets the security roadmap and their own work against it. Approves architecture and cross\-property standards; owns the exception register. Final technical escalation. Escalates to the Vice President for budget, contractual, or organizational decisions only. Accountable for outcomes on a quarterly cadence rather than for task\-level activity. **First\-Year Success Measures** * Full ownership of the firewall estate established: one inventory of record, no firewall out of support, high\-availability pairs tested, and a published refresh plan. * A single firewall, access\-control, and segmentation standard published and adopted at all six properties, with a documented deviation list rather than six local conventions. * Complete, current security documentation for all six properties, with a review cadence that holds after the initial push. * A 12\-month posture roadmap in place, sequenced and defensible, with the first two initiatives delivered rather than planned. * Grant, audit, and insurance evidence current and maintained on a calendar rather than a scramble. * Sustained reduction in critical findings and in the age of open findings. * Two engineers capable of leading a migration independently. **Conduct and Data Handling** * Handles customer proprietary network information and subscriber data. Strict adherence to CPNI, lawful\-process, and internal data\-classification standards is a condition of the role. * Security tooling and administrative access are used only for authorized purposes; all privileged activity is logged and reviewable. * AI tooling is used within the published data\-handling standard — advisory only, never in the control path for production changes. **Working Conditions** * Remote, but must reside within driving distance of one of our property locations: **Winona, MN; Sergeant Bluff, IA; Maricopa, AZ; Hagerstown, MD; Burlington, VT; or New Knoxville, OH** * Office, data center, headend, and hub site environments; occasional work in equipment rooms and outside\-plant facilities. * Ability to lift and position equipment up to 50 pounds and to rack and cable hardware. * After\-hours and weekend maintenance windows; participation in an on\-call rotation with defined response expectations. * Extended periods at a workstation; travel by vehicle between properties in multiple states. **Why Join Schurz Broadband Group?** When you join Schurz Broadband Group, you’ll be part of an award\-winning company and team. We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Group health \& dental insurance * 401(k) program with company match * Generous PTO program * Company wellness program * Employer\-paid short\- and long\-term disability * And much more! We are committed to providing an environment that gives each employee the opportunity to nurture their gifts and achieve their potential. Our mission is to pass on to future generations—customers, employees, communities, and owners—an organization that is even stronger and better than it is today. **Schurz Communications and its subsidiaries’ strategic objectives:** * We will attract, invest in, communicate with, and retain top talent. * We will innovate, partner, experiment and create a better future together. * We strive to continuously improve operating performance to ensure sustained growth. * We will dynamically grow revenues by building and nurturing mutually beneficial and profitable customer relationships. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Senior Data Scientist** ========================= * CONSUMER AND WORKER PROTECTION Posted on 09/29/2026 * Full\-time Location NYC\-ALL BOROS * No exam required Department Research and Analytics Salary range: $98,159\.00 – $112,883\.00 Save **Job Description** ------------------- \*\*This position may be eligible for remote work for up to 2 days per week, pursuant to the Flexible Work Pilot Program. \*\* The NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP) protects and enhances the daily economic lives of New Yorkers to create thriving communities. DCWP licenses nearly 45,000 businesses in more than 40 industries and enforces key consumer protection and workplace laws that apply to countless more. By supporting businesses through equitable enforcement and access to resources, DCWP protects the marketplace from predatory practices and strives to create a culture of compliance. DCWP empowers consumers and working families by providing the tools and resources they need to achieve financial health and work\-life balance. DCWP also conducts research and advocates for public policy that furthers its work to support New York City’s communities. For more information about DCWP and its work, call 311 or visit DCWP at NYC Department of Consumer and Worker Protection (DCWP), sign up for its newsletter, or follow on its social media sites, X, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. About RAD The Research and Analytics Division (RAD) is DCWP's in\-house data team, and one of the first municipal offices of its kind in the country. Data scientists, technologists, engineers, product managers, and PhD economists work directly with the agency's attorneys and investigators to speed up investigations and win relief for consumers and workers. RAD also supports the agency's research, policy analysis, public reporting, and internal operational analysis. DCWP's data scientists and economists helped pioneer the Minimum Pay Rate for delivery workers, which has resulted in over $2 billion in additional pay. RAD will grow to 36 staff by FY28\. It's hiring now, and it's moving fast. The job The Senior Data Scientist will be a key member of RAD’s Operations Analytics team, which plays a critical role in providing timely and accurate operations data to stakeholders in order to comply with public reporting needs, increase the agency’s transparency, and provide direct informational support to our decision makers as they shape DCWP’s policies, practices, and procedures. The unit coordinates collaboration on quality improvement initiatives, designs and implements performance management systems and tools, and recommends new analyses and analytic projects to improve agency outcomes. DCWP is seeking for this position a highly skilled data scientist with a strong background in assessing data quality, a track record of applying appropriate analytical techniques to solve complex organizational and operational challenges, and an entrepreneurial spirit with the ability to think outside the box to design and implement novel solutions.
