jobs.title: Senior Principal Database Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview: At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting\-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth. **Be part of a team that makes a real difference.** Job Description : **This is a remote position and can be located anywhere in the US.*** We are seeking a **Principal** **Data Engineer** to design, build, and optimize modern data platforms that power enterprise analytics, reporting, machine learning, and AI initiatives. * The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise across cloud platforms, data architecture, and automation with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, high\-impact solutions. * This role will partner closely with business stakeholders, analytics teams, data scientists, architects, and engineering teams to deliver secure, governed, and reliable data products that drive measurable business value. * The Principal Data Engineer will design and maintain scalable data platforms and pipelines, develop and optimize cloud\-based data architectures, and automate infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools. * They will collaborate with data scientists, analysts, architects, and business leaders to gather requirements, troubleshoot complex technical issues, implement data quality controls, and improve platform governance and security. * The role also involves mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, evaluating emerging technologies such as GenAI and machine learning, and continuously improving data platform performance, reliability, and cost efficiency across cloud environments including AWS, Snowflake, Azure, and Databricks. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field * Equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered * Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field preferred * 10\+ years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or related technical roles * Proven track record designing and delivering enterprise\-scale data platforms and analytics solutions * Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives and influence architectural decisions * Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Experience operating in fast\-paced, highly collaborative Agile environments * Ability to independently drive projects from concept through implementation and support * Strong problem\-solving mindset with a focus on business outcomes, automation, and continuous improvement **Data Engineering \& Architecture*** Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python * Experience building and maintaining scalable ETL/ELT pipelines * Strong expertise in PySpark and distributed data processing * Experience designing enterprise data models and lakehouse architectures * Deep understanding of data warehousing, data lakes, and modern data platforms * Experience implementing data quality, monitoring, and governance frameworks **Cloud \& Platform Engineering*** Hands\-on experience with AWS services such as S3, IAM, Glue, and Lake Formation * Experience working with Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, or GCP * Experience designing secure, scalable cloud\-native data architectures * Understanding of cloud security, identity management, and access controls **Infrastructure \& DevOps*** Experience with Terraform or similar Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools * Strong Git\-based development practices * Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation * Knowledge of platform monitoring, optimization, and operational support **Collaboration \& Delivery*** Experience partnering with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions * Ability to advise teams on best practices, architecture, and platform capabilities * Experience working within Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe delivery frameworks * Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills **Desired Skills \& Experience*** Experience administering and scaling enterprise Snowflake environments * Multi\-cloud experience across AWS, Azure, and GCP * Experience supporting machine learning, MLOps, or AI\-enabled analytics platforms * Hands\-on experience with GenAI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI\-powered automation solutions * Experience leading cloud migrations from on\-premises environments to cloud lakehouse architectures * Experience developing platform governance, security, and cost\-management strategies * Experience building automated cloud provisioning frameworks and self\-service data platforms * Familiarity with dbt and modern analytics engineering practices * Experience with Tableau or other business intelligence tools * Proven ability to optimize cloud spending and improve platform efficiency * Experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering standards * Exposure to large\-scale, high\-volume data environments supporting enterprise analytics and data science workloads **Preferred Certifications*** Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate * AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or higher\-level AWS certifications * Snowflake certifications * Azure Data Engineer Associate * Terraform Associate or related jobs.title: Software Engineer (New Grad), AI Entities
jobs.description: EvenUp is on a mission to close the justice gap using technology and AI. We empower personal injury lawyers and victims to get the justice they deserve. Our products enable law firms to secure faster settlements, higher payouts, and better outcomes for victims injured through no fault of their own in vehicle collisions, accidents, natural disasters, and more. We are one of the fastest\-growing vertical SaaS companies in history, and we are just getting started. EvenUp is backed by top VCs, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Bain Capital Ventures, SignalFire, and Lightspeed. We are looking to expand our team with talented, driven, and collaborative individuals who seek to have a lasting impact. Learn more at www.evenuplaw.com. The **AI Entities team** builds the core technology that transforms unstructured information from legal and medical documents into reliable, structured information that powers EvenUp's products. We build systems that understand, organize, and manage information throughout the lifecycle of a legal case. As a New Grad Software Engineer on the AI Entities team, you will work at the intersection of **backend engineering, document processing, and AI**. You will collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, machine learning experts, and product teams to build systems that process large volumes of documents and power AI\-driven experiences. ### **What You'll Do** * Build and improve systems that extract and structure information from large volumes of unstructured documents. * Develop reliable backend services and systems that support document processing and AI\-powered products. * Work with engineers and data scientists to integrate AI technologies into production systems. * Improve the performance, reliability, and scalability of our systems as we grow. * Build tools and infrastructure that help teams develop, evaluate, and operate AI\-powered systems. * Participate in the full project lifecycle, from design and implementation to testing, deployment, and iteration. * Collaborate with product, engineering, data science, and machine learning teams to solve complex problems. * Learn new technologies and contribute to the evolution of our AI platform. ### **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science. * Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented programming. * Proficiency in at least one programming language. * Experience building software through internships, co\-ops, academic projects, personal projects, or other practical experience. * Strong problem\-solving skills and an ability to break down complex problems. * Curiosity about AI and interest in applying AI to real\-world problems. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. * Eagerness to learn, take ownership, and grow as an engineer. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience building backend systems or applications that work with large volumes of information. * Experience working with unstructured data such as documents, text, or images. * Familiarity with AI, LLMs, machine learning, or natural language processing. * Experience with cloud infrastructure, databases, APIs, testing, or system performance. **Benefits \& Perks:** As part of our total rewards package, we offer attractive benefits and perks to our employees, including: * Choice of medical, dental, and vision insurance plans for you and your family. * Additional insurance coverage options for life, accident, or critical illness. * Flexible paid time off, sick leave, short\-term and long\-term disability. * 10 US observed holidays, and Canadian statutory holidays by province. * A home office stipend. * 401(k) for US\-based employees and RRSP for Canada\-based employees. * Paid parental leave. * A local in\-person meet\-up program. * Hubs in San Francisco and Toronto. *(Please note the above benefits \& perks are for full\-time employees)* ***Notice to We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* Compensation Range: $130K

jobs.title: Finance Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Join Formlabs if you want to bring ground\-breaking professional 3D printers to the desktop of every designer, engineer, researcher, and artist in the world. The Finance Systems team owns the enterprise systems used to record, process, and report financial data across Formlabs. We're looking for a Finance Systems Engineer who is equally comfortable writing code to automate and interconnect our finance stack and administering those systems day\-to\-day — owning the configuration, access, and operational health that keep NetSuite and Coupa running as a compliant, efficient source of truth. This is a hands\-on role for someone who wants to both build (scripting, integrations, automation) and operate (privileged administration, BaU configuration, security). If you're as happy shipping a SuiteScript integration as you are provisioning a role, tuning an approval workflow, or debugging a failed PO sync, this is the role for you. **Build \& Integrate** * Design, develop, and ship customizations and integrations across **NetSuite, Coupa, and related financial systems (such as Adaptive, Avalara, or future custom\-built tools)** * Build and maintain integrations between finance systems and the wider landscape\- Shopify, Salesforce, the data warehouse, and middleware/iPaaS — using REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, and event\-driven patterns. * Automate reconciliations, data syncs, and reporting pipelines so that procurement, invoicing, sales, GL, and revenue data flow accurately across platforms in near real time. * Write SQL and saved searches to power reporting that pulls from multiple sources and aligns with finance and business needs. * Apply modern engineering practices\- version control, code review, testing, and clear documentation\- to deliver maintainable, well\-documented solutions. **Administer \& Operate** * Serve as a **privileged administrator** for NetSuite and Coupa, owning day\-to\-day system health, configuration, and change management. * Manage user provisioning and deprovisioning, roles, permissions, and periodic access/security reviews to enforce least\-privilege and support audit and audit and internal controls. * Configure and maintain custom fields, records, forms, workflows, approval routing, and notifications as business processes evolve. * Own saved searches, reports, dashboards, and KPIs; keep the reporting layer accurate and self\-serve for finance stakeholders. * Procurement approval chains and limits, content and account groups, supplier onboarding/SIM, and PO/invoice/expense configuration. * Manage sandbox refreshes, release\-preview and version testing, feature enablement, and bundle/SuiteApp management. * Support period closes by maintaining subsidiary, tax, and entity configuration, and by monitoring integration error queues, audit logs, and data integrity across systems. * Own license and subscription management, and act as the first line of triage for system issues, partnering with vendors and internal teams to resolve them. **You:** * A university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years in finance systems engineering, ERP administration, or systems integration. * Hands\-on, demonstrable experience with **NetSuite** (both SuiteScript development *and* administration) and **Coupa**. * Proven ability to manage system integrations using APIs and/or middleware tools. * Ability to write SQL from scratch and comfort with reporting and data\-warehouse concepts. * Strong understanding of finance, procurement, and accounting workflows. * A pragmatic problem\-solver with excellent communication skills, willing to wear many hats and jump in wherever needed to deliver outcomes. **Bonus Points:** * NetSuite certifications (SuiteFoundation, Administrator, or SuiteScript Developer) and/or Coupa administration experience. * Experience with additional finance/business systems (Salesforce, Shopify, Avalara/AvaTax, or similar) and iPaaS middleware. * Ability to effectively leverage AI coding and tooling. * Experience in a fast\-paced, high\-growth company that manufactures and sells physical products. **Our Perks \& Benefits:** * Robust equity program to build future wealth through RSUs * Comprehensive healthcare coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision) * Low cost fund options in our 401K and access to advisors * Generous paid Parental Leave (up to 16 weeks) * Tenure\-based paid Sabbatical Leave (up to 6 weeks) * Flexible Out of Office Plan – Take time when you need it * Ample free on\-site parking \& pre\-tax commuter benefits * Healthy on\-site lunches, snacks, beverages, \& treats * Regular sponsored professional development opportunities * Many opt\-in culture events across our diverse community * And of course… unlimited 3D prints

jobs.title: Lead Robotics Software Systems Engineer
jobs.description: We are Fresh. Together let’s build the future. With partners and clients, we practice strategy, design, development, and engineering to harness the power of technology and create what’s next. Our cross\-disciplinary approach blends human ingenuity and technology, empowering us to meet uncertainty with confidence. What got us to today won’t get us to tomorrow, so we test our assumptions and always strive for growth. From the products we build to the partners we collaborate with, we believe people make the difference. And we do so as a workforce representative of the communities we serve, understanding that a diverse workforce strengthens our organization. We value diversity and support a positive and welcoming environment where all of our employees can thrive. **What are we looking for?** We seek a highly skilled and motivated Systems Engineer with deep software expertise to join our robotics team. In this role, you will own the software system design for our client projects and programs, spanning the software that runs on the robot through the cloud services that operate fleets in the field. You will be the face of Fresh while partnering alongside the TPM (Technical Project Manager) and the rest of the engineering, design, and strategic delivery team. You will play a critical role in ensuring successful project execution, on\-time delivery, and quality performance of multi\-disciplinary robotics programs where the software architecture carries the majority of the product risk. **What will you be doing?** A Systems Engineer in the Fresh Robotics organization is a pivotal player in driving large, integrated software and hardware projects. This position emphasizes the software side of that portfolio. You will define how a system is structured across embedded and edge compute, the robotics middleware and autonomy stack, connectivity, and the cloud and data platform that supports a deployed fleet. Fluency in the hardware realities underneath that stack remains essential, including compute selection, sensor interfaces, and the manufacturing and service constraints that shape what the software can assume. A Fresh Systems Engineer has a high degree of expertise in understanding how to help lead multi\-disciplinary teams. This includes supporting strategy and delivery of key product development phases across the scope, definition, engineering, and design phases of complex hardware and software innovation products. A Systems Engineer has experience communicating with clients to understand the key business drivers and problems being solved by the product and project, while considering the long term goals of the client and how we best fit within their roadmap. Our programs involve deploying in the real world at scale, which means the software decisions made early carry through to field reliability, serviceability, and the cost of every update that follows. The methodology for building these systems continues to evolve, and we have adapted alongside it. Across our programs you will encounter classical automation and scripted behaviors, purpose\-trained models, and learned policies, and part of this role is guiding clients toward the approach best suited to their requirements. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Leadership:** * Act as a technical point of contact for clients, including regular updates on project progress and addressing any technical and product development plan concerns. Work closely with the project management team. * Keep an eye on the big\-picture project and client\-product direction, team needs, and dependencies while understanding the detailed work plans of the contributing teams. * Partner with the Technical Project Manager to develop and maintain project schedules, resource plans, and budgets to meet project objectives. * Proactively identify and mitigate risks, resolving technical and programmatic issues as they arise. Work directly with the delivery team and the client to build solutions. * Provide the technical interface between the client and the delivery team. **Software System Lead:** * Coordinate and lead the software architecture for client projects across the full stack, including embedded firmware, edge compute, robotics middleware, connectivity, and cloud services. * Define the software system decomposition and the interfaces between subsystems, establishing how autonomy, application logic, device management, and data services fit together. * Define system requirements, specifications, and performance metrics covering latency, throughput, availability, and update cadence. Ensure they are met throughout the development process. * Establish the fleet and data architecture supporting OTA updates, telemetry, remote diagnostics, and observability across deployed units. * Guide build and release strategy, including CI/CD, simulation\-in\-the\-loop and hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing, versioning across mixed fleets, and staged rollout. * Advise on the suitability of learned an ather than as a later addition. **Team Collaboration:** * Coordinate project activities and resources by working closely with project managers, strategists, industrial designers, engineers, and other team members. * Partner with hardware, electrical, and mechanical leads so that software architecture decisions and hardware selection inform one another throughout development. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to team members, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment. * Support the project estimation team in evaluating new opportunities and providing technical and timeline input. **Skills and Qualifications** ----------------------------- * Bachelors or advanced degree in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience developing software for products that ship, with significant experience as an individual contributor and subject matter expert. * 3\+ years of leadership experience in a software architecture or system design role for connected hardware, robotics, or embedded products. * Demonstrated depth across multiple layers of the stack, such as embedded or edge software, robotics middleware, and cloud or backend services. * Strong proficiency in the languages common to this work, including C\+\+ and Python, with the judgment to evaluate designs and code produced by the team. * Experience with ROS or ROS 2 and the architecture of autonomy stacks, including how perception, planning, and control interact. * Experience with connected device and fleet architecture, covering OTA update mechanisms, telemetry pipelines, and remote diagnostics. * Proficiency with modern software delivery practices, including Git workflows, containerization, CI/CD, and automated testing. * Experience with system architecture, integration, and validation across hardware and software boundaries. * Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to interface with clients effectively and explain technical tradeoffs to business stakeholders. * Proficiency with industry\-standard project management tools and methodologies. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Experience delivering multiple large\-scale industrial, enterprise, or consumer\-facing products successfully, on schedule, and on budget. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience in a consulting, agency, or client\-facing product development environment. * Proven experience in Product Management or Product Ownership. * Familiarity with applied AI in robotics, including computer vision pipelines, vision foundation models, or learned policies, and the judgment to assess where each is appropriate. * Experience with simulation and sim\-to\-real workflows using tools such as Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, or Gazebo. * Experience with real\-time or deterministic systems programming and the constraints of safety\-relevant software. * Familiarity with functional safety and regulatory frameworks relevant to robotics and connected devices, such as ISO 13849, ISO 10218, IEC 62443, or UL 3300\. * Experience with cloud platforms and IoT services, including MQTT and device management at fleet scale. * Experience with edge compute platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, and the tradeoffs of deploying software to constrained hardware. * Experience building and operating systems that remain serviceable and supportable years after deployment. * Experience leading or mentoring engineering teams in a professional or consulting context. Equal employment opportunity: All qualified persons will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, familial status, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability for which a reasonable accommodation can be made, or any other status protected by law. Assistance will be gladly provided upon request for any applicant with sensory or non\-sensory disabilities. * Fresh Consulting is an E\-Verify participating company

jobs.title: Product Quality Engineer II
jobs.description: Position Overview: Position is located in our Lebanon, NH Office. The Product Quality Engineer II is a fully qualified, career\-level individual contributor with combined responsibility for New Product Introduction (NPI) quality and sustaining Product Quality. The role serves as the Quality representative from product development, qualification, and design transfer through production release, volume manufacturing, customer support, and continuous improvement. The engineer partners with Engineering, Program Management, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, and customers to ensure that product and process risks are identified and controlled, requirements are translated into effective manufacturing controls, processes are capable and ready for release, and production quality performance is sustained. The engineer leads data\-driven problem solving, manufacturing quality improvement, product and process qualification, launch readiness, nonconformance management, and corrective action and may mentor junior engineers and technicians. Company Overview: At FUJIFILM Dimatix Inc., printing and material deposition devices are only as good as their printheads. We are a recognized leader in the manufacturing and design of durable and productive drop\-on\-demand inkjet printheads that power cutting\-edge systems, as well as integrated inkjet solutions that add digital inkjet capabilities to other equipment. These are part of the digitization and transformation of many applications such as commercial printing, graphics, label \& packaging, additive manufacturing, ceramic tiles, textiles, electronics and life science research. We’re looking for forward\-thinkers eager to spark innovation in inkjet technology. Bring your talents to a team built on collaboration, creativity, and a passion for excellence. At FUJIFILM Dimatix, every product we make begins with the extraordinary people behind it. Join us for groundbreaking work in a flexible, engaging environment. We’re based in two incredible locations: Lebanon, New Hampshire, surrounded by picturesque New England landscapes, and Santa Clara, California, a dynamic hub in Silicon Valley with a mix of innovation, diversity, and sunshine. Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers Job Description: **KNOWLEDGE** A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career\-oriented, journey\-level position. **JOB COMPLEXITY** Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise. **SUPERVISION** Normally receives little instruction on day\-to\-day work, general instructions on new assignments. **EXPERIENCE** Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 3 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD without experience; or equivalent work experience. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** ========================================= **NPI AND DESIGN TRANSFER** --------------------------- * Serve as the Quality lead or core team representative for NPI programs from concept and design transfer through prototype, qualification, pilot builds, production release, and post\-launch stabilization. * Partner with Design Engineering, Process Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Program Management to define NPI quality objectives, deliverables, acceptance criteria, risks, and readiness requirements. * Lead or support NPI quality planning, including quality plans, DFMEA/PFMEA linkage, control plans, inspection strategies, measurement\-system analysis, capability studies, process validation, and product qualification activities. * Participate in phase and gate reviews and provide an independent Quality assessment of product and process readiness, open risks, containment needs, and release recommendations. * Ensure critical\-to\-quality characteristics and customer requirements are translated into drawings, specifications, supplier controls, manufacturing controls, test methods, and acceptance criteria. * Support prototype, engineering, qualification, and pilot builds by establishing data\-collection plans, reviewing build results, driving issue resolution, and confirming closure of quality\-related launch actions. * Coordinate objective evidence required for design transfer and production release, including validation records, first\-article results, capability evidence, control plans, work instructio ed** ------------ * Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, quality, or a related technical field and at least 5 years of related experience; or a master's degree and at least 3 years of related experience; or a PhD; or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * Demonstrated experience supporting both NPI or design\-transfer activities and sustaining manufacturing quality in a product\-development and production environment. * Demonstrated ability to lead complex root cause and corrective\-action efforts to effective, sustainable closure. * Working knowledge of manufacturing and product quality methods, including FMEA, control plans, verification and validation, Cpk/Cp, SPC, DOE, process data analysis, 8D, and DMAIC. * Ability to independently define problems, collect and analyze data, evaluate multiple contributing factors, draw valid conclusions, and implement practical changes. * Ability to work effectively across Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supplier Quality, customers, and suppliers. * Strong written, verbal, presentation, and technical\-reporting skills. * Experience directing or coordinating laboratory, test, or technical work. * Proficiency with Minitab or equivalent statistical software and Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Project or equivalent project\-planning tools. **Preferred** ------------- * Knowledge of ISO 9001 and other applicable international quality\-management\-system standards. * Experience supporting regulated, high\-reliability, or medical\-device\-related products and customers. * Experience supporting NPI, design transfer, production readiness, qualification builds, and launch stabilization in a cross\-functional product\-development environment. * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer, Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence, or equivalent certification. * Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. * Experience with field failure analysis, reliability testing, and Weibull or other life\-data analysis. * Experience with SolidWorks, test automation, data\-acquisition systems, or reliability\-analysis software. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT** ========================================= * Ability to work safely in office, cleanroom, laboratory, assembly, test, and manufacturing environments and to perform the functions associated with applicable manufacturing and test processes. * Ability to use standard office and laboratory equipment and to move between work areas as needed. * Occasional travel may be required. * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **GENERAL EXPECTATIONS** ======================== * Ensure that quality, delivery, cost, and safety objectives within the employee’s control meet or exceed internal and external customer requirements. * Comply with the Employee Handbook and applicable site rules, procedures, training requirements, and safety expectations. * Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records in accordance with applicable document\- and record\-control requirements. **FUJIFILM Dimatix provides competitive wages, a generous benefits package, and a friendly, dynamic working environment.** Equal Opportunity Employer: M/F/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities Fujifilm Dimatix, Inc. participates in E\-Verify. EEO Information: Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc. ADA Information: If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR Department (fdmxbenefits@fujifilm.com).

jobs.title: Technical Co-founder (CTO)
jobs.description: ### **The Opportunity** FutureSight is seeking an applied AI builder to co\-found and lead the technical direction of a new B2B AI venture from the ground up. This is a co\-founder partnership with founder\-level equity and founder\-level authority, not a salaried executive role. We are not looking for someone who manages engineers from a distance or adds AI language to a traditional CTO resume. We are looking for someone who can take a vague problem, frame it clearly, design the right system, and turn it into something customers actually use and trust. If you've gone from ambiguity to working product before — and you want to do it again with the backing of an experienced venture building team — this is the opportunity. This is a full\-time, exclusive commitment to building and owning a single B2B AI venture from the ground up. ### **About FutureSight** FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co\-creates world\-class software companies with values\-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale. You'll co\-create with a proven venture building team, including: * John Carbrey – 4x founder, bootstrapped to $100M ARR * Joshua Auslander – Seasoned CFO and strategic advisor with $200M aggregate exits * Alan Smith – Globally recognized early stage validation expert, 24 products launched, an exit, 5M\+ books sold * Prathna Ramesh – Early\-stage investor and capital strategy advisor ### **The Partnership** * Founder\-level equity with meaningful ownership from inception, aligned across funding rounds * Founder\-level authority, including co\-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy * Pre\-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow\-on funding * A proven process and playbook for taking ventures from 0 to 1, informed by our team's prior experience and mistakes * Venture building and scaling resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one * Investor and advisor network across B2B AI and early\-stage capital markets * A true co\-creation model in which you operate as CTO with FutureSight's cross\-functional team as your partner — building alongside you. ### **What you'll own** As Co\-Founder \& CTO, you will set the venture's technical direction and lead its execution. This is a co\-founder role, not a CTO hire. * Technical Direction — Own problem framing, architecture, system design, and product judgment from day one, translating rough product intent into structure, context, and specs that both humans and AI systems can execute against * Build — Use modern tools and frontier models to move fast without sacrificing quality or maintainability, designing agentic systems with first\-principles thinking and knowing when orchestration adds genuine leverage versus when simplicity is the better call * Customer \& Market — Be the primary technical voice in early customer conversations, understanding real workflows and shaping the right product rather than just shipping quickly * Traction Before Scale — Prove there is something worth scaling before thinking about scaling it, focusing on traction first and team\-building second * Capital — Contribute to fundraising, from investor conversations to due diligence * Team — Recruit and grow a technical team when the time is right, and establish the cultural foundation of the company ### **Co\-Founder Profile** * Proven track record of shipping AI products to real users under real\-world constraints — not research, experiments, or prototypes * Deep practical experience with frontier models, LLM\-based systems, and agentic architectures, with strong system design instincts and a bias for simplicity and maintainability * Strong translation layer skills — able to turn messy product intent into clear structure, constraints, and specs that both humans and AI systems can act on * Close to the customer, comfortable in customer conversations, and able to let real workflows shape what you build * Rigorous about verification — feedback loops, evaluation, and systems that can be trusted * Prior experience as a technical co\-founder or early engineering leader, with fundraising experience a strong plus * Founder at heart — energized by ambiguity, able to go far alone, and ready to commit fully ### **How to Apply** Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate. FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

observability—metrics, distributed tracing, structured logging, and alerting—and lead post\-incident reviews that drive systemic improvement. * Collaborate with product, engineering, operations, and business partners to translate needs into technical designs and deliver measurable outcomes. * Use AI coding assistants daily (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude) to accelerate design, enjoys helping others grow in architecture, Java/cloud\-native engineering, AI\-assisted workflows, and operational excellence. * An innovative thinker who explores new approaches and applies them jobs.title: Senior Controls and Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** GEMCO is seeking a Senior Controls and Automation Engineer to lead the design, programming, integration, and commissioning of automation systems for custom industrial mixing, blending, drying, and material processing equipment. This position will play a critical role in developing machine control systems that support our customers' manufacturing operations across pharmaceutical, food, chemical, additive manufacturing, and specialty materials industries. The successful candidate will work closely with mechanical engineers, project managers, manufacturing personnel, and customers to develop reliable, user\-friendly automation solutions from concept through startup. This role requires a hands\-on engineer who can balance technical expertise, project execution, and customer interaction while supporting both new equipment and retrofit projects. **About GEMCO** For more than a century, GEMCO has designed and manufactured industry\-leading tumble blenders, dryers, vacuum drying systems, and custom powder processing equipment. Our reputation is built on engineering excellence, innovative solutions, and long\-term customer partnerships. We specialize in delivering custom\-engineered systems that improve process efficiency, product quality, and operational reliability. **Key Responsibilities** **Controls System Design \& Development** * Design complete control systems for industrial processing equipment and integrated production systems. * Develop PLC, HMI, and SCADA applications to support machine operation, process control, recipe management, and data collection. * Create functional specifications, control narratives, and machine operating sequences. * Develop and maintain control system standards that promote consistency, scalability, and maintainability. * Evaluate and implement emerging automation technologies to improve machine performance and customer value. * Work with customers to develop specifications and expectations. **Electrical \& Controls Engineering** * Develop: * I/O lists * Electrical schematics * Network architecture drawings * Control panel layouts * Instrumentation specifications * Alarm and fault management strategies * Specify and integrate instrumentation, drives, motors, sensors, load cells, safety devices, and process equipment. * Support panel design and review electrical drawings for compliance with applicable codes and standards. **Programming \& Integration** * Program and troubleshoot PLC\-based control systems. * Develop HMI interfaces that provide intuitive operator interaction and system diagnostics. * Configure industrial communications networks and integrate third\-party equipment. * Support database connectivity, reporting systems, and production data acquisition where required. * Collaborate with OEM suppliers and customers during integration activities. **Project Execution** * Participate in project planning, budgeting, scheduling, and execution. * Coordinate controls\-related activities with internal teams, vendors, and customers. * Support procurement and technical review of automation hardware and software. * Ensure controls deliverables are completed on schedule and within project requirements. **Testing \& Commissioning** * Develop and execute Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT). * Lead machine startup and commissioning activities at customer facilities. * Perform troubleshooting, loop checks, functional testing, and system validation. * Provide operator and maintenance training following installation. **Customer Support \& Continuous Improvement** * Assist customers with troubleshooting, upgrades, and system improvements. * Support retrofit and modernization projects for existing GEMCO equipment. * Document lessons learned and incorporate improvements into future designs. * Help develop standardized automation platforms across product lines. **Safety \& Compliance** * Design systems that comply with applicable electrical, machine safety, and industry standards. * Participate in machine risk assessments and safety system reviews. * Support implementation of safe machine operation and maintenance practices. **Required Qualifications** **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. **Experience** * 10 years of experience in industrial automation, controls engineering, machine design, or manufacturing systems. * Experience supporting custom machinery, OEM equipment, or process manufacturing environments. * Proven experience managing projects from design through commissioning. **Technical Skills** * Strong experience with: * Allen\-Bradley ControlLogix and CompactLogix platforms * Siemens PLC platforms * FactoryTalk View, WinCC, Ignition, or comparable HMI software * Knowledge of industrial communication protocols including: * Ethernet/IP * Profinet * Modbus TCP/RTU * OPC\-UA * Experience with: * Variable frequency drives (VFDs) * Motion control systems * Industrial instrumentation * Safety circuits and machine safeguarding * Familiarity with SQL databases and industrial data collection systems. * Ability to read and create electrical schematics and control documentation. **Professional Skills** * Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. * Customer\-focused mindset with strong interpersonal skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with powder processing, blending, drying, pharmaceutical, food, or chemical manufacturing equipment. * Knowledge of batch process control systems. * Familiarity with UL 508A panel design requirements. * Experience with validation protocols including FAT, SAT, IQ, and OQ documentation. * Exposure to Industry 4\.0 technologies, remote diagnostics, and predictive maintenance systems. **Travel Requirements** * Ability to travel approximately 40–50% for customer meetings, equipment startup, commissioning, and service support. **Why Join GEMCO?** * Work on highly engineered custom equipment used by leading manufacturers worldwide. * Influence automation strategy across an established and growing product portfolio. * Participate in projects from concept through installation and customer acceptance. * Join a collaborative engineering team with a long history of innovation and technical excellence. * Opportunity for professional growth, leadership, and direct impact on company success. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Education: * Associate (Required) Experience: * Mechanical Knowledge: 5 years (Required) * Programmable Logic Controllers: 10 years (Required) * Electrical troubleshooting: 10 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer 3
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Join Seerist, a leading provider of AI\-driven, augmented analytics for threat and risk intelligence, designed to help commercial organizations and government anticipate, monitor, and manage global risks. Seerist delivers real\-time insights, forecasts, and alerts that bring clarity to decisions and save valuable time for security and intelligence teams. Every day, Seerist helps our customers support their operations and missions globally, ensuring informed, rapid decisions. **About the Role** You will join the Seerist software engineering team to build and evolve the core of our intelligence platform: the TypeScript applications, APIs, and search experiences that analysts and customers rely on every day, and the AI\-driven features that are changing how they work. We are looking for a creative engineer who values simplicity. You look for the plain solution to a hard problem, you leave the codebase easier to understand than you found it, and you work within an established architecture instead of adding complexity for its own sake. You will own work end to end, from scoping and implementation through rollout and production support. You will also help us tell the AI advances that matter from the hype, because you build with them. #### **Technical Skills** Simplicity \& Creativity: Favors the simplest design that solves the problem; brings creative thinking to product and technical problems and can explain the tradeoffs behind a choice TypeScript: Strong experience across frontend and backend systems Frontend: Vue 3 / Nuxt experience, ideally with large production applications Backend \& APIs: Node.js backend/API development; experience designing and maintaining REST APIs and OpenAPI contracts; AdonisJS familiarity is a plus Search \& Geospatial: Experience with search\-heavy applications, geospatial data, or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch is a plus Engineering Discipline: Strong testing and code\-review discipline; able to work within an established architecture rather than introducing unnecessary complexity Ownership: Comfortable owning work end\-to\-end, including scoping, implementation, rollout, and production support Building with LLMs: Hands\-on experience building with LLMs, tool use, agents, structured outputs, retrieval, and multi\-step workflows Agent Systems: Familiar with agent orchestration, tool calling, memory/context strategies, evals, guardrails, and failure handling AI Judgment: Keeps a strong pulse on emerging AI models, agentic patterns, and tooling; evaluates new model classes and frameworks on real tradeoffs in quality, latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability; regularly experiments and can separate useful advances from hype Shipped Work: Portfolio or meaningful examples of shipped production work **What Seerist Offers:** * An opportunity to be a part of a fast\-moving organization with cutting edge technology * A culture that is dynamic, diverse, trust\-centered, and open to bold ideas * Competitive salary, bonus plan, 401(k) matching, and long\-term incentives * Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, and life plans * A flexible and fun work environment that values work\-life balance * Hybrid position with 3 days in Reston office per week and flexibility to work onsite as the program requires * Unlimited PTO * Up to 16 Weeks Paid Parental Leave * Tuition Reimbursement * Professional Development Stipend Based in the greater Washington, DC metro area, in our Reston office three days per week, with the flexibility to work on site as the program requires Seerist is an equal opportunity employer. Seerist does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, non\-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. \#SF

We've developed a groundbreaking, vision\-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real\-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error\-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on\-time, in full" delivery. If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time. **About the Team** You'll join the fullstack and WMS integration teams at a pivotal moment: live systems, real enterprise customers, and a platform being deliberately re\-engineered from growth\-era tradeoffs into a durable, enterprise\-grade foundation. The team owns everything from customer\-facing integrations to the core services and data layer beneath them, and works in close partnership with product, security, and customer success to turn ambiguous requirements into dependable, well\-architected systems. **About the Role** Most staff engineering roles ask you to choose between architecture and code, or between engineering and customers. This one doesn't. As a **Senior/Staff FullStack Engineer,** you'll set the technical direction for how Gather AI's platform integrates with the world, while staying hands\-on with the code, infrastructure, and Kubernetes clusters that run it. You'll lead the shift from ad hoc, growth\-era integration patterns to enterprise\-grade standards, elevate a live customer\-facing solution alongside the engineer already driving it, and become the single US\-based point of contact who turns customer requirements into shipped, scoped engineering work. This is a hybrid role based at our Pittsburgh, PA headquarters. **What You'll Do** * Architect and build across distributed systems, APIs, integrations, and infra shipping your own code with performance, fault\-tolerance, and horizontal scale as first\-class design concerns. * Own the platform's non\-functional bar by setting explicit targets for scalability, reliability, availability, latency, performance, security, and observability, and holding the full stack to them. * Partner with team members on multiple projects like MHEV, Drone and 3DCC to elevate and deliver solutions in technical design and take new requirements to production at high SDLC standards (testable, observable, well\-scaled, tuned DB access). * Decompose overloaded APIs into well\-bounded services and introduce data\-access abstractions that control DB connections and improve scalability. * Retire reliability and compliance debt (e.g., PostgreSQL upgrades), stand up production observability metrics and alerts, and reduce delivery friction with CI/CD and AI\-assisted delivery. * Serve as the US\-based single point of contact for fullstack work, partnering with Customer Success to turn customer requirements into clear, well\-scoped engineering. * Mentor senior engineers and raise the bar on engineering practices across backend and infrastructure. **What You'll Need** * 6\+ years building and operating production software, with a track record of taking large, stateful systems to enterprise\-grade scale and reliability * Deep hands\-on experience with Python, Go and Node.js, PostgreSQL at production scale, and Kubernetes on Azure, from architecture through independent production debugging * Depth in APIs and integrations across internal service\-to\-service and external partner integrations: REST, protobuf, messaging, and OAuth, plus secure integration protocols across HTTP, SFTP, email, and IPSec, designed for resilience and secure data exchange * Deep grasp of non\-functional design: scalability, availability and failure modes, latency budgets, caching, and security as first\-class concerns, not afterthoughts * Solid, hands\-on CI/CD: building and owning automated build, test, and deployment pipelines that make delivery fast and safe * Production\-grade observability: instrumenting logs, metrics, and traces, and using them (with SLIs/SLOs and incident response) to keep systems healthy * Practical AI\-assisted engineering, using tools such as Claude across the SDLC with sensible guardrails * Establishing best practices that raise team's engineering standard * Comfortable running customer\-facing technical conversations and translating ambiguous requirements into scoped engineering work * Prior direct customer\-facing experience is not required, but candidates must demonstrate confidence and readiness to join customer calls when needed \- troubleshooting issues, explaining API integration capabilities, etc. **Nice to Have** * Domain jobs.title: Construction Inspector
jobs.description: Gedeon GRC Consulting is looking for a Construction Inspector to join our firm. The Construction Inspector is responsible and accountable for ensuring that all assigned operations are performed according to applicable standards and specifications, and to good construction practices. This position is the quality assurance of the methods of construction employed by the contractor and subcontractor including the materials incorporated. **SALARY RANGE:** $46\.00 \- $63\.00 per hour. Pay commensurate with experience. **LOCATION:** Based on Project Assignment. **BENEFITS:** 90% Company contribution towards all Health Insurance Plans, 401K Match, PTO, Bonus Potential, 10 Paid Company Holidays, and much more. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** ❖ Participate in meetings and respond to any inquiries concerning the inspections on the project. ❖ Prepare reports on project status, problems encountered, and overall results. ❖ Check grades, backfill component and other features of the construction and ensure these components adhere to project specifications. ❖ Report any complaints concerning issues about grading, dust control, drainage, accidents, hazardous or unsafe conditions and come up with resolutions to the complaint and advise Resident Engineers of complaints and plans for resolutions. ❖ Review any relevant specifications, standards, and Infrastructure's Standard Construction Operation Procedures (SCOP's). ❖ Inspect material prior to installation and verify appropriate certifications and/or lab reports have been submitted. ❖ Ensure workmanship and installed work conform to the plans and applicable specifications, standards, SCOP's, shop drawings and other submittals. ❖ Perform material sampling and required testing. ❖ Direct the contractor to rectify all areas of non\-compliance regarding safety, maintenance of traffic and maintenance of site. ❖ Maintain records of work performed daily including location, work force employed, equipment utilized, materials incorporated and pertinent measurements on the appropriate DDC Standard Record forms and in Site Manager. ❖ Record accidents, property damage and unusual conditions and all utility interferences and crossings. ❖ Maintain pile\-driving records. ❖ Report potential or developing conditions which may lead to extra work, claims, or which may in any way impact the community, the public, or property. ❖ All other duties as assigned. **QUALIFICATIONS:** ❖ Ability to become thoroughly familiar with contract requirements, site conditions, and special provisions including all relevant standards, requirements and stipulations. ❖ ASCE Grade II or NICET Grade III required. ❖ ACI certification required. ❖ OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 preferred. ❖ Bachelor's degree (BS or BA) in Engineering or Construction Management. ❖ 3 years of experience with construction inspection and management on infrastructure construction projects (highway/sewer/water) or High School diploma or GED and 10 years of experience in construction inspection or management of infrastructure construction projects (highway/sewer/water). ❖ Understanding of the agency's policies, procedures, and Infrastructure's Standard Construction Operating Procedures (SCOP's). ❖ Knowledge of the Construction Industry dealing with state and local agencies in New York on projects dealing with construction or repair of highways, bridges, tunnels, other structures. ❖ Strong knowledge of business and management principles involved in resource allocation and the coordination of people and resources. ❖ Extremely organized and detailed oriented, with the ability to maintain accuracy while handling multiple requests in a growing company environment. ❖ Ability to establish and maintain satisfactory working relationships with associates, contractors and the public. ❖ Proficiency in Site Manager, AutoCAD, and other project management software. ❖ Knowledge of Microsoft Office.

jobs.title: Sr Data Scientist (Operations Research)
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next. At General Mills, data helps us make better decisions and create food people love. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will work on challenging, large\-scale projects with significant business impact. You will challenge historical assumptions, translate business needs into analytical solutions, and recommend new ways to drive action through data\-driven insights. In this role, you will apply expertise in optimization, simulation, machine learning, and information retrieval to design, prototype, and build next\-generation advanced analytics engines and services. You will collaborate with product owners, business partners, AI engineers, and other Data Scientists to define technical problem statements, test hypotheses, and develop efficient, accurate analytical models that support business decisions. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Partner with data science leadership, AI engineering, business partners, and product owners to develop optimization models using leading tools and technologies. * Provide data science leadership within a product team through strong partnership, actionable insights, and strategic and tactical technical roadmap recommendations. * Design and develop modeling frameworks and architectures for deterministic and combinatorial optimization, advanced machine learning, and other complex business problems. * Build production\-ready, reusable, large\-scale or scalable operations research models that deliver real\-time insights and align with General Mills technology standards. * Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that balance effort, quality, scalability, and business value. * Monitor and improve model performance, optimality, recommendation quality, and other relevant metrics, incorporating feedback from business partners. * Apply critical thinking to frame business needs as statistical or analytical problems and develop solutions that balance technical completeness, complexity, and timely value delivery. * Clearly communicate the why and how behind recommendations to build trust and understanding in analytical solutions. * Advocate for and educate others on the value of data\-driven decision\-making and analytical methods. * Identify and develop long\-term data science processes, frameworks, tools, and standards. Collaborate with other Data Scientists by asking questions, engaging in shared problem\-solving, and actively soliciting and providing feedback. * **Required Qualification** **s** -------------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience working in data science, decision sciences, operations research, or a closely related quantitative field; 3\+ years may be considered for candidates with a PhD. * Master’s or PhD degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science, or a closely related quantitative field. * Strong proficiency in SQL and Python, with a solid understanding of complex databases. * Experience with large\-scale optimization, machine learning, and data visualization. * Strong quantitative and analytical judgment, including the ability to identify questionable data, investigate root causes, and develop practical solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and deliver solutions aligned with business priorities. * **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- Applied experience in business operations, commercial functions, or a related business area. * **Additional Considerations** * Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. General Mills will not sponsor applicants for a U.S. work visa. **SALARY RANGE** The salary range for this position is: $110,800 \- $184,800 Annual At General Mills we strive for each employee's pay at any point in their career to reflect their experiences performance and skills for their current role. The salary range for this role represents the numerous factors considered in the hiring decisions including, but not limited to, educations, skills, work experience, certifications, etc. As such, pay for the successful candidate(s) could fall anywhere within the stated range. Beyond base salary, General Mills offers a competitive Total Rewards package focusing on your overall well\-being. We are proud to offer a foundation of health benefits, retirement and financial wellbeing, time off programs, wellbeing support and perks. Benefits may vary by role, country, region, union status, and other employment status factors. You may also be eligible to participate in an annual incentive program. An incentive award, if any, depends on various factors, including, individual and organizational performance. **ELIGIBILITY** Applicants must meet a minimum 18\-year age qualification. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER (EOE)** General Mills is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital or familial status, status regarding public assistance, or membership or activity in a local human rights commission. **REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION REQUEST** If you need to request an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please fill out our online accommodation request form by following this link: Accommodation Request .

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Machine Learning and AI
jobs.description: **Senior Software Engineer \- Machine Learning and AI** Givelify is a fintech\-for\-good company where brilliant minds come to power the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving app platform. Thanks to over 2 million generous donors, we've helped more than 80,000 nonprofits and places of worship raise over $7\.5 billion. Together, they're changing their world with kindness and generosity. Inc. 5000, the Stevies® Awards, Gartner, Forbes, and many more have recognized our story, innovations, and achievements. Our award\-winning team builds products and experiences that put more good into the world. We love to take on big challenges because we know our work matters. Make an impact at one of the fastest\-growing private companies in the U.S. Be part of a talented team of big\-hearted individuals, earning competitive pay with excellent benefits. **About your role:** As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Givelify, you'll design, build, and ship the models that power real\-time decisions across our giving platform. This includes building systems that allow our donors to experience personalized causes that they can champion and help them become more consistent in their giving journey. You will also work on AI\-based fraud detection and risk\-scoring systems to protect our giving community. You'll own problems end\-to\-end, framing them mathematically, working with large\-scale donor and transaction data, training and evaluating models, and deploying them as reliable, low\-latency production services. Your work directly shapes how millions of donors find and support the causes they love — and protects every dollar they give. **Your team:** You'll join our Research Engineering \& Machine Learning team, a group of world\-class engineers and scientists. This team tackles complex computational, machine learning, and AI problems across Givelify's giving and fintech platforms and products. **The Senior Software Engineer \- Machine Learning and AI will get to:** * Ensure our models operate within our value systems and never recommend that leads our donors to have a bad experience. * Ensure donors easily connect with the organizations and causes that matter most to them. * Help donors become the best version of themselves by helping them realize their desire to become more consistent in their giving. * Own the production reliability and quality of our models. * Maximize product goals while minimizing false positives and negative experiences for our giving community. **To be successful in this role, you'll also:** * Research and prototype computational, statistical, and AI models on real\-world donor datasets for various real\-world problems. * Productize machine learning systems that can generate personalized recommendations for our Donors and help champion their giving journey. * Build AI systems that can consume vast amounts of real\-time data to a diverse class of problems from Engineering Reliability to Fraud Prevention. * Work on a wide array of problems that Machine Learning and AI can be used to solve. * Translate ambiguous product problems into well\-posed ML formulations. Including ranking, classification, and anomaly detection, with clear success metrics and evaluation design. * Build and maintain end\-to\-end ML pipelines: feature engineering on large datasets, training, evaluation, A/B testing, and deployment. * Ship real\-time inference services and work with Platform/DevOps on scalability, latency, and monitoring. * Mentor engineers on ML best practices and raise the team's bar for scientific rigor and code quality. **Your experience:** * **Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or in a STEM field, or equivalent research experience.** * **2\+ years of building and deploying machine learning systems in production,** ideally including at least one system serving hundreds of thousands to millions of users. * Deep grounding in the mathematics behind ML: probability and statistics, linear algebra, optimization; you understand why models work, not just how to call them. * Hands\-on experience across classical ML and deep learning (e.g., gradient\-boosted trees, embedding models, transformers) and knowing when each is the right tool. * Experience with large\-scale data processing (Spark, distributed training, feature stores) and modern ML tooling (PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit\-learn, MLflow or similar). * Track record in one or more of: recommender systems, fraud/risk modeling, search ranking, or real\-time classification. * Research background publications, thesis work, or applied research, translating novel methods into shipped solutions, is a strong plus. **Your superpowers:** * Integrity: Demonstrate congruence in thought, speech, and action. Can be trusted to act with courage and to do the right thing. Problem\-Solving \- Resourceful and creative in solving complex issues. Use sound judgment, data, and collaboration. * Scientific rigor: you insist on sound baselines, honest evaluation, and reproducibility. * Ownership mindset: you carry models from whiteboard to production and stay accountable for their behavior. * Effective Communication \- Communicate frequently using clarity and appropriate methods/tools of communication. * Customer Focus: Adopting a human\-centric approach that meets or anticipates customer needs when developing solutions. **Our culture:** We are a virtual team of award\-winning and high\-performing professionals who innovate and collaborate to fulfill our mission to instantly connect people to causes that matter most to them so they can change their world with kindness and generosity. Our four keys to success \- integrity, heart, simplicity, and wow \- fuel our passion to be recognized among the tech industry's most inclusive and purpose\-driven workplaces. We are steadfast in our conviction to overcome challenges while performing meaningful work alongside some of the most brilliant minds and biggest hearts. It propels our growth as individuals and as a team. We are committed to respecting each other in our workplace, firmly believing diversity is our strength. At the heart of everything we do are our giving community, our donors and our partner organizations. We lean on research and human\-centered design to consistently push the envelope and innovate our products and customer experiences. We take great pride in providing competitive pay, full benefits to help care for you today and in the future, amazing perks (including flexible PTO), and, most importantly, the opportunity to put passion and purpose front and center. **About Givelify** Givelify is the most loved and trusted online and mobile giving platform. Along with its powerful donation management system, it's the fastest\-growing technology for advancing generosity in the world. We instantly connect people to their heart's impulse to do good with award\-winning products and experiences. A global community of over 2 million generous people supports their favorite churches, places of worship, nonprofits, and causes with over $7\.5 billion in donations across more than 80,000 organizations. Givelify leads all giving apps on the App Store and Google Play Store with more than 135,000 verified, authentic reviews with an average 4\.9 out of 5\-star rating. Learn more at Givelify.com. Ready to join the Givelify team? Apply below.

jobs.title: AI Engineer

FULL\-TIME AI Engineer** We are seeking a skilled and motivated AI Engineer to design, build, test, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions that address real business problems. This role is a hands\-on engineering position focused on developing production\-ready AI capabilities, integrating models and agents with enterprise systems, and collaborating with cross\-functional partners to deliver secure, scalable, and responsible AI solutions. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Los Angeles, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience as a data or systems engineer, solutions architect, or pre\-sales consultant. * Experience delivering demos, workshops, or architect overviews to business leaders. * Experience migrating, refactoring, or debugging proprietary or open source workloads. * Experience building data platforms, warehouses, or data lakes, and experience with data programming languages and leveraging agentic platforms. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Practical experience implementing enterprise data/AI governance, metadata management, access control, or lineage tracking across modern catalogs. * Experience designing and deploying enterprise Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, LLM application integrations, or context orchestration frameworks. * Experience with developer advocacy, building internal technical advocate programs, delivering technical enablement, or contributing to open\-source data/AI communities. * Experience applying value\-selling principles to align technical architectures with business outcomes. * Experience in core data science workflows, including proficiency with data manipulation libraries and integrating data pipelines with ML platforms. **About the job** ----------------- As an Agentic Data Cloud Customer Engineer, you will be the premier technical subject matter expert in your territory. jobs.title: Data Center Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5 years of experience in mission\-critical facility design and construction environments. * 5 years of experience in design, construction and commissioning of Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) and mechanical distribution systems, including air and water side systems. * Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to 50% of the time as required. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Master's degree in Engineering, Business, or other relevant fields, or a Professional Engineering (PE) license. * 5 years of experience with mission critical facilities and data centers (multi\-tenant facilities or build\-to\-suit single tenant facilities) in design or construction with project/engineering management. * Experience working with data center equipment and environments (e.g., switchgear, generators, transformers, controls, security monitoring systems, fire safety systems). * Understanding of start up/commissioning processes. **About the job** ----------------- Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department \- cutting\-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state\-of\-the\-art, environmentally\-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements \- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior\-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians. With your technical expertise, you ensure compliance with codes and standards, develop infrastructure improvements and serve as an expert in your specialty (e.g., cooling, electrical). As a Mechanical Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the implementation and operational support of Google’s rapidly expanding data centers. You will be responsible for overseeing the design, construction, and commissioning of complex Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) and mechanical distribution systems, ensuring projects are delivered safely, swiftly, and with high quality. Your role involves managing site\-level mechanical engineering issues, ensuring compliance with design standards and local regulations, supporting quality assurance, and providing technical guidance to vendor teams. You will use your strong communication and collaboration skills who grow on construction sites and has experience with complex mechanical systems, ideally within mission\-critical facilities, heavy industrial, oil and gas, or semiconductor industries. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity.
