assigned tickets in order of SLA. * Serve as the first point of contact for client support requests received through phone, email, and client portal. * Answer inbound support calls, create service tickets, and ensure requests are properly documented, categorized, and prioritized. * Troubleshoot and resolve frontline technical issues efficiently and effectively to minimize disruption to customer operations. * Escalate advanced or unresolved technical issues to Systems Administrators or Systems Engineers following established escalation procedures. * Document all technical work comprehensively to facilitate accurate client billing and ongoing support. *Collaboration, Communication, and Customer Service* * Demonstrate excellent customer service skills with a focus on professionalism, responsiveness, and problem\-solving. * Communicate clearly with clients regarding ticket status, troubleshooting steps, next steps, and resolution details. * Collaborate with Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, and other technical team members to resolve client issues. * Participate in team meetings, training sessions, documentation efforts, and knowledge\-sharing activities. * Follow up with clients and internal team members as needed to support timely issue resolution and a positive client experience. *Technical Support* *\& Documentation* * Provide frontline technical support for end\-user devices, Microsoft 365 applications, and common infrastructure issues, escalating complex issues as appropriate. * Support the configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting of workstations, peripheral devices, and basic server, networking, and cloud technologies under established procedures. * Assist with Microsoft 365 user administration, including account provisioning, password resets, licensing, and basic support for Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint. * Troubleshoot common connectivity issues involving workstations, printers, wireless networks, VPN access, and basic network services, escalating advanced networking issues when necessary. * Support backup verification, endpoint management, documentation, ticketing, remote management, and monitoring tools as part of daily operational activities. * Collaborate with Systems Administrators, Systems Engineers, and other team members to resolve client issues while continuing to develop technical knowledge and skills. * Follow established IT service management processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to deliver consistent, high\-quality support. * Maintain accurate documentation of work performed and contribute to knowledge base articles and SOP updates as appropriate. *Professional Development \& Technical Growth* * Demonstrate curiosity and commitment to continuous learning across Microsoft technologies, networking fundamentals, service delivery, and client support. * Participate in training, coaching, and certification pathways that support continued growth into advanced technical responsibilities. * Leverage approved AI solutions responsibly to accelerate learning, improve troubleshooting efficiency, enhance documentation quality, and support better customer outcomes. * Develop foundational technical knowledge that prepares the employee for potential progression into Systems Administrator responsibilities. **Job Qualifications** *Education/Certification Requirements:* * Associate degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience). * Valid driver’s license. * Entry\-level certifications are preferred. Examples including but not limited to:? + CompTIA A\+ + Google IT Support Professional Certificate + Microsoft Fundamentals certifications + CompTIA Network\+ *Experience Requirements:* * 1\-3 years of experience in technical support, help desk, desktop support, call center technical support, field support, or related IT support roles. * Experience supporting Microsoft operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, basic networking issues, and end\-user technology. * Experience delivering customer\-facing support with a strong focus on professionalism, communication, and service quality. * Experience working within a Managed Services Provider (MSP), consulting, or multi\-client IT support environment is preferred. *Technical Knowledge \& Experience (including, but not limited to):* * Administration and troubleshooting of Windows workstation environments. * Basic Microsoft 365 administration and end\-user support. * Basic Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID user administration. * Basic understanding of Azure cloud concepts and Microsoft cloud services. * Basic networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, wireless connectivity, and general connectivity troubleshooting. * Experience using ticketing systems and remote support tools, including ConnectWise or similar platforms. * Familiarity with endpoint management and remote monitoring tools, including Intune, ConnectWise Automate, or similar technologies. * Familiarity with firewall, wireless, and network support tools, including WatchGuard, Meraki, or similar technologies. * Working knowledge of hardware, printers, mobile devices, peripherals, and workstation deployment.? * Working knowledge of cybersecurity best practices, user security awareness, data privacy, and appropriate handling of client information. * Working knowledge of AI\-assisted productivity and support tools, including Microsoft Copilot, Chat GPT Enterprise, and other approved generative AI solutions. * Ability to leverage AI tools responsibly to improve troubleshooting efficiency, documentation quality, and customer support outcomes. At **Integris**, we value our team members and **offer comprehensive benefits**, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * 401K Retirement Plan * Minimum 4 Weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) * Birthday PTO * Paid Holidays * Paid Time Off for Volunteering * Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Insurance * Life Insurance * Supplemental Insurance * Employee Assistance Program Join us in transforming IT services for small and midsize businesses across regulated industries. Be part of a team that’s scaling nationally, investing in vertical expertise, and **building for better**. *Integris is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, familial status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected class under applicable federal, state, and local laws.* *\#LI\-HYBRID*

jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Come join the Intuit Enterprise Builders team as a Senior Staff Software Engineer. As Intuit expands its footprint in the Mid\-Market and Enterprise segment, you will be part of the group enabling the product to be able to expand into various industries by leveraging AI and relevant technology frameworks. In this role, you will partner closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges that block new customer acquisition and onboarding. You will be crucial in helping Intuit’s largest, most sophisticated customers solve their most pressing business challenges by leveraging the Intuit Enterprise Suite to its full capability and crafting tailored solutions, enabling our partners and clients to thrive in the digitized financial environment. **Responsibilities** * Develop an in\-depth understanding of the Intuit Enterprise Suite architecture, its components, and the business problems it solves. * Evaluate partner and customer technical requirements to design and deliver tailored solutions that integrate seamlessly with their existing systems. * Collaborate with enterprise sales and pre\-sales teams to understand customer requirements and translate them into scalable technical solutions. * Dive deep into system specifications, capacity planning, and technology stacks to ensure the effective and efficient use of Intuit Enterprise Suite. * Identify and solve high\-impact engineering challenges that affect new enterprise customer acquisition and onboarding. * Design and prototype custom or reusable solution patterns to address gaps in product capability or integration. * Lead and facilitate discussions on complex customer deals, system integrations, assessing compatibility, acknowledging limitations, and explaining technical intricacies. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams—including Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Product Management—to translate business needs into robust and scalable technology solutions. * Provide input to Product Management on the most pressing product gaps and roadmap prioritization. * Educate and guide sales teams on technological capabilities and constraints to ensure integrity and trust in customer interactions. * Create documentation, reference architectures, and onboarding playbooks to support repeatability and scale. * Support post\-sale handoff to implementation or customer success teams, ensuring continuity and clarity in the solution architecture. **Qualifications** * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions architecture, or sales engineering roles. * Proficiency in cloud\-based architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP), SaaS platforms, cloud infrastructure and an understanding of container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) * Strong technical background with experience designing and integrating APIs or enterprise software systems. * Experience with programming languages such as Python and Java. * Experience working in cross\-functional environments, especially with product, engineering, and sales teams * Knowledge of enterprise integration patterns, security, scalability, and performance best practices. * Thorough understanding of DevOps, CI/CD methodologies, and agile development practices. * Strong knowledge of API frameworks and microservices architecture. * Exceptional problem\-solving with a hands\-on approach to resolving engineering blockers. * Proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * A proven track record of working with large enterprise customers and leading high\-impact technical projects. * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. Preferred Qualifications: * Prior experience supporting technical sales cycles or solutioning for pre\-sales engagements. * Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Postman, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and CI/CD systems. * Understanding of compliance, data privacy, and industry\-specific requirements (e.g., fintech, construction, etc.). * Experience in B2B or SaaS enterprise environments. * Experience with web services with REST \& GraphQL \& various industry authentication standards. * Knowledge of QuickBooks accounting software is highly desirable. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: New York $220,500 \- $298,000

jobs.title: Digital Education Manager – Network Engineer
jobs.description: * Atlanta, GA, United States / Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Information Technology \& Systems * JOB219474 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. Tier 3 engineering support. * Develop and maintain SailPoint architecture for a large, complex, multi\-bureau federal environment, including appropriate separation and governance of bureau identity and entitlement data. * Architect and oversee SailPoint IdentityIQ workflows, identity lifecycle, provisioning, entitlement governance, recertification, correlation, reporting, and connector health. * identity data and with Splunk/CloudWatch, ITSM, and agency security/monitoring services. * Lead Tier 3 troubleshooting, RCA, connector remediation, architecture reviews, technical documentation, runbooks/SOPs, and Federal workforce knowledge transfer. * Support cybersecurity and authorization activities including NIST 800\-53/RMF, FISMA, FedRAMP High, vulnerability remediation, POA\&M remediation, audit inquiries, and ATO maintenance. * Collaborating with client stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and manage scope, timelines, dependencies, and delivery quality * Provide technical leadership, code/configuration reviews, and mentoring to SailPoint engineers, developers, and administrators. * Support structured knowledge transfer to Federal personnel, including architecture, integrations, workflows, escalation procedures, and operational processes. Position Qualifications/Experience/Education: Required Qualifications: • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field; 10\+ years of IAM/ICAM experience with 7\+ years of deep SailPoint IdentityIQ engineering/architecture experience. • Expert knowledge of SailPoint IdentityIQ architecture, lifecycle workflows, provisioning, certifications/recertifications, roles/entitlements, connectors, correlation, reporting, and integrations. * Experience architecting SailPoint in large federal or comparable enterprise managed\-service environments with complex authoritative sources and application connectors. * Experience with Active Directory/Azure, APIs/integration patterns, ServiceNow/ITSM, cloud\-hosted federal systems, FISMA/RMF, and high\-availability operations. * Ability to lead complex troubleshooting, connector design, data\-quality remediation, technical reviews, and mentoring/knowledge transfer. * SailPoint IdentityIQ technical certification(s) appropriate to senior architecture/engineering responsibilities required or strongly preferred. * Ability to travel 20\-40%, on average, to the DC area based on frequency of client meetings and level of project engagement required. * Treasury Expereince Desired Qualifications: * Recent federal delivery experience integrating SailPoint IdentityIQ in a managed\-service environment. * Experience with large SailPoint IIQ deployments. * Experience with DHS CDM/MUR requirements, AWS GovCloud, Splunk/CloudWatch, MuleSoft, and CyberArk integration. * CISSP, CCSP, or AWS certification. * Experience applying AI\-assisted coding workflows or Model Context Protocol technologies within SailPoint implementations Competencies: * Strong communicator able to work effectively with agency stakeholders, bureau teams, technical teams, and vendors. * Highly organized and outcome\-focused; jobs.title: Support Engineer (TeamCity)
jobs.description: Do you care about keeping developer tools running reliably, enjoy digging into the systems and infrastructure behind them, and know that reliable tools make all the difference for development teams? If you are calm under pressure, enjoy diagnosing complex systems, want to help developers overcome technical hurdles, and thrive on deep problem\-solving across diverse tech stacks, this role is for you. **About JetBrains** We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale. **About TeamCity** TeamCity is a highly scalable CI/CD server that integrates across the modern software ecosystem. Because it supports complex server\-side setups and SaaS deployments, issues can stem from the product itself or the surrounding infrastructure. **What you’ll do** As part of our Support Engineering team, you will act as a crucial link between global engineering teams and our internal product developers. You will take ownership of incoming technical issues, pinpoint root causes, and provide working resolutions or clear escalations. You'll work American\-timezone hours to give our global community timely, effective support. Day to day, you will: * Identify whether an issue stems from the product, infrastructure, or third\-party integrations. * Provide workarounds, submit bug reports, or escalate issues directly to development. * Capture insights and publish solutions following KCS (Knowledge\-Centered Service) principles. * Share user feedback with internal product teams to shape future tool improvements. **What you’ll bring** * A systematic and structured, but flexible approach to troubleshooting complex software and infrastructure issues. * A clear, direct communication style that explains technical details in ways others can understand. * Comfort working independently across distributed teams and time zones. * Curiosity about how different build systems, VCS providers, and clouds operate together. * An inclination to leave documentation and systems better than you found them. **What you’ll need** * Fluency in English, with strong written communication skills. * The ability to work aligned with American time zones. * Practical experience troubleshooting web servers and applications (such as Tomcat and Java\-based environments). * A working knowledge of relational databases (such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MSSQL). * Hands\-on experience with version control tools and hosting platforms (such as Git or Perforce, GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket). * Familiarity with build automation tools (such as Gradle, Maven, or .NET build systems). * An understanding of containerized environments or cloud infrastructure (such as Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, or Azure). **What success looks like** Success in this role means resolving complex support cases efficiently while maintaining clear communication with developers. You build trust by accurately diagnosing underlying infrastructure or application bugs rather than addressing symptoms alone. Over time, your contributions to the knowledge base reduce repeat issues, and your feedback helps product teams make TeamCity more resilient. \#LI\-DNI *This range reflects the employer’s good\-faith estimate of the base salary it reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Starting pay within the range will be determined based on job\-related factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, and work location.* The base salary range (per year) for this position in the posted work location(s) is $144,000 \- $216,000 USD **We are an equal opportunity employer** We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation. *We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the* *Recruitment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: Autonomy Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Joby Advanced Development designs, develops, and flight\-tests novel aircraft using a software\-first autonomy approach. We build and deploy autonomy, perception, planning, and radar systems across conventional, electric, and hydrogen\-electric aircraft in both CTOL and VTOL configurations. **Overview** ------------ Joby Advanced Development is seeking an Autonomy Senior Machine Learning Engineer, to design and build the state\-of\-the\-art perception and reasoning algorithms for our Superpilot™ autonomy stack. This position offers a unique opportunity to enable our aircraft to safely and autonomously navigate their complex environment. In this role, you will design and develop solutions for aircraft autonomy involving perception, navigation, and other applications. You will work closely with other software engineers and AI experts in computer vision, robotics, navigation, and controls. The role requires deep expertise with machine learning algorithms, hands\-on software engineering, and autonomous systems industry experience. You will train perception models and develop robust perception software for autonomous flight. Further, you will also apply a data\-centric approach to creating AI solutions for simulation, mapping, and advanced sensing with cameras, lidars, and radar. Your work will help teams deploy state\-of\-the\-art AI algorithms and systems for autonomous flight on multiple types of aircraft. We are a small, high\-impact team that values curiosity, technical initiative, and the ability to operate independently. You will collaborate deeply with sensing, controls, and flight software engineers to build a foundation that accelerates our path to safe, autonomous flight. The right candidate is a strong autonomy machine learning engineer who cares deeply about system design, software engineering, and enabling fast, safe iteration across multiple aircraft programs. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Autonomy ML Development** + Design, train, and maintain state\-of\-the\-art ML models for perception on autonomous aircraft + Combine deep learning and 3D computer vision techniques for sensor fusion, navigation, and detect\-and\-avoid + Build high\-performance model training pipelines and extensive evaluation systems to ensure reliability and quality * **Autonomy Technical Solutions** + Optimize and tune real\-time AI perception algorithms for autonomous aircraft + Contribute to software development for data management, annotation, and curation + Contribute to autonomy modeling, simulation, and analysis software tooling * Collaborate closely with the rest of the Superpilot™ team to ideate, plan and execute on high\-quality, well\-integrated solutions and features * Monitor system health and performance, proactively addressing issues and providing user support **Required** ------------ * Degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, or related field * 8\+ years of experience in machine learning * Experience in developing software and systems for autonomous vehicles * Strong proficiency in python * Extensive practical knowledge of state\-of\-art models for real\-time perception * Deep understanding of 3D computer vision and machine learning for video * Ability to invent and quickly prototype technical solutions in autonomy * Proven ability to document complex technical designs, architectural trade\-offs, and implementation roadmaps * Champion of software best practices, including rigorous code reviews and mentorship * Excellent communication skills for collaborating with cross\-functional teams **Desired** ----------- * Expert\-level software engineering: deep expertise in architecting and writing clean, scalable, and maintainable code * Professional software development experience with multi\-disciplinary teams in aerospace autonomy * Experience in autonomous vehicle software development * Experience deploying ML models in a production environment using modern MLOps principles and tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow) * Experience in processing aircraft sensors data such as GPS, inertial, ADS\-B, air data, radio data * Experience in ROS2 or related middleware and DDS systems * Competence in C\+\+ **Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $180,500 \- $250,000/yr****. The compensation package will be determined by job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience.** **Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more.** **Additional Information** -------------------------- Joby Aviation is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Global Program Manager Advanced Manufacturing Technology
jobs.description: **Role Overview** The PMO Program Manager is accountable for the governance, portfolio management, and execution discipline that turns nine independent Advanced Manufacturing and Digital Transformation SME roadmaps into a single, governed, fundable, trackable portfolio. This is a foundational, Year 1 role: it must be stood up early, alongside the SMEs themselves, so that the standards, technology roadmaps, and capital requests coming out of Joining \& Surface Finishing, Functional Test, Manufacturing Quality, Material Flow, Automation \& Robotics, Maintenance \& Reliability, Manufacturing Systems/ERP, Digital Twin, and Industrial IoT are prioritized, funded, and executed against one common framework rather than nine separate ones. The role owns the operating model, prioritization framework, consolidated capital plan, and execution tracking across every factory in the network — Stiva 1, 2, 3, and 5, Durango, and Cienega — and reports directly to the VP of Advanced Manufacturing. This is explicitly not a desk\-bound or office\-based role: it is run through modern, purpose\-built digital program\-management tools — live visual dashboards, digital action\-plan and governance platforms, AI\-assisted meeting capture — rather than static spreadsheets, and it is led from the factory floor and the finance conference room in equal measure, not from behind a screen. The PMO Program Manager must be equally fluent partnering with finance on capital business cases and ROI, and with factory personnel — schedulers, engineers, operators, and plant leadership — at Gemba, seeing firsthand how initiatives are actually landing. Success requires the credibility to act as a leader of leaders: holding nine technical SMEs and plant leadership accountable to a common governance model without owning any of their technical domains directly; the financial and program\-management rigor to consolidate capital decisions across a multi\-site, multi\-country network; and an intense, urgent, hands\-on, highly organized approach that converts the roadmap into funded, executing, benefit\-delivering initiatives rather than a well\-organized backlog. **Key Accountabilities** **A) Governance \& Operating Model** Establish and maintain the portfolio governance charter that defines decision rights across SMEs, plant leadership, and finance — what can be approved locally versus what requires steering committee sign\-off. Own the RACI across the SME network, plants, and finance, and run the recurring steering committee cadence with the VP of Advanced Manufacturing and plant leadership so the portfolio gets discussed and decided, not just reported. **B) Portfolio \& Prioritization** Own and continuously maintain the master technology and capital roadmap, consolidating the initiatives coming out of all nine SMEs into one sequenced view by factory and by year. Establish and apply a standard prioritization framework — SQDIP impact, investment tier, and speed\-to\-value — so initiatives across every SME and factory are compared on the same basis. Own the stage\-gate process (Identify Pilot Business Case Deploy Scale Sustain) that operationalizes the organization's experiment\-deploy\-scale philosophy and keeps initiatives from stalling indefinitely at any one gate. **C) Financial \& Capital Management** Consolidate the capital plan across all factories and SMEs — committed versus available capital, by site and by year — and partner directly with finance to keep it current. Own the business case template and ROI standard used by every SME so capital requests are comparable and auditable. Track benefits realization after deployment, closing the loop on whether a funded initiative actually delivered the safety, quality, delivery, inventory, or productivity improvement it was funded to deliver. **D) Execution \& Delivery Tracking** Maintain the portfolio through modern, purpose\-built digital program and project management tools — live visual dashboards, digital action\-plan and governance platforms, and AI\-assisted meeting\-minutes and action\-item capture — covering status, spend, schedule, and risk across every active initiative, SME, and factory. Manual spreadsheets are not an acceptable substitute for this: decisions, action items, and status must be current, visible, and easy to update in real time, not buried in a static file that goes stale between updates. Own the RAID log and the escalation path for risks and issues, with particular attention to anything on the critical path of a capital\-speed priority. Manage resource and capacity planning across the SME and plant engineering network so competing initiatives don't silently collide over the same scarce plant teams in the same quarter. **E) Standards, Knowledge \& Change Management** Build and maintain the template and tools library — charter, business case, stage\-gate checklist, status reporting, lessons\-learned — used consistently across all nine SMEs, delivered through the same modern digital  not manual spreadsheet\-based tracking — including digital action\-plan and governance tools and AI\-assisted meeting\-minutes/action\-item capture * Experience partnering directly with finance on capital planning, business cases, and benefits realization tracking * Willingness and ability to travel internationally (approximately 30–50%) across the US and Mexico plant network **Strongly Preferred:** * PgMP or PfMP (program or portfolio management) certification in addition to PMP * Experience specifically in advanced manufacturing, automotive, HVAC, or other complex engineer\-to\-order/high\-mix manufacturing environments * Direct experience with modern PPM and digital governance tools (e.g., Planview, Smartsheet, Monday.com, Asana, Jira/Confluence) and BI/visual dashboard tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), and with AI\-assisted meeting\-capture/action\-tracking tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai) as a replacement for manual, spreadsheet\-based governance * Lean or Six Sigma certification, or equivalent operational excellence experience * Prior experience standing up a PMO in a global, multi\-country organization * Bilingual English/Spanish, given the US\-Mexico plant footprint **Core Knowledge Expectations:** * Portfolio and program management methodologies (stage\-gate, hybrid\-Agile, PMI standards) * Capital planning and business case/ROI methodology (payback, IRR/NPV fundamentals) * Financial acumen sufficient to partner credibly with finance on capital versus operating expense decisions * Change management and adoption frameworks for rolling out standards across a diverse, technical stakeholder base * Risk management methodology (RAID logs, escalation frameworks) * Modern digital PMO tooling: purpose\-built program/project management platforms, live visual dashboards, digital action\-plan and governance systems, and AI\-assisted meeting\-minutes and action\-tracking tools — used in place of manual spreadsheets * Data and dashboard tools for portfolio\-level reporting * Ability to operate as a credible peer to technical SMEs without needing to framework and stage\-gate process defined and piloted on 2–3 initiatives * Business case template and ROI standard adopted by all nine SMEs * Portfolio dashboard live with real project, spend, and status data across the network, running on a modern digital PMO platform rather than manually maintained spreadsheets * Trusted working relationships established with all nine SMEs, plant leadership, jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Reporting
jobs.description: **About JustPark** JustPark is the premier partner offering both B2B solutions for destinations and B2C services for drivers, giving us the best of both worlds. We simplify the entire parking experience. From venues and councils to private driveways, our platform makes it simple for drivers to find, book, and pay for parking—while empowering our operating partners to deliver exceptional parking experiences. We’ve always believed parking should be easier from end to end. That’s why we, two trailblazing companies ParkHub and JustPark have come together to make that vision a reality. ParkHub revolutionized event parking in the US, optimizing venue operations for a smoother, stress\-free experience. JustPark transformed parking in the UK, turning the hunt for a spot into a simple, seamless task. Now, as one unified company, we’re combining expertise to offer a full\-service, frictionless parking solution for both businesses and consumers. **About the role** Join the Reporting team at JustPark as a Senior Software Engineer. You'll build, ship and maintain the data platform and reporting products behind our venue operations, used at venues like Mercedes Benz Stadium, The Greek Theatre and The O2 Arena. Following the 2024 merger of ParkHub and JustPark, we're scaling internationally, which means distributed systems, distributed teams, and interesting problems at the intersection of payments, data and real time event operations. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you'll own meaningful pieces of our platform from design through production, including keeping them healthy on live event days. We're an AI native engineering team: engineers use Claude Code, Copilot and Cursor as daily tools for code generation, review, debugging and documentation, and we build MCP integrations that connect our AI tools directly to Jira, Confluence, Slack and internal APIs so engineers stay in flow. You'll work closely with Product, QA, and our UK engineering and data teams to shape the data strategy of a fast growing international company. **Requirements** **Responsibilities** * Design, build and ship backend services and streaming data pipelines in Go that handle real world scale * Own data end to end: event schema and contract design, durable messaging patterns, and the read models and warehouse tables analytics is served from * Build financial data flows, including payment processor ingestion, fee reconciliation and ledger backed reporting * Ingest and reconcile third party data (partner files and payment processor APIs) with idempotent, replayable backfills * Develop and evolve API and GraphQL serving layers that power our internal and external products * Migrate existing reporting paths onto the new architecture * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code and developer tooling * Collaborate across time zones with Product, QA, and our UK engineering and data teams on shared data models * Use AI assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and similar) as a natural part of your workflow, writing code, reviewing PRs, debugging, generating tests and accelerating delivery * Own features vertically: backend first, but able to follow a feature into our React frontends with AI assistance when the work calls for it * Mentor more junior developers on the team **Requirements** * US based, ideally within commuting distance of Dallas Fort Worth * Bachelor's in CS/SE or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of professional backend engineering, with strong recent experience in Go * Deep SQL and data modeling skills; you've designed schemas for analytics and reporting workloads, not just CRUD, and you're comfortable operating production databases including locking, connection behavior, query performance and safe zero downtime migrations * Experience working with large datasets and a strong understanding of OLAP/OLTP paradigms and when to use each * Experience building event driven or streaming data systems, including durable messaging, change data capture, delivery guarantees, replayability and the failure modes that come with them * Experience working with payment processor systems and financial data (ingestion and reconciliation) * Hands on data warehouse experience (BigQuery or similar) and warehouse transformation tooling (dbt or similar) * Deep experience with AWS (EKS, Kinesis, RDS, S3, IAM) and BigQuery on GCP * GraphQL and API design experience for data heavy products, including access control for client facing data * Kubernetes experience (EKS/GKE) and proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) * Solid testing practices across unit, integration and end to end * Comfortable working with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor and similar); we expect engineers to leverage these daily as core workflow, not as a novelty * Clear communication skills, especially async (PRs, design docs, Slack) * The ability to own problems end to end, taking them from ambiguous ask to shipped design, while working in concert with other senior engineers and our principal engineers to meet team objectives * Nice to have: schema and data contract tooling and typed event design (Protobuf or similar) * Nice to have: experience building MCP servers or AI augmented internal tooling * Nice to have: multilingual engineers (TypeScript/Node or others) alongside Go * Nice to have: a quantitative streak around data quality monitoring, statistical thinking or anomaly detection * Nice to have: parking, mobility, ticketing or live events sector experience **Benefits** **Recharge your batteries** * Unlimited PTO policy * Complimentary in\-office barista * Catered breakfast \& lunch between Tuesdays \- Wednesday * Regular social events at the office **Investment in you and your wellbeing** * Comprehensive medical \& dental coverage through Blue Cross Blue Shield * Multiple healthcare plan options including low\-deductible and HSA along with broad supplemental benefits * Employee Assistance program **Simplifying journeys so you can breathe easier** * Subscriptions to mental health assistance platforms * Travel stipend for local employees **We look out for your family** * Generous parental leave policy * Fertility support via ARC Fertility * Pet insurance and discount plans **Look after the pennies** * 401(k) retirement and savings plan **Success is best when it's shared** * Regular social activities such as annual Hackathons and ad hoc celebrations

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Job** At KBX, we use technology, market\-based solutions, and operational excellence to create value for our customers and businesses. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design and deliver scalable software solutions that support our transportation and logistics platforms. This AI\-native product engineering role requires strong technical judgment, modern engineering practices, and ownership to turn ambiguous business problems into production solutions quickly, safely, and with fewer handoffs. **Our Team** We are the KBX Managed Freight Engineering team, focused on transforming freight management with innovative, AI\-powered software solutions. Working closely with product, engineering, and business partners, we build and support scalable applications for shipment tracking, exception management, and carrier connectivity. Our collaborative, cross\-functional team embraces modern engineering practices and empowers each member to take ownership and deliver meaningful business results. **What You Will Do** * Use AI\-assisted and agentic engineering practices across discovery, design, coding, testing, documentation, and support while maintaining accountability for solution quality, security, and supportability * Collaborate directly with Product Managers, Product Owners, Technical Leads, and business stakeholders to clarify problems and requests, challenge assumptions, evaluate tradeoffs, and deliver valuable business outcomes * Design, develop, and maintain scalable full\-stack software applications and services, writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code across backend and user\-facing components * Design and implement complex backend services, APIs, integrations, core system components, and user\-facing application features * Participate in architecture discussions, technology strategy, technical decision\-making, code reviews, and technical design discussions to ensure adherence to engineering standards and best practices * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to software engineers while helping resolve complex technical challenges * Improve application performance, scalability, reliability, and observability * Support and maintain existing applications by troubleshooting and resolving production issues * Document code, technical designs, architectural decisions, and engineering processes * Share reusable patterns, lessons, and practices that improve engineering speed and quality across team **Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)** * Experience leveraging AI\-powered development tools and solutions, including LLMs and agentic systems, while ensuring generated outputs meet standards for quality, security, maintainability, and business value * Experience designing, developing, and maintaining software applications using .NET and related application frameworks * Experience on backend services, APIs, integrations, data access patterns, and user\-facing application features * Experience developing user\-facing application features using modern front\-end frameworks or technologies * Experience designing and developing APIs, integrations, service\-oriented solutions, and translating business requirements into technical solutions * Experience supporting applications through the full software development lifecycle * Experience collaborating with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to deliver software solutions from discovery to production * Experience delivering software through small, cross\-functional teams with broad individual ownership and accountability for outcomes * Experience leading technical activities including code reviews, complex designs, architecture discussions, and troubleshooting * Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to other engineers **What Will Put You Ahead** * Experience incorporating AI capabilities into enterprise software solutions * Experience working on large software development teams delivering enterprise\-scale applications * Experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, fleet management, or related industries * Experience using modern frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue * Experience designing and implementing microservices and distributed systems * Experience with cloud\-native development, containerization, and DevOps practices * Experience with test strategy, test planning, and automated testing frameworks * Experience improving system observability, monitoring, and operational excellence * Experience working in Agile product development environments * Experience with relational and document databases such as PostgreSQL and MongoDB At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy. **Hiring Philosophy** All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here . **Who We Are** As a Koch company, KBX provides the global transportation, logistics and technology solutions that help our customers deliver life's essentials to people all over the world. We develop and deploy cutting\-edge technologies to deliver better solutions for increasingly complex supply chains. Our team of tenacious problem\-solvers are driven to create real, long\-term value for our customers. At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company. **Our Benefits** Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength \- focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes \- medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter. Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results. **Equal Opportunities** Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test. This employer uses E\-Verify. Please click here for additional information. jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** As a Solutions Engineer at KEV Group, you will play a pivotal role in driving our business growth by working closely with schools and districts to design tailored solutions using our software. You will serve as the technical expert throughout the sales cycle, ensuring clients understand how our platform can solve their financial management challenges. This role blends technical knowledge with customer\-facing interactions, making you a crucial link between the sales team and our customers. ### **How You'll Contribute** * Act as the Subject Matter Expert with prospective clients and key stakeholders in all applicable phases of the sales cycle. * Deliver impactful and engaging product demonstrations, showcasing the capabilities of KEV Group's solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Work closely with product management, engineering, and support teams to ensure customer feedback is incorporated into product improvements. * Partner with and participate in the strategy and direction of work set out by the Account Executive including but not limited to territory and account planning. * Acts as a KEV ambassador; attends events and tradeshows representing KEV. * Update the sales team on all new product features and assist in creating a solution for sales to demo. * Ad hoc projects as requested by VP of Sales ### **Who You Are** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. * 3\+ years of experience in a sales engineering, pre\-sales engineering, or similar role. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills * Exceptional interpersonal skills and strong attention to detail * Ability to work in different time zones * Ability to create big\-picture software solutions. ### **What We Offer** * **Competitive compensation** – We believe in rewarding great work with fair, competitive pay. * **Meaningful benefits**– Because your well\-being matters; both at work and at home. * **Retirement Savings Support** – We help you plan for your future with company\-matched programs, including RRSP matching in Canada and 401(k) contributions in the U.S. * **Professional development –** We invest in your growth with ongoing learning, stretch opportunities, and continuing education, including KEV Academy for onboarding and skill\-building, plus KEV University, our online platform offering a wide range of courses. * **Flexible PTO –** Take the time you need to recharge with close to 4 weeks of vacation and a company\-wide holiday closure **Why** **You'll** **Love Working at KEV** * **Make a real difference every day –** At KEV, your work supports children, parents, and schools across North America. We don't just build software, we create solutions that simplify lives and strengthen communities. Our mission is rooted in impact, and **every team member** plays a vital role in shaping the future of K\-12 education. * **The KEV Way –** At KEV, you'll never feel stuck in the status quo. You'll be part of a team that's constantly questioning, improving, and innovating—always with one guiding focus: *How does this help our schools and the students they serve?* It's a culture that challenges you to do your best work while reminding you why it matters. * **Grow with us –** We're scaling fast, and so are our people. At KEV, you'll have real opportunities to learn, develop, and shape your career. Whether advancing in your role or exploring a new path, you'll be supported every step of the way. * **Work alongside excellence** – You'll be part of a team with integrity who treat their colleagues with respect. who are accomplished but humble, collaborative but accountable. It's a place where you can do your best work while feeling supported and inspired by the people around you. * **Celebrate Community and Culture** – At KEV, we connect, recognize, and celebrate our people. Join **Club KEV** for team\-building fun, hear directly from customers in our **Voice of Customer Series**, stay aligned with **Monthly Townhalls**, and be inspired by the **KEVite Awards**, where top contributors are recognized by their peers. This job description indicates the general nature and level of work expected. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities required by an individual joining the KEV team in this or any other capacity. KEV Group is pleased to accommodate individual needs in accordance with the Accessibility of Ontarians with Disabilities Act, 2005 (AODA), within our recruitment process. If you require accommodation at any time throughout the recruitment process, please speak with your recruiter. KEV Group is an equal opportunity employer who agrees not to discriminate against any employee or job applicant because of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, physical or mental disability, or age. All hiring decisions are made by our People and Culture team in partnership with Hiring Managers. Visit our website for more information and details about working at KEV.

jobs.title: Front-End Engineer
jobs.description: Cardiovascular care is often the \#1 cost for health plans and employers, with the current fee for service model incentivizing providers to maximize volume and throughput at the expense of clinical outcomes and patient satisfaction. Karoo’s mission is to improve the lives of every cardiac patient in America by transforming the current care model to improve patient outcomes at significantly lower cost. Karoo deploys a value\-based approach which combines a blend of traditional, guideline\-based medicine and state of the art digital tools to accomplish this important mission by enabling the conversion to, and success in, value\-based care arrangements for cardiovascular networks, health systems and payers. enablement, user adoption, or process redesign alongside technical delivery. **What Success Looks Like** * Working solutions in users’ hands at the end of each sprint — not decks or proofs of concept. lead post\-incident reviews and convert lessons learned into measurable improvements. * Participate in exercises and simulations that strengthen organizational readiness for major cybersecurity events. **Threat Intelligence \& Emerging Threats** * Maintain awareness of the evolving threat landscape and incorporate intelligence into monitoring, detection engineering, vulnerability prioritization, and incident response. * Monitor attack techniques, vulnerabilities, industry trends, and threats relevant to retail and large enterprises; translate technical threats into business risk and actionable recommendations. **Technology \& Security Capabilities** * Provide strategic direction for SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, network detection, cloud monitoring, threat intelligence, case management, and related security platforms. * Partner with architecture and engineering to ensure security technologies deliver appropriate visibility, scalability, resiliency, and integration. * Evaluate AI, machine learning, automation, and emerging technologies to improve detection coverage, response speed, analyst effectiveness, and operational resilience. **Offensive Security** * Lead the enterprise Offensive Security program, including penetration testing, red teaming, adversary emulation, purple\-team exercises, attack\-path analysis, and validation of security controls across applications, infrastructure, cloud, identity, and digital environments. * Establish a risk\-based testing strategy aligned to threat intelligence and critical business services; prioritize findings by exploitability and business impact and track remediation through retesting. * Connect offensive testing with detection engineering, threat hunting, vulnerability management, application security, and engineering so attack insights continuously improve prevention, detection, and response. **Risk, Governance \& Compliance** * Ensure Security Operations supports applicable legal, regulatory, audit, and company requirements; maintain procedures, playbooks, documentation, and evidence. * Partner with Cybersecurity Risk, Governance, and Compliance to address control gaps and protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of company information and technology assets, including regulated/payment environments where applicable. **Metrics \& Executive Communication** * Establish meaningful metrics and OKRs covering detection, incident volume/severity, response performance, automation, resilience, maturity, and risk reduction. * Provide concise reporting to senior Cybersecurity, Technology, and business leadership; translate complex technical issues into business impact, risk, and recommended actions. * Use operational data and threat intelligence to identif  security professionals, including geographically distributed teams and partners. * Establish performance expectations, coaching, development, succession planning, accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, innovation, and operational excellence. * Connect the team’s work to protecting customers, associates, company operations, and the enterprise. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent education and professional experience. * 10\+ years of progressive cybersecurity, information security, technology, or related experience, including significant security operations, monitoring, incident response, or threat detection experience. * 5\+ years leading cybersecurity or technical teams with direct people\-management responsibility; experience supporting enterprise\-scale SOC capabilities and significant cybersecurity incidents. * Strong understanding of SIEM, EDR/XDR, network security, cloud security, identity, threat intelligence, security automation, and complex cloud/on\-premises environments. * Demonstrated ability to communicate cybersecurity risks and recommendations to senior leaders, with strong leadership, stakeholder management, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in a relevant technical or business discipline; experience leading large\-scale, highly distributed and/or global 24x7 security operations. * Experience in retail, e\-commerce, financial services, critical infrastructure, or another high\-volume/high\-availability environment; cloud security operations and regulated/PCI environments. * Experience with security automation, orchestration, AI/ML, major incident response, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT\&CK, and related frameworks. * Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GIAC, CRISC, CISA, or equivalent. **Leadership Profile** The successful candidate will operate effectively at executive, strategic, and operational levels—leading through high\-pressure cybersecurity events while building the long\-term strategy, talent, technology, and capabilities required for modern enterprise Security Operations. The leader will translate complex cyber issues into business terms, challenge existing approaches when appropriate, build strong partnerships, and continuously improve the organization’s ability to detect threats earlier, respond faster, reduce business risk, and protect customers, associates, operations, and the enterprise. **About Lowe’s** Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 100 home improvement company with total fiscal year 2025 sales of more than $86 billion. Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,750 home improvement stores, 540 branches and 120 distribution centers. Lowe’s is a core value S\&P 500 equity stock and a dividend aristocrat. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe’s supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing, improving community spaces, helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts and providing disaster relief to communities in need. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Commercial
jobs.description: About Luxer One --------------- Luxer One designs and deploys intelligent locker and access systems across multifamily, commercial, enterprise, and entertainment markets in North America. An Assa Abloy company, our products are connected hardware — physical locker systems with embedded firmware, cloud management, IoT device networks, and mobile interfaces — deployed at thousands of locations and processing millions of transactions annually. Our commercial portfolio includes Luxer One, DropLocker, American Locker, and Luxer Trace, and it is growing. Hardware is the foundation. The software makes it smart. We need a **Senior Product Manager** who thinks in that order.Why This Role Matters --------------------- As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the hardware that Luxer One's commercial business runs on — the lockers, control boards, access hardware, IoT gateways, and connected device network behind every deployment. That means owning the product from concept through manufacturing through field deployment through the full lifecycle, with a commercial lens on every decision: what it costs to build, what it costs to deploy, what it generates in the market, and what it takes to win. The commercial portfolio is at an inflection point. New hardware platforms are entering production. New market segments are opening. The next generation of our connected hardware needs a product leader who can drive NPI programs, work with manufacturing partners, spec the firmware requirements, price the product for the market, and stand in front of an enterprise customer and make the business case — all without changing gears. If hardware product management is your native discipline and connected devices are your home terrain, this is built for you.Who You Are ----------- You are a hardware product manager first. You have lived the NPI cycle — from concept and requirements through design validation, manufacturing ramp, and field deployment. You understand BOM and cost targets, design for manufacturability, certification and compliance, and what it means to ship a physical product that has to work in the field for years without someone pressing a reset button. You also understand what makes hardware smart in 2026: connectivity, cloud management, OTA updates, device telemetry, and the software layer that turns a physical product into a managed fleet. Connected hardware experience is not a bonus for you — it is the part of the job you are most excited about. You are:* **A hardware PM with manufacturing depth** — you have owned NPI programs, worked with contract manufacturers, managed BOM and cost targets, and shipped physical products into production; the hardware development lifecycle is your native environment * **Connected device fluent** — you understand how hardware connects to cloud services, how fleets of deployed devices are managed remotely, what OTA update architecture looks like, and how telemetry and device health monitoring work at scale; IoT is not a stretch for you, it is the domain * **Commercial and revenue focused** — you hold yourself accountable for what the hardware produces in the market — revenue, margin, win rate, customer value delivered — not just what ships from manufacturing; you have owned pricing decisions, business cases, and launch strategy * **Technically credible across the stack** — you can sit with firmware engineers on embedded constraints, with cloud architects on device management design, and with manufacturing partners on production tooling, and you are credible in all three rooms; you do not need to be the deepest expert in any one layer, but you need to understand how they connect * **AI\-forward in product thinking and personal workflow** — you apply AI to how you work (discovery synthesis, spec generation, competitive analysis) and you see AI capability as a meaningful product design lever for connected hardware * **Entrepreneurial and fast** — you make decisions with incomplete information, prototype before specs, and prefer a physical prototype in a customer's hands over a perfect requirements document; you have launched things from scratch, not just managed existing roadmaps And you bring:* A track record of shipping connected hardware products — physical devices with cloud management, remote update capability, and fleet\-scale deployment — into commercial markets * Real NPI experience: from requirements through DVT, manufacturing ramp, and field deployment * Revenue ownership: pricing, packaging, business case development, and accountability for product\-driven commercial results * Multi\-product range: you have managed more than one hardware platform or product line simultaneously What You'll Do -------------- **Hardware Portfolio Ownership and NPI*** Own the hardware product roadmap across the commercial portfolio — control boards, IoT gateways, connected locker hardware, access systems, and next\-generation platform programs * Lead NPI programs end to end: requirements definition, ware product decision — cost targets, pricing strategy, and the business case behind every new product introduction * Own go\-to\-market for hardware launches: pricing and packaging, sales enablement, positioning, and launch execution in partnership with the VP Sales and Senior Product Marketer * Build and defend business cases for new hardware programs — market sizing, investment rationale, revenue models, and payback period * Partner directly with sales and account management on enterprise opportunities that require hardware product expertise — join customer conversations, help close deals, bring market signal back **Discovery and Technical Leadership*** Lead customer and market discovery for new commercial hardware initiatives — building conviction from direct observation in the field, at customer sites, and at industry events * Translate market signal into technically grounded hardware specifications that manufacturing partners can build and engineering teams can implement * Serve as the technical product authority for commercial hardware in cross\-functional planning — representing hardware requirements, constraints, and capabilities in roadmap, NPI, and strategic discussions **AI Application to Hardware Products and PM Workflow*** Identify where AI capabilities create real product value in the connected hardware portfolio: predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, AI\-powered fleet management, and agentic workflows for device operations * Apply AI tools actively in the PM workflow — spec generation, competitive analysis, discovery synthesis, and cross\-portfolio coordination — to move faster and produce higher\-quality output Location \& Work Model **Sacramento, CA preferred.** This role works closely with the VP Commercial Product \& Delivery, the embedded systems team, manufacturing partners, and field operations — in\-person presence matters. Hybrid considered for the right candidate. Regular travel required for manufacturing partner visits, customer site visits, NPI validation, and industry events.### **Requirements** What We're Looking For ---------------------- * Seven or more years of product management experience with the majority spent on physical hardware products — you are a hardware PM, not a software PM who has also touched hardware * Direct connected hardware experience: physical devices with cloud connectivity, remote management, OTA update capability, and fleet\-scale deployment in a commercial or enterprise context * NPI ownership: you have led hardware development programs from requirements through manufacturing and field deployment, with experience working directly with contract manufacturers * Revenue and margin accountability: you have owned pricing decisions, business cases, and commercial performance for a hardware product line — not just delivered to a revenue target someone else set * Technical depth across the connected hardware stack: embedded firmware constraints, cloud device management, connectivity protocols, and mobile interfaces — sufficient to make credible technical product decisions in each domain * Multi\-product or multi\-portfolio experience: you have managed more than one hardware platform simultaneously and can context\-switch without losing strategic thread * Demonstrated AI fluency: in your product thinking and your own PM workflow — active usage, not a resume keyword * Strongly Preferred ------------------ + Experience at a company manufacturing and deploying connected hardware at commercial scale — IoT, access control, smart lock, asset tracking, industrial IoT, or similar + Direct experience with device management platforms, MDM, or fleet monitoring tooling for connected hardware at scale + Background at a startup or growth\-stage hardware company where you had broad NPI and commercial ownership — not a specialist PM inside a large hardware organization + Experience with access control, smart locker, asset management, or connected physical security products Bachelor's Degree

jobs.title: Senior GenAI Engineer
jobs.description: ##### **Project description** We are seeking a hands\-on GenAI Engineer to join a team developing production\-grade, AI\-powered solutions for a major US insurance provider. The role involves designing and delivering end\-to\-end LLM\-based applications, including scalable backend APIs, agentic workflows, deployment, monitoring, and observability. You will support our client in applying generative AI to key insurance processes such as underwriting, claims, and customer service. ##### **Responsibilities** Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI. Build and integrate LLM\-powered features using OpenAI GPT and Anthropic Claude models. Develop and maintain MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers using FastMCP to expose enterprise tools and data to AI agents. Create and extend Skills and Plugins that enhance LLM capabilities for business\-specific workflows. Design and implement Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, chunking, embedding and retrieval strategies. Build agentic solutions using LLM orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or similar. Work with vector databases to support semantic search and knowledge retrieval. Implement observability and diagnostics for LLM applications: tracing, logging, evaluation, token and cost tracking, latency and quality monitoring. Own the full application lifecycle: development, testing, deployment and production support. Use AI\-assisted development tools (Claude, Codex) to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality. Collaborate with client stakeholders, architects and business analysts to translate requirements into working solutions. Ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, data privacy and responsible AI use. ##### **Skills** Must have 4\+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on Python. Solid experience building production REST APIs with FastAPI (or a comparable framework). Hands\-on experience integrating LLMs (OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude) into real applications, including prompt engineering, tool/function calling and structured outputs. Practical experience with MCP servers (FastMCP preferred) and LLM tool ecosystems (Skills, Plugins). Proven experience designing and implementing RAG pipelines. Experience building agentic workflows with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex or similar. Hands\-on experience with at least one vector database (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Chroma, pgvector, Azure AI Search). Experience with observability and diagnostics for LLM systems (e.g., LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix, OpenTelemetry). Experience deploying and running applications in production: Docker, CI/CD, and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP). Daily, confident use of modern development tools including VS Code and AI coding assistants such as Claude and Codex. Strong understanding of software engineering best practices: clean code, testing, code review, version control (Git). Upper\-Intermediate (B2\) or higher English, with the ability to communicate directly with US\-based stakeholders. Nice to have Experience in the insurance or broader financial services domain. Knowledge of LLM evaluation techniques (automated evals, LLM\-as\-judge, guardrails). Experience with Kubernetes and infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, Bicep). Familiarity with data privacy and compliance requirements for handling PII in regulated industries. Experience with asynchronous Python, message queues or event\-driven architectures. Frontend experience (React, Streamlit) for building internal AI tools and demos. ##### **Other** Languages English: B2 Upper Intermediate Seniority Senior Remote United States, United States of America Req. VR\-125338 Software/System Architecture Cross Industry Solutions 01/10/2026 Req. VR\-125338
