jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** Reporting to the VP, Commercialization, the Director of Product Management will serve as the strategic leader for Motional's product team and lead the design and execution of product vision and design to ensure every rider has the best rider experience possible. Working closely with executive and senior leaders and a team of product managers, you will build out our product vision and oversee the design of our entire AV system of systems. You will incorporate feedback from riders, executives, shareholders and customers and leverage these insights to ensure we are providing the best possible experience with a sustainable business mindset. This includes aligning roadmaps and products across Autonomy, Engineering, Operations, Mission Support, and Commercial teams. This is a pivotal time to join Motional because we are at a historic stage of transitioning from developing an autonomous vehicle to deploying and operating a commercial driverless service. As we transition from development to deployment in Las Vegas in 2026, we are setting the stage to scale our technology globally. This role requires a visionary product leader who can zoom out to build a cohesive Motional point of view on the product experience, while zooming in to untangle complex technical dependencies between hardware, AI, and operations. You will ultimately lead our product teams, establishing a high\-velocity development loop that ensures every release is safer, more performant, and more commercially viable than the last and our tools develop and scale for growth. This role will be expected to travel up to 50% of the time depending on the business purpose and product deliverables. **What you'll be doing:** * **Build and Lead the Product Organization:** Attract, hire, and inspire a small and mighty world\-class team of Product Managers. You will establish a product culture focused on analytical rigor, cross\-functional collaboration, and high\-quality execution. * **Define the Motional Product POV:** Lead the development of a unified product vision that spans the entire rider journey and technical stack on and off the AV. You will consolidate disparate roadmaps into a single, unified strategy for Motional's robotaxi service. You have expertise at managing all aspects of the product life\-cycle, from conceptualization to market introduction and production, and product dimensions including technical, commercial/business, financial, legal and legislative. * **Establish Prioritization Frameworks:** Create and enforce rigorous, data\-driven frameworks to balance competing priorities across Engineering, Fleet Operations, and Commercial teams. You will make the hard trade\-offs between technical capability, system complexity, and time\-to\-market. * **Catalyze Autonomous Performance \& Developer Velocity:** Oversee the product strategy for our underlying autonomy tools and data pipelines. Partner deeply with leads to identify workflow bottlenecks, improve strategies, and ensure engineering teams can rapidly iterate on performance. * **Orchestrate Hardware \& Software Synergy:** Own the feedback loop between the in\-vehicle experience, the physical fleet, and the backend software. Ensure the product roadmap maximizes the capabilities of our vehicle platform and scales effectively for daily operations. Influence and support the current and future generation platforms with OEMs, help execute commercial and go\-to\-market strategies for expansion and prepare for growth. * **Lead Strategic Internal Collaborations:** Establish the product organization's "rhythm of business," including roadmap reviews, resource allocation meetings, and executive briefings. You will act as the primary operational bridge aligning internal technical execution with external commercial obligations. * **Customer and Partner Obsession**: You will collaborate to define the integration scope and milestones with partners. Your team will own the technical customer\-facing aspects of our integrations with ride\-hail partners and owners and operators, ensuring a seamless and successful partnership. * **Define Success \& Track KPIs:** Define what "winning" looks like across Safety, Progress, and Comfort. Track and report on key performance indicators, ensuring our engineering velocity translates directly into measurable improvements in the Operational Design Domain (ODD) and rider experience. **What we're looking for:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent field, or commensurate professional experience. * 10\+ years relevant professional experience in Product Management, with a minimum of 5\+ years leading product teams within Autonomous Vehicles, Ride\-Hail, robotics, or complex AI/ML industries. * **Systems\-Level Thinking:** You have a proven ability to unify fragmented workflows and consolidate disparate product strategies into a single cohesive vision. * **Technical Authority:** Deep foundational understanding of the ML development lifecycle, data curation, and autonomous systems. You can hold your own in architecture reviews and engage with engineers on data pipelines and algorithmic requirements. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** You possess a proven track record of orchestrating complex projects across highly technical and non\-technical teams, translating commercial needs into clear directives for Autonomy and Operations. * **Executive Presence:** You possess superb communication skills and can command a room. diagnostic activities. * Investigate equipment failures and recommend corrective actions, preventive measures, and long\-term reliability improvements. * Lead the Management of Change (MOC) process applicable NERC standards, ASME codes, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. **Project Management \& Continuous Improvement** * Manage strategic projects from planning through completion, coordinating with Operations, Maintenance, and plant leadership. * Plan, budget, and manage capital improvement projects in alignment with plant priorities and financial requirements. * Prepare and evaluate RFPs and bid packages, support vendor selection, and ensure compliance with contractual and safety requirements. * Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal stakeholders, engineers, contractors, vendors, and regulatory agencies. * Serve as backup to the Maintenance Manager and Operations Manager, providing leadership and decision\-making support as needed. * Review plant operations and design practices to identify opportunities for cost savings, efficiency improvements, and improved performance. * Lead plant upgrade and technology initiatives by Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- **Site Reliability Engineer** ============================= Onsite: Atlanta, GA **Job Summary** --------------- At NCR Voyix, we're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer II to help build, support, and scale the cloud platforms that power our products and services. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving technical challenges, automating manual processes, and improving the reliability and performance of applications in a cloud\-native environment. As part of our Engineering organization, you'll work closely with software engineers, cloud architects, and operations teams to ensure our platforms remain secure, available, and scalable. You'll have the opportunity to gain hands\-on experience with cloud technologies, automation, observability tools, and modern infrastructure practices while contributing to mission\-critical systems used by customers around the world. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Support and enhance cloud\-based infrastructure and applications across modern cloud platforms. * Implement automation solutions that improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and increase system reliability. * Monitor application and infrastructure health using observability and monitoring tools to identify and resolve performance issues. * Participate in incident response and on\-call support rotations for production systems. * Troubleshoot infrastructure, application, and deployment issues in partnership with engineering teams. * Assist with root cause analysis (RCA) activities and support implementation of preventive solutions. * Contribute to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) initiatives using modern automation and cloud provisioning tools. * Partner with software development teams to improve application reliability, scalability, and operational readiness. * Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation processes. * Create and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, and troubleshooting guides. * Stay current with emerging cloud and platform technologies and recommend improvements where applicable. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 1\-3 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Systems Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or a related technical role. * Experience with at least one public cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Python, Bash, Go, or PowerShell. * Familiarity with Linux operating systems and basic system administration concepts. * Understanding of cloud infrastructure, networking, and application architecture fundamentals. * Familiarity with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Knowledge of CI/CD concepts and experience with tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar platforms. * Exposure to monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, Splunk, or ELK. * Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across technical teams. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi. * Understanding of SRE concepts including service availability, reliability, incident management, and operational excellence. * Experience supporting production applications in a cloud\-native environment. * Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies. * Relevant cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, or GCP) are a plus. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Contributes to reliable, scalable, and secure cloud services. * Helps reduce operational toil through automation and process improvements. * Responds effectively to incidents and contributes to long\-term reliability improvements. * Builds strong partnerships with development and platform engineering teams. * Continuously expands technical expertise while supporting business\-critical systems. *This job description outlines the primary responsibilities of the position and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties. Additional responsibilities may be assigned based on business needs and individual skills and experience.* Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job **EEO Statement** Integrated into our shared values is NCR Voyix’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. NCR Voyix is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at NCR Voyix has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment. **Statement to Third Party Agencies** To ALL recruitment agencies: NCR Voyix only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. jobs.title: Field Service Technician II - Golden, CO
jobs.description: **About NCR Atleos** NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self\-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe. NCR Atleos was ranked \#12 in Newsweek’s prestigious 2025 Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces® list. Title: Field Service Technician II Location: **Golden, CO** At NCR Atleos, our Field Services organization is on the front line of keeping commerce running for some of the world’s largest retailers and financial institutions. Our technicians are trusted partners to our customers, delivering reliable, high\-quality service that keeps essential self\-service technology operating around the clock. We are looking for Field Service Technicians who are technically curious, mechanically inclined, and customer focused. Whether you already have field service experience or bring transferable technical skills, NCR Atleos provides the training, tools, and support needed to build a long\-term career in a high\-impact, customer\-facing role. **Position Summary** Are you a Field Technician, Field Engineer, or Service Technician—or interested in starting a career in this field? Are you tech savvy with strong mechanical aptitude and transferrable skills? Do you want to work with some of the largest retailers and banks in the industry? managers will strive to communicate in advance whenever possible to minimize schedule disruptions * May elect to participate in overnight travel assignments to support broader service coverage; all travel follows established company policy and reimbursement guidelines **Basic Qualifications** * Local candidate to the specific geographic area * Authorized to work in the United States * At least 19 years of age * Valid driver’s license and driving record that meets NCR Atleos fleet requirements * PC skills, basic electronic skills, and operating system familiarity * Ability to perform essential job functions without reasonable accommodation, including: o Prolonged travel with several hours of driving per day o Rotating and weekend shifts o Carrying and lifting tools, parts, and equipment weighing up to 50 lbs. without assistance o Bending, squatting, walking, standing, sitting, reaching, and repetitive hand movements manipulating objects of various sizes **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with large servers, mainframe computers, and imaging software * A\+ Certification, CompTIA, or Network\+ (N\+) Certification * One (1\) or more years of related experience Salary Range: $42,400\.00 \- $63,600\.00 Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job. **Full time employee benefits include**: * Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Life Insurance * Vision Insurance * Short/Long Term Disability * Paid Vacation * 401k **EEO Statement** NCR Atleos is an equal\-opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Architect
jobs.description: Company Overview: Req ID: 392376 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now. We are currently seeking a Senior Software Architect to join our team in Charlotte, North Carolina (US\-NC), United States (US). Job Description: * Seeking a highly experienced Senior Software Architect to lead the design and evolution of mission\-critical, high\-scale distributed platforms. This role requires deep hands\-on expertise in API development, MongoDB, Python, and Java, with a strong record of architecting systems that process millions of transactions per day while meeting rigorous SLA, availability, security, and resiliency requirements. * The ideal candidate combines strategic architectural leadership with practical engineering depth. They will define technical direction, solve complex scalability and reliability challenges, establish engineering standards, and partner closely with product, platform, security, and engineering teams. Key Responsibilities * Architect scalable, highly available, and resilient distributed systems supporting high transaction volumes and mission\-critical workloads. * Define end\-to\-end system architecture across APIs, services, data stores, asynchronous processing, caching, observability, and infrastructure. * Design and govern enterprise\-grade API platforms, including RESTful and/or event\-driven APIs, API security, versioning, rate limiting\*\*\* error handling, and backward compatibility. * Lead architecture decisions for services built primarily in Python and Java, ensuring performance, maintainability, operational readiness, and secure coding practices. * Design, optimize, and govern large\-scale MongoDB deployments, including data modeling, indexing, sharding, replication, consistency, backup/recovery, and capacity planning. * Establish reliability and resiliency patterns, including fault isolation, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery. * Drive performance engineering, including load testing, bottleneck analysis, query optimization, API latency reduction, and scalability planning. * Define observability standards across logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, alerting, SLOs, SLIs, and incident response. * Partner with DevOps/SRE teams to improve production readiness, deployment automation, infrastructure reliability, and operational maturity. * Conduct architecture reviews, establish technical standards, and mentor senior engineers and technical leads. * Translate business and non\-functional requirements into clear technical designs, roadmaps, trade\-offs, and implementation plans. * Lead root\-cause analysis for critical production incidents and drive permanent corrective actions. Required Qualifications * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience in software architecture or technical leadership roles. * 8\+ years experience architecting and delivering large\-scale distributed systems supporting high throughput, high availability, and strict SLA requirements. * Deep expertise in API design and development, including scalable service architectures, API lifecycle management, security, authentication/authorization, and performance optimization. * 8\+ years strong hands\-on development experience in both Python and Java. * Extensive enterprise\-scale experience with MongoDB, including: * Data modeling and schema design * Indexing and query optimization * Replica sets and sharding * Read/write scaling strategies * High availability and disaster recovery * Performance tuning and capacity planning * Backup, restore, and data consistency strategies * Strong knowledge of distributed systems concepts, including eventual consistency, CAP trade\-offs, concurrency, message delivery semantics, idempotency, and data partitioning. * Demonstrated experience with cloud\-native architectures, containerization, CI/CD, and production operations. * Strong understanding of monitoring and observability practices, including metrics, logs, tracing, alerting, SLOs, and incident management. * Experience leading technical design discussions and influencing cross\-functional stakeholders. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions clearly. Preferred Qualifications * Experience building platforms in regulated, financial, telecommunications, healthcare, or other SLA\-critical environments. * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, service mesh, API gateways, and infrastructure\-as\-code. * Experience with event streaming or messaging platforms such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent. * Experience with caching technologies such as Redis. * Familiarity with security architecture, secrets management, encryption, OWASP practices, and identity/access management. * Experience modernizing legacy Python or Java platforms into scalable, cloud\-native services. * Experience leading teams through major platform migrations or reliability improvement programs. About NTT DATA: NTT DATA is a $30 billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long term success. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start\-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure and connectivity. We are one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3\.6 billion each year in R\&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** Natera is currently seeking a Clinical Laboratory Associate to analyze laboratory specimens following the standard methods and procedures while maintaining equipment and instruments in good operating condition by troubleshooting malfunctions as needed. **PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Assists in testing of patient samples according to standard operating procedure in an efficient manner with little to no errors * Responsible for maintaining updated understanding and knowledge of methods performed in the lab * Follows GLP (good laboratory practice): maintain cleans and organized work space * Completes training and other deadlines on time. * Recognizes and escalates equipment malfunctions; jobs.title: Operating Engineer
jobs.description: **How You’ll Contribute** The Campus and Experiences division creates and supports inspirational experiences for live audiences and delivers excellent service and operations at National Geographic Society facilities. The division is responsible for our Base Camp headquarters, including all aspects of the Museum of Exploration. This division also produces and generates revenue through National Geographic Live, Speakers Bureau and National Geographic’s Traveling Exhibitions programs. The Operating Engineer provides support to the Engineering Manager in the operation and maintenance of the facility during assigned shifts. This position assists and instructs maintenance mechanics in their duties and overall maintenance programs. The Operating Engineer is responsible for managing temperature, lighting, power, and all other facility requirements across campus. This role requires comprehensive knowledge of all building systems, hours of operation, and the specific areas served by each system. This position is designated as essential. Essential personnel are required to report to or remain at work during emergency situations to ensure proper operational coverage. We are seeking a team member who values interoperability and is ready to jump in and support colleagues across different projects when needed. At the Museum of Exploration, we believe that our greatest successes come from shared expertise and a willingness to step outside of a single role. This isn't just a part of the job; it's a core aspect of how we operate and collaborate, reflecting the spirit of partnership that defines National Geographic's culture. The schedule for this position is Wednesday through Saturday 6:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.**Your Impact** **Responsibilities Include:** * **Preventive Maintenance Oversight (40%):** Oversee and provide technical and/or physical assistance with the shift's scheduled preventive maintenance program to ensure timely completion and professional\-quality workmanship. * **System Operations \& Monitoring (40%):** Operate and/or monitor the building's mechanical, electrical, and life safety systems during the assigned shift. Maintain a written account of shift activities when the Engineering Manager is off\-site. * **Administrative Duties (10%):** Review operations manuals, maintenance records, and OEM equipment specifications. Research and recommend operational techniques or improvements to reduce energy usage. Perform inspections of mechanical and engineering spaces assigned to the shift to maintain proper housekeeping standards. Manage timecard records. * **Testing \& System Maintenance (5%):** Perform testing, operations, and maintenance of mechanical and life safety systems as required by law or manufacturer recommendations. * **Water Treatment \& Analysis (5%):** Perform water treatment and system analysis for systems assigned to the shift. Keep a written log of test results, add chemical treatments, maintain treatment systems, and recommend necessary improvements. **The schedule for this position is Wednesday through Saturday 6:00 a.m. – 4:30 p.m.** **Minimum Education Required** A high school graduate with continuing education in the Mechanical Engineering field. **Minimum Years and Type of Experience** Minimum of 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in the engineering field. **Must have a 3rd class District of Columbia Steam Operators license and CFC Certification.** 24 hours of continuing education per year will also be required. **Knowledge and Skills Required** * Extensive practical experience operating and maintaining low\-pressure steam boilers. * Hands\-on expertise with centrifugal chillers, packaged AC systems, fan coil units, VAV systems, and refrigeration systems. * Demonstrated experience in water treatment analysis and maintenance. * Proficiency in air balance techniques and Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs). * Operational knowledge of fire alarm and fire suppression systems. * Familiarity with Energy Management Systems (EMS) and commercial food service equipment. * Practical ability to operate and maintain all facilities systems required to deliver a first\-class working environment in a Class A office complex. * Strong oral and written communication skills. * Computer literacy, including proficiency with standard office PCs and standard software applications. Desired Skills * Strong leadership abilities to assist, instruct, and guide maintenance mechanics effectively. * Advanced troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across complex mechanical and electrical systems. * Proactive problem\-solving capabilities focused on energy conservation and process improvement. * High degree of adaptability and cross\-functional teamwork in a dynamic, multi\-project environment. **Supervision** No direct reports **Salary Information** The National Geographic Society offers a competitive and holistic total rewards package. Our compensation structure and transparent pay philosophy are based on industry\-specific market data for similar\-sized nonprofit organizations. The salary range for this position accounts for a wide range of factors including but not limited to organizational need; specific skill sets; experience and training; certifications; and more. At the National Geographic Society, individuals are typically hired at or near the starting point of the salary range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The hourly range for this position is $42\.75 \- $45\.00\. Employees in positions who are assigned to a shift that starts or ends between 6 p.m. and 6 a.m. are entitled to shift differential pay of 10% of base pay for the hours worked between 6 p.m. and 6 a.m. In addition, the National Geographic Society offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package that includes, but is not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance; engaging and comprehensive wellness program; 401(k) retirement savings plan with matching contributions after 6 months of employment; flexible paid time off benefits with up to 22 days of paid annual leave per calendar year (15 days for new hires in their first year, prorated based on the number of pay periods remaining in the year) and 10 days of sick leave; 12 paid holidays and a paid winter break between December 25 and 31 (May not apply to all roles that are required to work during high volume seasons or essential workers. Please check with the hiring manager for confirmation.); paid parental leave, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, fertility benefits; learning and development opportunities; Lifestyle Spending Account; pet adoption assistance and insurance; pre\-tax transportation benefits with a generous employer subsidy; employer\-paid life insurance and disability benefit; and a variety of National Geographic discounts and perks. **Job Designation** On\-Site \- Staff members who spend 100% of work time on\-site at Base Camp, supporting overall campus and museum operations. On\-Site staff shifts (spread over seven days a week and 24 hours a day, including holidays) are scheduled by their supervisors and determined by team needs and may be adjusted based on cyclical work cycles and ebbs and flows of work throughout the year.*Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.* *W**e encourage you to apply even if your experience is not a 100% match with the position. We are looking for someone with relevant skills and experience, not a checklist that exactly matches the job description. We want to help you grow and in return, you help us grow into a stronger, more inclusive organization.*

jobs.title: Construction Traveling Superintendent
jobs.description: Company Overview The Neenan Company is one of the nation's premier integrated design\-build firms, consistently recognized among the Top 100 Design\-Builders in the United States. Headquartered in Fort Collins, Colorado, Neenan brings architects, construction professionals, and industry experts together under one roof to deliver innovative, cost\-effective solutions that align with our clients' strategic goals and organizational vision. By combining design and construction collaboration throughout the project lifecycle, we create exceptional facilities across a diverse range of commercial markets nationwide. If you are looking for a career, not just a job, we are the company for you. Position Summary The Traveling Construction Superintendent provides overall field leadership for commercial construction projects throughout the Western United States. This position is responsible for planning, coordinating, and supervising all on\-site construction activities to ensure projects are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with Neenan's quality standards. The Superintendent serves as the primary field representative and is responsible for fostering strong relationships with subcontractors, trade partners, owners, consultants, and project team members while maintaining a safe, productive, and professional jobsite. This position requires extended travel and temporary relocation to project sites for assignments typically ranging from 12 to 18 months. Essential Responsibilities Project Leadership \& Execution * Lead all field operations from project startup through final completion and owner turnover. * Develop and maintain short\-term and long\-term construction schedules to support project milestones. * Coordinate daily activities of subcontractors, suppliers, and trade partners to ensure efficient workflow and project progress. * Direct and manage field personnel while fostering accountability, collaboration, and high performance. * Participate in preconstruction planning activities with the General Superintendent, Project Manager, and project team. Safety Management * Champion a culture of safety and ensure strict compliance with OSHA regulations, company safety policies, and site\-specific safety plans. * Partner with the Safety Director to proactively identify, mitigate, and resolve jobsite hazards. * Conduct regular safety meetings, site inspections, and corrective action reviews. Quality Assurance * Ensure all work is executed in accordance with contract documents, specifications, building codes, and Neenan quality standards. * Conduct quality control inspections and collaborate with the Quality Manager to identify and resolve deficiencies. * Verify layout accuracy, dimensional control, and installation quality throughout construction. Schedule \& Resource Management * Monitor project progress and productivity to maintain schedule commitments. * Coordinate labor, equipment, and material resources to optimize project performance. * Identify potential delays and implement corrective actions to minimize schedule impacts. * Support project budget objectives through efficient field operations and resource utilization. Communication \& Documentation * Maintain accurate and timely project documentation, including daily reports, inspections, schedules, safety records, and regulatory requirements. * Collaborate effectively with Project Managers, architects, engineers, owners, consultants, and authorities having jurisdiction. * Communicate project status, challenges, and solutions to stakeholders in a professional and proactive manner. * Utilize construction management software, mobile applications, and project technology platforms to support project delivery. Problem Solving \& Client Service * Anticipate and resolve field conflicts, design challenges, and construction issues. * Foster strong client relationships through professionalism, responsiveness, and exceptional project execution. * Support a positive project culture focused on teamwork, continuous improvement, and client satisfaction. At Neenan, you'll be part of a collaborative design\-build team that values innovation, accountability, craftsmanship, and client service. We empower our Superintendents to lead projects, build relationships, and make meaningful contributions to the success of our clients and communities. Qualifications Required * Minimum 10 years of construction supervision experience on commercial construction projects. * Demonstrated ability to successfully lead commercial construction projects from groundbreaking through completion. * Strong knowledge of construction means and methods, scheduling, quality control, safety regulations, and project documentation. * Proficiency with construction management software and mobile field technology. * Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Valid driver's license and ability to travel extensively. Preferred * Minimum 5 years of healthcare or medical facility construction experience. * OSHA 30 Certification. * Design\-build project experience. * Experience managing projects across multiple states and jurisdictions. * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field. Travel Requirements * Ability to relocate for project assignments lasting approximately 12 to 18 months. * Opportunity to work one week per month from home or location of your choice.

Engineering Manager for all project engineering and technical matters from front‑end development through construction, commissioning, startup, and handover to operations. * Provide technical leadership and assurance across all disciplines, including: * + Process Engineering + Mechanical (static \& rotating) + Piping \& Layout + Electrical + Instrumentation \& Process Control + Utilities, off‑sites, and infrastructure * Serve as a credible technical authority capable of challenging EPC contractors, licensors, and vendors while maintaining strong working relationships. **Systems, standards, workflows, tools, and best practices to be used across multiple projects. * Establish and align engineering standards with: * + Company requirements + Industry codes \& standards + US and state regulatory requirements + Process licensor design packages + SHE, Process Safety, and Project Excellence (PEX) standards **Design Assurance \& Process Safety** * Ensure engineering design international travel, as engineering, procurement, and fabrication activities span the US, Europe, and Asia.

jobs.title: Robot Support Associate, Burlington, NJ
jobs.description: **About Nimble** Nimble is an AI robotics company building the autonomous supply chain to power fast, efficient and economical commerce. We’re training robot AGI to power a proprietary generalist supply chain superhumanoid, the first robot in the world capable of performing thousands of tasks across the supply chain. We’ve raised over $220M at over $1B valuation and formed a strategic alliance with FedEx to build a national network of autonomous warehouses capable of generating many billions in annual revenue. We are a hardcore and obsessed team of the world’s best engineers and operators. If you are obsessed with your craft, enjoy a high\-intensity and fast moving high impact environment, are super high agency in getting hard things done and want to be part of building the world’s most legendary robotics company at the most pivotal moment in history, we want to work with you. We are on a mission to empower and inspire mankind to accomplish legendary feats by inventing robots that liberate us from the menial. We will accomplish this by training robot AGI to invent and build the Autonomous Supply Chain – everything from the inside of factories and warehouses to your front door – powered by generalist superhumanoids. Our founding team comes from the AI labs at Stanford and Carnegie Mellon and our board of directors include famed robotics and AI legends including Fei\-Fei Li (Chief Scientist of AI at Google and Director of Stanford’s AI Lab), Marc Raibert (founder of Boston Dynamics), and Sebastian Thrun (founder of GoogleX, Waymo; Stanford Professor and considered the father of autonomous vehicles). Let’s be legendary. **Why Join Nimble?** At Nimble, we are committed to building legendary products, a legendary team, and a legendary legacy. Join us and become part of an ambitious, humble, and resourceful culture where your work will leave a lasting impact on the future of robotics and commerce. **Nimble's Core Values:** **Be relentlessly resourceful** \- *Challenge conventions and overcome obstacles.* **Be legendary** \- *Be the very best and do work that inspires.* **Be humble** \- *Prioritize growth, learning, and doing whatever is needed to further the mission.* **Be dependable** \- *Take ownership and deliver with high agency.* **The Role** The Robotics Support Associate is responsible to monitor in real\-time a fleet of autonomous fulfillment robots, swiftly resolving hardware and software errors, and ensuring optimal flow across the facility. You will partner with frontline operations, Service technicians to achieve daily production goals. You will closely collaborate with Engineering to troubleshoot edge cases, track performance patterns, and drive continuous system improvements #### **Responsibilities** * Monitor fleet management interface to ensure continuous, uninterrupted throughput of autonomous systems. * Track key operational metrics and proactively address bottlenecks. * Quickly respond to system alerts, physical robot faults, pathing jams, and hardware exceptions * Perform basic physical and digital triage to safely clear error states, recover stalled robots and return them to active service without compromising shift pace. * Use our tracking system to log detailed fault/bug reports, capturing necessary information to root cause incidents. * Partner with the appropriate engineering teams to diagnose recurring hardware, software, or sensor failures. * Participate in root\-cause analysis (RCA) sessions and assist in testing or validating new firmware, software patches, and hardware retrofits on the live floor. * Keep clear line of communication with on the floor operations and Service to achieve daily production goals * Enforce safety protocols when operating on the grid and the control mezzanine. #### **Qualifications** * One or more years of experience in a similar role working in an automated warehouse, manufacturing facility, autonomous fleet monitoring or technical operations environment * Comfortable navigating complex software dashboards, fleet management software, and basic hardware diagnostics. * Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills; ability to remain calm and decisive during high\-volume operational incidents. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills and ability to work in a fast paced environment involving quickly changing priorities and ability to handle stressful situations * Working knowledge of google suite * Working knowledge of WMS systems * Working knowledge of OSHA regulations * Dedicated, hard working and quick learner ### **Additional Requirements** * Must be able to stand/walk for up to 12 hours * Regular bending, stretching and reaching both below the waist and above the head * Warehouse environment with variable noise levels, lighting conditions and temperature variation * Required to work and walk at elevated heights, using fall protection equipment. * Frequently required to stand, walk, sit, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl to access necessary equipment. * Occasionally required to smell, using odors to determine process or equipment problems. * Regularly lift and/or move up to 20 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 40 pounds, and occasionally be required to lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. **Compensation** The pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be **between $25\.00 \- $27\.00/hr**. Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. **Culture:** We embrace challenges and strive to make the impossible possible each day. We’re not in this to do what’s easy or to be mediocre. We want to create something legendary and leave our mark on the world. We’re ambitious, we’re gritty, we’re humble and we’re relentlessly resourceful in pursuit of our goals. If this sounds like you then you might be a great fit! Nimble Robotics, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions based solely on merit. We provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state, federal or local laws. **Nimble's Benefits** **Paid Time Off** Enjoy the time you need to travel, rejuvenate, and connect with friends and family. **Health Insurance** Nimble provides medical, dental, and vision insurance through several premier plans and options to support you and your family. **Paid Parental Leave** Enjoy paid bonding time following a birth. **Commuter Benefits** Take the stress out of commuting with access to fully paid parking spots. **Referral Bonus** Get a cash bonus for any friend or colleagues that you refer to us that we end up hiring. **401k** Contribute towards a 401k for retirement planning.

jobs.title: Endpoint Technology Associate or Lead
jobs.description: **Location:** Des Plaines, IL **Category:** Staff **Job Type:** Full Time Staff **Posted On:** Thu Sep 24 2026 **Job Description:** **This is a multi\-level search with two open positions to be filled. Depending on qualifications, the successful candidates may be hired at either the Endpoint Technology Technician Associate or Lead level.** **Job Summary:** Lead and support endpoint technology from computers to audiovisual systems across the college. Install, update, and maintain technology in classrooms, offices, and event areas. Provide expert troubleshooting for computer and audiovisual systems. **Associate Endpoint Technology Technician** **Job Responsibilities:** * Install, maintain, and update classroom, conference room, event space and office technology, including pulling cables, installing computers, printers, projectors, lecterns, cameras, speakers, microphones, wall mounted monitors, and other hardware. * Ensure inventory is accurate by appropriately onboarding and disposing of assets following current processes and procedures. * Create, update and troubleshoot tickets related to endpoint technology. Meet current SLAs, provide documentation both on tickets and in knowledge articles. Follow all current processes and procedures related to service management. * Coordinate support for new and remodeled spaces during construction. Provide direct support for equipment moves and installations as needed. * Implement classroom computer\-based control systems and programming (e.g., Extron, Dante, or other current technology) and the networked projectors system. * Direct the delivery, set up and return of media and computer\-based equipment used in classes, meetings, and special events. Provide support for live events. * Make recommendations on equipment and material purchases. Participate in team meetings to review and update technology standards, including current processes and procedures related to endpoint technology. * Maintain an in depth and up to date knowledge of endpoint technology. * Perform other job\-related duties as assigned, including providing support at other locations and campuses for major events. **Lead Endpoint Technology Technician** **Job Responsibilities** * Design new installation initiatives, and coordinate the installation of new endpoint technology including classroom, audiovisual, video conferencing and other endpoint systems. * Review and maintain asset inventory for endpoint technology; update and review inventory processes and procedures in collaboration with other areas of IT and the college. * Review tickets for endpoint technology. Provide and review documentation for supporting endpoint technology. Follow all processes and procedures related to service management. Coordinate support with the Help Desk Supervisor and other areas of IT to resolve incidents. * Review construction plans and timelines, plan equipment moves and installations. Provide and coordinate support for new and remodeled spaces during construction, including ensuring plans align with current technology standards, * Serve as the application expert for classroom\-based control systems and programming (e.g, Extron, Dante, or other current technology). Serve as the application expert for the projector management software system. * Serve as primary production engineer during live events, managing the a/v control rooms or mobile control centers for events; work with IT personnel to help support the delivery, set up and return of media and computer\-based equipment used in classes, meetings, and special events. * Make recommendations on equipment and material purchases. Participate in team meetings to review and update technology standards, including current processes and procedures related to endpoint technology. Lead testing and assessment of new technology. * Maintain an in depth and up to date knowledge of endpoint technology. * Perform other job\-related duties as assigned. **Job Requirements:** **Associate Endpoint Technology Technician** **Education, Work Experience, and Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Communications, Computer Science or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired. * Five years of directly relevant experience including: * Five years audio video and/or computer hardware and system support. * Two years technical repair experience and knowledge of current audiovisual equipment, including mixing boards, microphones, wireless systems, printers, and computers. * Ability to read and interpret wiring diagrams and schematics. * Valid and current driver's license and the ability to travel between all campuses, including transporting equipment in College owned vehicles. * A high level of interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to deliver services in an environment where there is an emphasis on customer service are required. * Two years' experience with IP protocols in routed networks, preferred. * Experience programming Extron and/or Shure control systems for classrooms, boardrooms, and auditoriums, preferred. * Two years' experience supporting Video Conferencing, Lecture Capture, preferred. **Lead Endpoint Technology Technician** **Education, Work Experience, and Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Communications, Computer Science or related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience from which comparable knowledge and abilities can be acquired. * Seven years of directly relevant experience including: * Five years designing audiovisual systems * Two years of third\-level expert computer hardware support. * One\-year primary production engineer during live events, including demonstrated ability to correctly and safely mount, test and calibrate equipment including projectors, screens, monitors, cameras and speakers. * Two years' experience in reading and interpreting wiring diagrams and schematics. * Valid and current driver's license and the ability to travel between all campuses, including transporting equipment in College owned vehicles. * A high level of interpersonal and communication skills and the ability to deliver services in an environment where there is an emphasis on customer service are required. * Current certification or training in Oakton supported classroom systems (e.g., Extron or Shure). * A minimum of two years' experience with IP protocols in routed networks, preferred. **Both Positions** **Working Environment and Physical Demands:** * Work requires some lifting of items weighing up to 70 pounds, some stooping, kneeling, crouching, and/or crawling and use of ladders. Mobility to travel to all campuses. Work is performed in a general office environment with little or no exposure to adverse working conditions. **Supervision Received:** Functional supervision is received from the Manager of User Support Services, Endpoint Technology and the Event Technology Support Supervisor (for events). Administrative supervision is received from the Director of User Support Services. **Supervision Exercised:** Functional supervision may be exercised over student employees as needed. The Lead Endpoint Technology Technician provides project\-based supervision over the Associate Endpoint Technology Technician. **Additional Information:** **HOURS: Monday \- Friday, 8:15am \- 5:00pm (Hours may vary due to the needs of the College and are inclusive of a 45 minute unpaid meal break).** **SALARY: Compensation will be commensurate with experience.** **Associate Endpoint Technology Technician:** The minimum starting salary is $28\.25 per hour which equates to $56,921 annualized based on Oakton's summer hours schedule. **Lead Endpoint Technology Technician:** The minimum starting salary is $30\.39 per hour which equates to $61,242 annualized based on Oakton's summer hours schedule. Based on the needs of the college and with Administrator approval, some positions at the college may have a hybrid schedule option available after 30 working days. THIS POSITION IS NOT FULLY REMOTE **For information regarding employment eligibility, please visit** **our employment at Oakton web page****.** **Equal Opportunity Employer**

projects and other assignments. * Provide input on project scope, forecast, resources, and deliverables within specified deadlines while continuously assessing the client’s ability to change relative Knowledge and Skills:** * Ability to facilitate meetings with a high level of effectiveness * Strong negotiation/problem solving skills * Exceptional organizational skills. * Ability to reason in “real time” * Outstanding interpersonal, written and oral communication skills * Highly technical and analytical with the ability to collaboratively engage customers, 3rd party vendors, and internal team members in an effective and supportive manner * Advanced troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills utilizing science and engineering education to arrive at practical solutions * Ability to multi\-task and manage time efficiently * Detail\-oriented, independent and able to adjust to changing priorities * Proven track record of success in managing multiple projects/multiple presentation deadlines at one time * Experience with Linux/Unix/Windows, and with Postgres database as well as installing applications on Windows or Linux servers * Working knowledge of server hardware and network configurations, web server technology, and SSL security * Experience with SaaS technologies such as microservices, docker/containers, and Kubernetes and proficiency with Bash/Ruby * Proficiency with software tools like Confluence, Jira, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Slack used to divide complex projects into related sub\-tasks, manage critical path tasks, and track resources, deadlines, and milestones **Basic Qualifications:** * College degree in a Computer Systems related field * Three years of demonstrated work experience in healthcare / pharmacy * In lieu of College Degree, applicants must meet all following requirements: High School Diploma/GED, Technical Certification in Information Systems / Technology, a minimum three years’ systems engineering experience within a healthcare technology or pharmacy systems **Preferred Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in a Computer Systems related field * 3\+ years of demonstrate project management work experience in healthcare / pharmacy * Pharmacy or clinical operations work experience * Experience with effectively presenting technical information to leadership * Experience with container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes * Strong Linux skills * High degree of competence in Bash and Shell * Ability to shift from one project to another in an agile work environment * Kubernetes distros such as OpenShift, RKE2 and/or Tanzu * Experience with Gitlab, Jenkins, Artifactory * Experience with server and or desktop virtualization * Virtualization Infrastructure Experience with VMware or similar virtualization tools * Networking experience – TCP/IP, DNS, NetBIOS, switching, routing, VLANs * Experience with at least one public cloud environment, such as Amazon Web Services or Microsoft Azure **Working Conditions** * Working across multiple time zones * Up to 10% travel * May be required to stand or sit for long periods of time Drug Screen: Not Required About Us At Omnicell, innovation starts with people who are passionate about making healthcare safer and smarter. Every improvement, every breakthrough, every idea is rooted in our belief that better is always possible. But what sets us apart isn’t just the work we do, it’s how we do it. jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: OVERVIEW \- US ONLY We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Full\-Stack Software Engineer to join a contractor program in supporting a critical customer engagement. This role is ideal for an engineer who can own features end to end across a React frontend, a Node.js service layer, and a PostgreSQL data model, and deploy and operate them on Google Cloud Platform with minimal oversight. The successful candidate will work closely with the Engagement Lead and Program Manager and customer stakeholders to ensure project success from initial definition through final delivery. **Required Credentials** ------------------------ * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience delivering production web applications * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Backend development in Java with Spring Boot, including REST API design, Spring Data JPA or an equivalent persistence layer, and Spring Security * Frontend development in React, including state management and integration with backend APIs * Working proficiency in Node.js for building and maintaining supporting services, including REST API design and one common framework (Express, Fastify, or NestJS) * Ability to translate Figma mockups into production React components * Relational data modeling in PostgreSQL, including authoring SQL queries, joins, and schema migrations * Writing unit tests and maintaining test coverage as part of the development workflow, using tools such as JUnit and Mockito on the Java side * Deployment and operation of applications on Google Cloud Platform (for example Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage) * Proficiency with Git\-based version control and pull request workflows **Useful Qualifications** ------------------------- * TypeScript across frontend and Node.js services * Build tooling for Java projects (Maven or Gradle) * Containerization with Docker * CI/CD pipeline configuration (Cloud Build or GitHub Actions) * Infrastructure as code with Terraform * Google Cloud certification (Associate Cloud Engineer or Professional Cloud Developer) * Integration and end\-to\-end testing experience beyond the unit level **Contractor Scope of Work Delivery Expectations** -------------------------------------------------- Below covers the scope of work we anticipate the contractor supporting throughout the project timeline. **Scope and Solution Expectations:** * Design and implement application features spanning the React frontend, the Spring Boot backend, and the PostgreSQL schema. * Build React components and views from Figma mockups provided by the design team. * Design and evolve the PostgreSQL data model, including authoring SQL and writing schema migrations. * Build and maintain the REST API layer between the frontend and the Spring Boot services. * Develop and maintain supporting Node.js services and their integration with the Spring Boot backend. * Write unit tests for new and modified code as part of the standard development workflow. * Deploy and configure application components on GCP, including runtime services, the managed database, and object storage. * Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines covering build, test, and deployment for both the Java and Node.js components. * Participate in working sessions with the engagement team and customer stakeholders to define requirements and technical approach. * Produce technical documentation covering architecture, API contracts, and the data model.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer II
jobs.description: **DevOps Engineer II** **Who We Are** OpenEye, the cloud video platform company, provides solutions for video security, business intelligence, and loss prevention. For over 20 years, OpenEye has been committed to developing an easy\-to\-use, comprehensive video management system backed by Heroic Customer Service® and support. Our on\-site and cloud\-based products can be found protecting schools, hospitals, banks, retail stores, and other facilities worldwide. OpenEye's solutions are available globally through our trusted network of certified service providers. OpenEye is a subsidiary of Alarm.com. Learn more at www.openeye.net . OpenEye is proud to be one of the 2023 Best Places to Work in the Inland Northwest. Ready to join a casual, fun, and creative culture? Apply to join our team! **Job Summary** OpenEye is seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Engineer II to play a key role in our DevOps Engineering Team. In this individual contributor role, you will drive up to production\-level DevOps tasks, contribute technical expertise, and add significant value to our organization. The ideal candidate is a strong programmer or scripter, excels in working within a collaborative team, and operates independently in complex operational and production environments. As a DevOps Engineer II, you will be responsible for the managing the cloud environment, assisting developers with the release and deployment of software, building, maintaining, and monitoring the health of the environment using a combination of technical proficiencies, organizational aptitude and interpersonal skills, as well as learning and progressing with evolving technology, including advance agentic workflows. You'll leverage your expertise to improve our DevOps workflows, debug challenging issues, and ultimately independently oversee deployments and production systems. **Role and Responsibilities** * Maintain highly available AWS\-based infrastructure for global video and related services. * Provide recommendations for platform scalability, performance, and cost optimization. * Optimize CI/CD pipelines that deliver releases faster and more reliably. * Automate environment provisioning, system updates, and security patch workflows. * Collaborate with developers to containerize workloads and streamline service deployments. * Partner with the SRE team on advanced monitoring and alerting systems and to define and maintain service\-level objectives (SLOs) and ensure they are met consistently. * Utilize infrastructure patterns with security, scalability, and compliance in mind, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, and future certification readiness. * Assist in production deployments ensuring consistent adherence to compliance and operational procedures. * Diagnose live production issues, identify root causes, and ship fixes. * Assist with cloud cost optimization by refining resource allocation and scaling strategies. * Other duties as assigned. **The Tech Stack** AWS, Docker, K8s, Grafana, OTEL, Agentic AI, Git, GitOps, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, MySQL, CrateDB, and more. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience. * 2\+ years of DevOps or related experience. * Strong AWS knowledge, including scaling, networking, security, and automation. * Strong programming or scripting skills (Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or similar languages). * Experience with CI/CD systems, infrastructure as code, and monitoring tools. * Proven track record of troubleshooting production systems under pressure. * Strong communication skills for cross\-team collaboration. Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration\-related support, is not available for this position at this time. **The Perks!** * The pay range for this opportunity is $90,000\- $125,000 annually. In addition, this position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. * Employees are eligible to purchase company stock at a discounted rate * Collaborative, fun, creative culture where idea sharing is encouraged * Casual dress (Jeans are welcome!) * Medical, dental, vision \& prescription benefits starting day 1! Generous medical plan subsidy and health savings account option with company contribution helps keep your costs low. * Up to $5,000 annual company match for 401k * Company paid short\-term/long\-term disability, AD\&D and life insurance * Paid maternity and paternity leave * 15 Days of Paid Vacation accrued per year (increases after year 3\) * 7 Paid Sick/Wellness days per year * 9 Paid Holidays per year * This position is eligible for a flexible hybrid work schedule * Educational Assistance Program covering non\-degree support, undergraduate and graduate degrees * Employee Equipment Program – Free Alarm.com system for your home! **About OpenEye:** OpenEye is a leading cloud video platform company delivering solutions for video security, business intelligence, and loss prevention. For over 20 years, we've been committed to creating easy to use, comprehensive video management systems backed by our signature Heroic Customer Service® and support. Our on\-premise and cloud products protect schools, hospitals, banks, retail stores, and other facilities worldwide, delivered through our trusted network of certified service providers. OpenEye is a subsidiary of Alarm.com. Learn more at www.openeye.net. **OpenEye is an Equal Opportunity Employer** In connection with your application, we collect information that identifies, reasonably relates to or describes you ("Personal Information"). The categories of Personal Information that we may collect include your name, government\-issued identification number(s), email address, mailing address, other contact information, emergency contact information, employment history, educational history, criminal record, and demographic information. We collect and use those categories of Personal Information about you for human resources and other business management purposes, including identifying and evaluating you as a candidate for potential or future employment or future positions, recordkeeping in relation to recruiting and hiring, conducting criminal background checks as permitted by law, conducting analytics, and ensuring compliance with applicable legal requirements and Company policies. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that we may retain some of the personal data that you provide in your application for our internal operations such as managing our recruitment system and ensuring that we comply with labor laws and regulations even after we have made our employment decision. **Notice To Third Party Agencies:** Alarm.com understands the value of professional recruiting services. However, we are not accepting resumes from recruiters or employment agencies for this position. In the event we receive a resume or candidate referral for this position from a third\-party recruiter or agency without a previously signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to you. If you are interested in working with Alarm.com, please email your company information and standard agreement to RecruitingPartnerships@Alarm.com. JR105755 \#LI\-RC1 \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Sr. Staff Applied AI Engineer (Tech Lead)
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. **About the role** ------------------ You'll be the first technical leader for AI at OpenLoop. You're joining the AI Platform pod as one of the earliest hires, which means the decisions you make now become the foundation everyone else builds on: how our AI agents run, how we know if they're actually good, how we keep them safe and affordable, and how other teams build on top of what you create. This pod will eventually split into two teams, AI Infrastructure and AI Tools, so we need someone who can go deep in at least two of the core AI engineering disciplines while staying credible across all of them. Until we hire an AI Principal Engineer, you'll also carry the long\-range technical direction for AI across the whole company. This is a hands\-on role. You'll write code and review designs, not just draw boxes on a whiteboard. You'll partner closely with the AI Engineering Manager, who owns people and delivery while you own architecture and technical quality. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Set the technical direction for agent runtime and orchestration: how agents call tools, hold context, and hand off work, and whether we build or adopt frameworks to do it * Build the evaluation systems that prove our AI is actually good, not just "seems to work," including regression tests and AI\-graded evals * Make the call on model access and operations: routing across providers, managing version upgrades, and planning for what happens when a provider goes down * Own observability and cost: tracing what agents did and why, and attributing AI spend so nobody gets a surprise bill * Build retrieval and grounding over real, messy company data so agents answer with facts, not guesses * Work with business and ops teams to turn human workflows into agent workflows, and decide what should always stay with a person * Keep patient data protected in every AI system you touch. This is healthcare, so security and privacy aren't optional * Make sound calls on cloud and data infrastructure (we run on GCP) and partner well with the Data Platform team * Raise the bar through code and design review, and mentor engineers who are new to AI * Explain AI trade\-offs in plain language to product, operations, and clinical stakeholders, including when the honest answer is "the AI isn't ready for this yet" **Who you are** --------------- * 12 or more years of software engineering experience, with real technical leadership experience (tech lead, staff, or principal\-level scope) * Two or more years building and running LLM\-based systems in production, not just demos or personal projects * Deep, hands\-on expertise in agent runtime or evaluation, plus working knowledge across the rest of the AI engineering stack * A track record of measuring AI quality with real evaluation methods and data, not vibes * Experience leading a small team's technical direction from zero, or close to it **Preferred** * Healthcare or other regulated\-industry experience (PHI, HIPAA) * GCP experience * Experience building an internal platform used by other engineering teams * Background in classic machine learning as well as LLMs * Experience scaling a team from a single pod into multiple teams **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation * Medical, Dental \& Vision * Flexible Spending / Health Savings Accounts * Generous PTO and hybrid\-work flexibility * 401(k) with Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet Insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.

jobs.title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About OpenLoop** ------------------ OpenLoop was co\-founded by CEO, Dr. Jon Lensing, and COO, Christian Williams, with the vision to bring care anywhere. Our telehealth support solutions are thoughtfully designed to streamline and simplify go\-to\-market care delivery for companies offering meaningful virtual support to patients across an expansive array of specialties, in all 50 states. **About the Role** ------------------ OpenLoop is the clinical and operational infrastructure that digital\-health brands, clinics and employers use to run virtual care across all 50 states. Our clients put their brand on the front end; everything behind it runs on us: clinicians, intake, scheduling, charting, pharmacy and fulfillment, payments and licensing. Clients reach that infrastructure through one client platform, from a no\-code storefront to a full Partner API, and our job is to make it effortless for them to adopt. Forward Deployed Engineering is how we build that platform with real clients instead of guessing. An FDE embeds with a client, works in the client's own codebase, and builds their integration against OpenLoop's production API. Whatever the client needs that the platform cannot do yet is filed as a platform gap and built once, centrally, so every client inherits it. The work product of an FDE is not the client's integration; it is the reusable asset that client forced into existence: a recipe others start from, an executable check behind every claim in our docs, a client manifest that makes the impact of any platform change computable, and the SDKs, agents and tooling that make the next deployment faster than the last. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer you take the deployments nobody else can, and you set the pattern the rest of the team runs. You are the technical architect of a pod: you own the client manifest, decide what is bespoke and what generalizes, are the one voice to our platform teams on API behaviour, and build the AI\-native tooling that lets one engineer carry two clients. You write production code in two places, the client's system and ours, and you tell our own sales team when a commitment should not be made. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build for clients, in their codebase, against our API. Embed with a client's engineering team and stand up their integration on OpenLoop's Partner API: their app, their data, their identity, their legacy systems. Own the outcome through go\-live and the weeks after it. Never wire around the platform: where the API falls short, file the gap with the endpoint it stands in for, and leave a dated, time\-boxed workaround at most. * Build AI SDKs and agentic solutions for clients. Design and ship the backend and frontend systems that let a client build on us with AI in the loop: SDKs and reference implementations, a CLI and machine\-readable docs a client can hand to their own coding agent, and agentic workflows on our API (intake, routing, support and refill journeys) with human review by design, evaluations before launch and monitoring after. * Architect and own the AI\-assisted way FDE works. Own the agent roster that runs our deployments: the tenant readiness gate, the conformance checks against a live tenant, seeding checkers, docs\-freshness and superseding drafts, gap filing, client communication drafts. Every agent output is a draft a human approves; you decide where the human sits and how you know the agent is right. * Build the systems that improve OpenLoop's API for everyone. Turn what one client needed into what every client gets: additive recipes and checks on the shared cookbook, client manifests and impact analysis, API conventions for how domain teams expose capabilities to clients, and the evidence that moves a recurring workaround into the platform roadmap. The measure is how much less of us the next client needs. * Turn ambiguity into a plan. Take a client ask that is over\-promised or self\-contradictory and produce a phased, defensible scope, with a clear statement of what we are not doing and what the API does not do yet. * Never undo prior work. Checks lock the claims we publish; manifests tell you who depends on what; edits are additive or explicitly superseding with a compatibility window. A change that would break a live client stops and becomes a proposal, not a merge. * Hold the line. Be the credible technical voice with client engineering leadership and internally: what we cannot do, what we should not do, and what will not fit the timeline are three different answers. * Raise the bar. Mentor FDEs and deployment strategists, calibrate how deployments are run, and help write the playbook for a team that is being built now. **Who You Are** --------------- * 10\+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time delivering directly for external customers or partners, in their environments, not only internal roadmap work. * Proven end\-to\-end ownership of complex, customer\-facing technical deliveries: you can name the deployments you ran, what went wrong, and what you did about it after launch. * Strong integration engineering depth: API design and consumption, auth, webhooks versus polling, idempotency, rate limits, pagination, schema drift, reconciliation, and comfort across the stack from APIs to data to cloud infrastructure. * You build with AI agents every day and can show how you verify what they produce, when you stop trusting them, and how you evaluate an LLM\-based system before it reaches a customer. * Experience handling sensitive data with a security\-first mindset, treating compliance constraints as design inputs rather than follow\-ups. * Excellent communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, including delivering unwelcome news to a customer early and keeping the relationship. * Demonstrated judgment about scope: you can point to things you descoped, sequenced or declined, and explain why. * Evidence of leverage beyond your own delivery: SDKs, tooling, checks, reference implementations or practices you built that made other people's work faster. **Preferred** * Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain where a mistake has consequences beyond a rollback. * Practical experience shipping LLM\-based or agentic systems to production, including how you measured quality and what you did when the model was confidently wrong. * Experience building developer platforms: SDKs, CLIs, API conventions, documentation that is tested rather than written. * Familiarity with EHR, scheduling, pharmacy or payments integrations; FHIR is a plus. * Experience working alongside sales or solutions teams in pre\-sales technical conversations without becoming a blocker. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **How You Work** OpenLoop's values are prescriptive, and this role tests all of them: * Disciplined Intensity: effective under real deadline pressure, and you build systems instead of becoming the only person who can fix things. * Do No Harm: patient safety and data integrity come first, and you know when to slow down to do it right. * Step In, Stay In: your ownership travels to the outcome, not to the handoff. * Purposeful Speed: you ship fast without leaving behind something only you can maintain. * Clarity Over Comfort: you say the thing, explain the why, and invite disagreement. Core collaboration hours are CST 8am to 5pm, with client\-facing work occasionally requiring flexibility outside them. Remote within the United States; periodic travel to clients and to team working sessions. **Our Benefits** ---------------- In addition, for salaried positions you would also be eligible for: * Medical, Dental, and Vision plans * Flexible Spending/Health Savings Accounts * Flexible PTO * 401(k) \+ Company Match * Life Insurance, Pet insurance, and more **Our Company** --------------- We have a relatively flat organizational structure here at OpenLoop. Everyone is encouraged to bring ideas to the table and make things happen. This fits in well with our core values of Autonomy, Competence and Belonging, as we want everyone to feel empowered and supported to do their best work. Sound like a good fit? We’d love to meet you.
