jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Rippling AI
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the role** ------------------ At Rippling, we're not just building AI features, we're building an autonomous operating system for work. We're investing heavily in the next generation of enterprise AI: intelligent background automation, systems that monitor and improve themselves, and a custom intelligence layer built on Rippling's unique data and workflows. The opportunity is to make Rippling's products fundamentally smarter and more autonomous over time, not through one\-off features, but through platform\-level infrastructure that compounds. You'll be joining the team that recently launched Rippling AI, the fastest\-growing product in Rippling's history. Every customer touchpoint, from onboarding to expense approvals to IT requests, is being rebuilt around agents, and the platform you build will be the foundation every AI surface at Rippling runs on. We're moving at startup speed with the reach of a category leader, and we're staffing this team like it's the most important bet at the company. As a Senior Engineer on AI Platform, you'll own meaningful technical initiatives end\-to\-end, drive architecture decisions within your scope, and collaborate closely with engineers across product, infra, and platform orgs. You'll work alongside some of the best engineers and product leaders at Rippling. This is a deeply hands\-on role where you'll be in the weeds of the code. **What you will do** -------------------- * Own end\-to\-end technical design and implementation for high\-impact AI platform initiatives from design through production * Collaborate closely with engineers across product, infra, and platform organizations * Build scalable agent infrastructure that automates repetitive, high\-frequency workflows across Rippling's product surface * Design systems that are observable, self\-correcting, and capable of improving over time with minimal human intervention * Develop harness and platform capabilities that encode business logic and institutional knowledge into reliable, automated workflows * Partner closely with Product to ensure AI\-powered surfaces are trustworthy, controllable, and intuitive for end users and admins * Mentor junior engineers, contribute to best practices for AI platform development, and raise the technical bar on your team * Track the frontier, translate model capability improvements into architectural decisions and move quickly when new approaches unlock better outcomes **What you will need** ---------------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering experience with a proven track record of owning and delivering complex technical projects * Strong expertise in platform and distributed systems engineering — you've built reliable, observable, large\-scale systems * Strong hands\-on coding skills; you are an active, high\-output contributor in the codebase * Experience driving technical initiatives end\-to\-end, including collaborating across teams to deliver outcomes * Strong product instincts — you translate ambiguous problems into durable platform capabilities and partner effectively with product teams * Clear, precise communication to diverse audiences, both written and verbal * Comfort with ambiguity and high velocity; the roadmap evolves as the technology evolves * Recent hands\-on experience building AI agents is a plus **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US San Francisco Bay Area) 168,000 \- 280,000 USD per year(US Tier 1\)

jobs.title: Growth Recruiter
jobs.description: **About Rox** ------------- Rox is an AI\-native B2B revenue intelligence company. We are a Series A startup under active construction. Seven months ago we were just under 60 people. Today we are closing in on 130\. We move fast, we ship constantly, and we build with the same AI\-native systems we sell to our customers. **About the Team** ------------------ Talent at Rox has been a team of one. That is about to change. We are hiring another full\-time member of the Talent team to lead Growth recruiting. This is not a sourcer\-only role. This is a full\-cycle Growth recruiter seat for someone who wants to run a desk alongside our Head of Talent — sourcing, interviewing, agencies, and candidate experience — without needing to own the function yet. **Location:** This role is based in our San Francisco office. You need to be in the office a minimum of three days a week. **Why This Role Is Growth\-Specific** ------------------------------------- At Rox, Growth means post\-sales. The roles you will recruit for sit after the deal closes and keep customers expanding with us: Growth Strategists, Forward Deployed Engineers, Data Science, InfoSec, and Customer Support. We want someone who already speaks that language walking in the door, not someone learning it on the job. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Run full\-cycle recruiting across Growth / post\-sales roles: Growth Strategists, Forward Deployed Engineers, Data Science, InfoSec, and Customer Support * Build and maintain sourcing pipelines using AI\-native tooling, not just job boards and cold outreach * Run structured interviews and contribute to hiring bar calibration * Manage agency and partner relationships end to end * Build and ship internal recruiting tools and automations (Claude, Ashby, Slack, Notion) * Keep reporting and pipeline visibility sharp for Growth hiring teams and leadership * Represent Rox at events, on calls, and in every candidate touchpoint as a face of the company * Get hands\-on with the Rox product itself, including regular dogfooding, so you can sell the mission with real conviction **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * Required: 1\+ year of professional experience, including 1\+ year of recruiting for post\-sales / Growth functions in an early\-stage startup. You have hired Growth Strategists, FDEs, Data Science, InfoSec, Customer Support, and/or adjacent customer\-facing talent — not adjacent general talent acquisition only. * Plus: Recruiting experience in an AI\-native or hyperscale SaaS environment. Scale, volume, and bar management are a plus on top of the early\-stage Growth requirement above. * **Growth fluency, not general recruiting fluency.** You know post\-sales org structures, the functions above, and the brands worth pulling from. That knowledge compounds into speed here. * **Operator or player first.** You do not wait for a lane to be defined, you build it. You have carried a desk, a number, or a pipeline yourself, not just watched one from a distance. * **High\-impact outlier.** You look for leverage everywhere and you are not precious about title or scope. * **Amazing human above all.** Rox is a small team doing a lot, and how you treat people matters as much as what you ship. * Comfort across the full stack of modern recruiting tools: Ashby, Slack, Notion, and AI\-native workflows built in Claude. * A track record of ownership, speed, craftsmanship, and learning velocity, the same bar we hold every candidate to at Rox. * **Real pull toward Rox specifically.** Between two similarly qualified candidates, the one who wants to be here, who has done the homework on the product and the mission, wins. Passion for what we're building is a genuine tiebreaker in this process. **Our Stack** ------------- Ashby, Slack, Notion, and a unique set of proprietary ai\-native tools. (shhh) **Compensation** ---------------- Base salary range: **$180,000 – $250,000 USD**. Total compensation includes benefits, stock options, and perks. **A Note on How We Hire** ------------------------- At Rox, we evaluate for ownership, client obsession, craftsmanship, speed, pivot ability, collaboration, cross\-functional impact, systems thinking, and learning velocity. We expect this role, more than any other, to embody that bar. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Software Engineer (SE/Senior/Staff)
jobs.description: Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission. By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale. With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order. Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures. You own the architecture, lead initiatives that span teams, set the standard for how the team builds with agents, and grow senior engineers into stronger technical decision\-makers **What You'll Need** ==================== * 3 to 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and running production software * Hands\-on experience building software with agentic workflows: using AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) to take work from requirements through planning, coding, testing, and deployment * A solid grasp of agentic development basics: giving agents good context, breaking work into plans, and verifying output instead of trusting it * Strong engineering fundamentals: system design, data modeling, APIs, testing, and debugging in production * The ability to work confidently in our core languages with agents. jobs.title: Senior GenAI Engineer — AI Enablement & Agentic Systems-1
jobs.description: **Position Summary** Samsung Ads focuses on enabling brands to connect with Samsung audiences across all devices. As an international company, Engineers at Samsung work on big complex projects with stakeholders and teams located around the globe. Our purpose is to deliver unparalleled results for our customers. Samsung Ads uniquely transforms the advertising landscape by using comprehensive data to build the world’s most intelligent connected audience platform. We deliver on Samsung Electronics’ 51\-year commitment to excellence through smart, easy, effective advertising solutions to make advanced video advertising work. **Role and Responsibilities** **What you will do** -------------------- As a Senior GenAI Engineer, you will be the hands\-on driving force behind AI\-powered productivity and automation across Samsung Ads. Reporting to the IT Director, you will work directly with non\-technical teams across every department to identify, build, deploy, and scale Generative AI solutions that fundamentally improve how people work. You will partner closely with a dedicated Product Owner and the Principal Architect from Engineering to shape and execute our GenAI enablement roadmap. While Engineering builds core platform capabilities, your focus is on the last mile — putting powerful, safe, and practical AI tools directly into the hands of business users. A critical dimension of this role is **designing and orchestrating agentic AI workflows** — multi\-step, autonomous processes where AI agents plan, reason, use tools, and execute complex tasks with minimal human intervention. As enterprises shift from simple prompt\-based AI interactions toward agentic architectures, you will be responsible for identifying where autonomous AI workflows can replace manual, multi\-step business processes — and building them safely within Samsung's governance framework. You are expected to be opinionated, delivery\-oriented, and security\-conscious in everything you do. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design, build, and deploy GenAI\-powered automation and productivity solutions for business teams across Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR, Legal, and Operations. * **Architect and implement complex agentic workflows** that enable AI agents to autonomously handle multi\-step business processes — including task decomposition, tool orchestration, decision\-making loops, and human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints where required. * **Design and maintain multi\-agent orchestration patterns** , where specialized AI agents collaborate on complex tasks such as document analysis, research synthesis, data transformation, and cross\-system process automation. * Serve as the primary hands\-on technical resource for our AI tooling ecosystem, including **AWS Bedrock, Claude, AnythingLLM** , and our homegrown GenAI platform built on open\-source tools. * Identify high\-impact use cases through direct engagement with business stakeholders, translating pain points into practical AI\-driven workflows — with a specific focus on **processes that benefit from autonomous, adaptive execution rather than simple prompt\-response interactions** . * Build and maintain custom AI agents, prompt chains, RAG pipelines, and integrations tailored to departmental needs. * **Integrate agentic AI workflows with existing enterprise applications and business systems** (e.g., CRM, HRIS, finance tools, collaboration platforms) to enable end\-to\-end process automation across departments. * **Define guardrails, escalation paths, and human oversight mechanisms** for agentic workflows to ensure autonomous AI actions remain safe, auditable, and aligned with Samsung's internal policies. * **Develop evaluation frameworks for AI tools and agentic systems** based on production requirements — including accuracy benchmarks, latency, cost\-per\-task, and compliance criteria — not vendor demos. * Evaluate and recommend new AI tools and vendors in collaboration with the Architecture team, including hands\-on proof\-of\-concepts to support build\-vs\-buy decisions. * Ensure every AI solution deployed adheres to **Samsung's internal security and privacy policies** , including data classification requirements mandated by HQ (South Korea). * Proactively assess data exposure risks of any AI tool or workflow before deployment and maintain a clear inventory of all AI tools, their data flows, and classification levels. * Define and track KPIs for every AI initiative: workflows automated, hours saved, adoption rates, and user satisfaction. * Develop training sessions, documentation, and self\-service resources to accelerate AI adoption among non\-technical users. *(Nice\-to\-have)* **Required Skills And Experience** ---------------------------------- * **3\+ years of hands\-on experience** with Generative AI tools and platforms, with a proven track record of delivering successful productivity or automation projects adopted by real users. * **5\+ years of experience** in IT, automation  any audience. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent practical experience). **Nice\-to\-Have** ------------------ * Experience with **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** for building tool\-integrated AI agents at scale. * Experience integrating AI workflows with **enterprise business systems** (Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, Workday, or similar). * Background in **Ad Tech** or experience working in a digital advertising environment. * Familiarity with **change management frameworks** and delivering training/enablement programs at scale. * Experience navigating **multinational corporate governance** structures (especially APAC\-headquartered companies). * Relevant certifications: **AWS AI Practitioner, AWS ML Specialty, Anthropic Claude certification** , or equivalent. * Experience building or managing **AI Centers of Excellence** or similar enablement functions. * Fluency in Korean. **Skills and Qualifications** **Why This Role Is Different** ------------------------------ Unlike GenAI roles buried inside engineering orgs building internal tooling, this position puts you at the center of a company\-wide AI transformation. You will have direct visibility with business leadership, a mandate to move fast, and the autonomy to shape how an entire organization works with AI. You won't be optimizing model benchmarks — you'll be measured on **business impact** . Workflows automated. Hours saved. Teams empowered. Processes reinvented. If you've been looking for a role where Generative AI meets real\-world business problems at scale, and where you have the freedom to be opinionated about how to solve them, this is it. If you're interested in joining a growing team building an outstanding, world\-class advertising organization with a relentless focus on design and customer experience, you've come to the right place! jobs.title: Estimator
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** This is the seat where Tideview's heavy civil division gets built — and the person who fills it is expected to grow into leading it. You will own preconstruction end to end: soliciting and leveling subcontractor and supplier pricing, running takeoffs, assembling bids in B2W Estimate, HeavyBid or Hard Dollar, and tracking every opportunity from advertisement through award. The work spans both sides of this market — public infrastructure for FDOT, county and municipal owners, and private commercial and multi\-family site development for developers and general contractors. You will report directly to the President of Tideview Construction Group — no layers, no filtered information, a direct line to the person making the go/no\-go call on every job we chase. That access is the point. Estimators who can price storm, utility, roadway and commercial site development work accurately and then stand behind those numbers in the field are the people who become Chief Estimators, Preconstruction Managers and Division Presidents. We are hiring for that arc deliberately, not as a consolation for a long tenure. As the division grows, the person who priced the work and helped buy it out is the natural candidate to run it. Location: St. Augustine, FL corporate office (on\-site) Reports to: President, Tideview Construction Group Type: Full\-time, exempt Position Summary The Heavy Civil Estimator owns the preconstruction process for storm drainage, underground utility, roadway, commercial and multi\-family site development projects from bid advertisement through buyout and handoff to operations. Day to day, that means reading plans and specifications, developing quantities and takeoffs, soliciting and qualifying subcontractor and supplier proposals, building crew\- and production\-based unit costs in bidding software, and assembling complete, competitive bids. After award, you stay with the job through buyout — writing scopes, locking in pricing, and supporting senior field leadership with submittals, design changes, delivery coordination and payment requisitions. This is not a back\-office pricing role. You will be in the plans, on the phone with vendors, in the trailer with superintendents, and in the room when Tideview decides which work to chase. Preconstruction and Estimating * Review plans, specifications, geotechnical reports, permits and contract documents to identify scope, exclusions, constructability issues and risk before pricing begins * Perform and assist with quantity takeoffs for storm drainage, water and sewer, roadway, earthwork, grading, paving, MOT and site restoration * Estimate commercial and multi\-family site development packages — mass and fine grading, building pads, wet and dry utilities, storm systems and ponds, parking lots and drive aisles, curb and sidewalk, hardscape and site concrete * Build estimates in B2W Estimate, HCSS HeavyBid or Hard Dollar using crew compositions, equipment spreads and production rates — not lump\-sum guesswork * Solicit, log and level subcontractor and supplier quotations; confirm scope coverage, unit pricing, escalation, lead times and bonding capacity * Develop and maintain a historical cost database from completed jobs so that unit pricing reflects what Tideview actually produces in the field * Price general conditions, indirect costs, equipment, temporary works, dewatering, sheeting and shoring, testing, and site\-specific risk allowances * Prepare quantity and pricing comparisons against the owner's engineer's estimate and against prior bid history for the same agency or developer * Attend pre\-bid meetings and site visits; document existing conditions, access constraints, utility conflicts, staging and haul routes * Issue and respond to RFIs during the bid period and incorporate addenda and revised civil plan sets into the estimate before bid close * Recommend alternates, value engineering and means\-and\-methods changes that improve competitiveness without transferring unpriced risk to Tideview — a lever that matters especially on negotiated private work Bid Management and Tracking * Own the bid calendar: monitor FDOT, county, municipal, utility authority and private plan rooms, and field invitations to bid from developers and general contractors on commercial and multi\-family projects, for work that fits Tideview's capabilities and prequalification * Maintain the bid log — project, owner, engineer, bid date, estimated value, go/no\-go decision, bid amount, apparent low bidder and spread — and report status to the President on a standing cadence * Prepare and present go/no\-go recommendations that weigh backlog, crew availability, geography, competition, bonding and margin potential * Assemble complete bid packages: bid bonds, qualification statements, DBE/MBE participation forms, unit price schedules, acknowledgment of addenda and all owner\-required forms * Run bid day — collect and level late quotes, update the estimate, finalize markup wit involvement, not the end of it. The estimator who priced the job carries the intent of that estimate into execution. * Lead the buyout phase: convert bid\-day quotes into executed subcontracts and purchase orders with airtight scope, schedule, insurance and retainage terms * Negotiate final pricing on material, pipe, structures, aggregate, site concrete and specialty subcontracts; confirm quantities, delivery windows and price\-hold periods * Conduct the estimate\-to\-operations turnover: walk the project team through the bid assumptions, production rates, crew build\-ups, quantities, allowances and known risks * Support senior field leadership with submittals and shop drawings, tracking review status against procurement lead times * Verify design changes and plan revisions against the contract quantities; identify and price change orders, extra work and differing site conditions early * Coordinate material deliveries against the schedule so crews are not waiting on pipe, structures or aggregate * Assist with monthly payment requisitions — quantity verification, stored materials, subcontractor pay applications and lien waivers * Participate in job cost reviews with the President and field leadership, comparing actual production and cost against the estimate Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering or a related field — or a minimum of five years of progressive heavy civil estimating experience in lieu of a degree * Demonstrated command of storm drainage, underground utility and roadway bidding — you can price a drainage structure schedule, a water and sewer run and a roadway typical section without supervision * Exposure to commercial and multi\-family site development bidding — grading, site utilities, ponds, parking and site concrete priced off a civil plan set rather than an agency pay item list * Hands\-on experience producing complete bids in commercial estimating software * Fluency in reading civil plans, cross sections, profiles, details and technical specifications * Working knowledge of public bidding procedures — addenda, bid bonds, unit price contracts, DBE participation, prequalification and award protest windows — and of private bid formats, including lump sum proposals, developer bid forms and AIA or ConsensusDocs subcontract terms * Proficiency in quantity takeoff — digital takeoff software and the judgment to sanity\-check what the software reports * Strong Excel skills and comfort building and auditing cost models * Ability to manage several bids with overlapping deadlines and deliver each one complete and on time * Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites, pre\-bid meetings and site visits within the region * Able to walk active construction sites and job corridors in Florida field conditions Preferred Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Construction Management or Civil Engineering * Direct experience in B2W Estimate, HCSS HeavyBid or Hard Dollar (now InEight Estimate) — these are the tools this role runs on * FDOT/Public experience: Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Construction, * Private development experience — bidding site packages to national and regional multi\-family developers, commercial general contractors, retail and industrial owners, and working through site plan approval, SJRWMD and local environmental permitting conditions * Northeast Florida market knowledge — St. Johns, Duval, Flagler, Clay and Putnam counties, plus JEA, St. Johns County Utility Department and municipal utility standards * Established subcontractor and supplier relationships in the region * Familiarity with digital takeoff platforms (Agtek, InSite, Trimble Business Center, Bluebeam Revu) * Experience estimating in a jobs.title: Electrical Engineering, Repair & Quality Operations Manager
jobs.description: **Socomec Group** (Socomec) is a global leader in electrical equipment engineering and manufacturing, specialized in low voltage energy performance. **Socomec North America** (NAM) is Socomec’s organization overseeing all operations in North America. **About This Role** The Repair and Quality Center Manager leads the North American Repair and Quality Center within the Expert Services organization. The role owns the return lifecycle from receipt through technical evaluation and final disposition, including repair, refurbishment, root cause analysis, return material authorization coordination, and controlled scrap. The manager ensures accurate documentation, traceability, and reporting of return status, test results, technical findings, disposition decisions, and corrective\-action progress. The manager develops the center as the primary North American resolution point for returned equipment and repairable components. The role converts return, repair, and parts\-usage data into actionable analysis; identifies recurring or epidemic failure patterns; and coordinates evidence\-based escalation with business\-line quality leaders, engineering, vendors, overseas factories, and service leadership. This includes reviewing and driving vendor and factory RCA and 8D responses through corrective\-action closure. Business\-line quality leaders retain product\-quality governance; this role provides the return intelligence and case management needed for timely decisions. Safety and Operational Philosophy The center handles electrical and electronic assemblies that may contain stored energy, damaged components, unknown failure conditions, or incomplete field information. The manager is accountable for appropriate lockout and tagout, electrical safe\-work practices, electrostatic\-discharge controls, test\-bench safeguards, material handling, and approved repair procedures. Production pressure, customer urgency, turnaround commitments, or cost considerations do not justify bypassing safety controls, unsupported repair decisions, or untraceable disposition. The manager must protect people and evidence, maintain configuration and material traceability, and stop, quarantine, or escalate work that exceeds approved capability or authorization. **Key Responsibilities And Accountabilities** * Leads the safe, compliant, and effective operation of the North American Repair and Quality Center, including personnel, workload, work areas, test equipment, repair processes, material controls, and daily operating priorities. * Owns the complete lifecycle of customer and technician returns from receipt through technical evaluation and documented disposition, including return for repair, refurbishment, root cause analysis, supplier or factory review, return to stock, or controlled scrap. * Develops repair capability for approved repairable components by establishing test methods, acceptance criteria, work instructions, spare\-parts support, technician authorization, and quality controls that produce safe and repeatable repairs. * Builds the center to resolve at least 80 percent of eligible return cases within North America before factory or engineering escalation, while maintaining defined escalation criteria and complete technical evidence for cases requiring higher\-level support. * Manages customer and field\-service return material authorizations across business lines, ensuring clear case ownership, accurate status communication, timely disposition, and coordination of operational priorities with Service, Logistics, Sales, and business\-line stakeholders. * Analyzes parts usage, failure modes, repair findings, no\-fault\-found returns, repeat failures, and return trends to identify emerging or epidemic issues and provide business\-line quality leaders with actionable evidence and recommended containment or corrective actions. * Leads or coordinates structured root cause analysis for returned products and components, determines when factory or engineering involvement is required, and ensures escalation packages include failure history, test results, configuration data, photographs, parts information, and other relevant evidence. * Recruits, develops, and leads repair and return personnel while establishing performance measures, capacity plans, documentation standards, cross\-training, and continuous\-improvement priorities that allow the center to scale with the North American installed base. **Essential Qualifications, Experience, And Skills** * Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering required. * Typically 7 or more years of progressive experience in quality engineering, electrical or power\-electronics engineering, product support, repair operations, reliability, manufacturing quality, or mission\-critical technical service. * Demonstrated quality\-engineering experience with returned\-product analysis, nonconformance management, corrective action, root cause analysis, failure trending, or RMA processes required. * Demonstrated exp nical boundaries. * Strong data\-analysis capability using ERP, quality, service, spreadsheet, and business\-intelligence tools to track failure patterns, turnaround, repair yield, and cost. * Clear technical communication and timely decision\-making under pressure while preserving safety, evidence quality, procedural compliance, and escalation integrity. **Repair and Quality Center Manager Expectations** * This is an onsite leadership role based at the Suwanee, Georgia manufacturing plant. The position operates within Expert Services and works closely with plant functions while supporting North American customers and all business lines. * Work is performed in office, warehouse, manufacturing, electrical test, and component\-repair environments. Required personal protective equipment and electrostatic\-discharge controls must be used as applicable. * The role may provide technical or operational support outside normal business hours when significant customer, safety, quality, or return events require leadership attention. * Travel within North America and occasional international travel may be required for factory coordination, supplier or customer review, training, audits, or capability development; expected travel is generally up to 20 percent. * A valid driver license and the ability to obtain and maintain a valid passport are required. * Successful completion of applicable pre\-employment screening, background checks, and site\-access requirements is required. **Physical Demands** * Mobility: Ability to move throughout office, warehouse, manufacturing, repair, and test environments; work may involve standing, walking, climbing, bending, or kneeling for extended periods. * Stationary Work: Ability to remain seated or standing for prolonged periods while reviewing data, conducting technical evaluations, observing tests, or completing documentation. * Manual Dexterity: Ability to use computers, test equipment, hand tools, and small components when supporting inspection, evaluation, or repair activities. * Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift, carry, or move items weighing up to 50 pounds on an occasional basis. * Visual and Auditory Requirements: Ability to inspect components, read technical documents and computer screens, observe test activity, and communicate effectively in office and plant environments. * Travel: Ability to travel by vehicle and commercial transportation and to work at factories, supplier locations, customer sites, or other company facilities as required. **Compensation range: $95,000 – $105,000** \#LI\-YZW Upon request, we will provide reasonable accommodation for disabilities to support participation of candidates in all aspects of the recruitment process. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin. All applications are reviewed directly by the Socomec North America Talent Acquisition team and other human reviewers. No automated or AI‑based systems are used to make decisions in the application review process. Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Are you authorized to work in the United States/Canada without current or future employer sponsorship? * Do you hold a Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering? * Please describe your experience with UPS systems, power electronics, battery systems, power distribution equipment, or other mission\-critical power infrastructure. * How many years do you have managing a repair center, quality organization, or technical service team. * Please describe your experience working within an ISO 9001 quality management system, including your involvement with corrective actions, audits, continuous improvement initiatives, and root cause investigations. Work Location: In person

optimization, and observability across real\-time and domain service architectures. **Our Architecture \& Tech Stack** You will work directly across our modern retail banking ecosystem: * Client Applications: Angular SPAs (Admin Portal, In\-Branch Kiosks, Queue Displays, Remote Check\-In, Surveys, Analytics). * Edge \& Real\-Time: BFF Orchestrator APIs and SignalR\-style MessageHub for jobs.title: Mine Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us:** Solidus Resources is a U.S.\-based gold development company backed by Waterton Mining. The company is focused on advancing the Spring Valley Gold Project in Pershing County, Nevada, and specializes in taking high potential gold assets through late\-stage development and into production. Solidus applies a technically rigorous, capital\-disciplined approach to mine development, with a strong emphasis on environmental stewardship, operational safety, and community engagement. The Spring Valley Gold Project is located in the prolific Humboldt Range, an area with approximately 60 million ounces of gold endowment within a 50\-mile radius. Envisioned as a long\-life, low\-cost open\-pit, heap\-leach operation, Spring Valley has a robust resource base and considerable exploration upside along a 7\-mile strike length across the Black Ridge fault zone. With a leadership team experienced in engineering, permitting, and large\-scale project execution, Solidus Resources is advancing Spring Valley through feasibility, permitting, and construction, with a clear path toward operational readiness. The company’s goal is to responsibly unlock the value of U.S.\-based gold assets while building a reputation for excellence in project delivery and sustainable development. **This position is located on\-site at our mine in Lovelock, NV.** The Mine Engineer provides technical engineering support for the safe, efficient, and cost\-effective operation of an open\-pit gold mine. This role supports mine planning, production scheduling, drill\-and\-blast design, ore control, geotechnical monitoring, and operational performance analysis. Working closely with Operations, Geology, Survey, Processing, Maintenance, and Environmental teams, the Mine Engineer develops practical mine plans, monitors mining performance, and identifies opportunities to improve safety, productivity, cost, and gold recovery. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop short\- and medium\-term mine plans, designs, schedules, sequences, and equipment requirements aligned with production targets and the life\-of\-mine plan. * Monitor mine\-to\-plan performance and reconcile tonnes, grades, material movement, and equipment productivity. * Design and coordinate drill\-and\-blast programs to support safe, efficient mining and effective fragmentation. * Maintain designs for haul roads, pit access, stockpiles, waste dumps, and related mine infrastructure. * Coordinate with Geology and Grade Control to manage ore delineation, routing, blending, dilution, and recovery. * Analyze production data, operating costs, and key performance indicators to identify improvement opportunities. * Review geotechnical monitoring data and coordinate actions to address potential ground\-control risks. * Support survey activities, validate designs against field conditions, and conduct regular field inspections. * Prepare forecasts, technical reports, presentations, and regulatory documentation. * Participate in safety, risk assessment, incident investigation, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Collaborate across departments to achieve production, safety, environmental, and business objectives. **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering or a related discipline. * 3\-5 years of engineering experience in open\-pit mining, preferably gold. * Experience with mine planning, scheduling, design, drill\-and\-blast, and ore control. * Proficiency with Vulcan, MineSight, Deswik, or similar mine\-planning software. * Knowledge of open\-pit mining methods, material movement, grade control, and stockpile management. * Experience with geotechnical monitoring and slope management is an asset. * Strong analytical, organizational, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and production reporting tools. * Ability to perform regular fieldwork in an active mine environment. **The pay range for this role is:** 95,000 \- 110,000 USD per year(US)

jobs.title: IT Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Collectivus Holdings is a dynamic business group encompassing brands many of the most prestigious brands in the Collecting, Trading Card Game, and Hobby industries. With a century's worth of collective experience in driving product and service innovation, high\-end quality standards, and elevated customer experience, Collectivus brands are among the most recognized and loved throughout the world by the communities they serve. **Website:** https://www.collectivusholdings.com **Locations:** Nashville – Garland – Aarhus – Lisbon – Worldwide **Job Title:** IT Systems Engineer I **Location:** Garland, Texas (Hybrid) Collectivus Holdings is seeking an IT Systems Engineer I to join our IT Operations team, supporting core enterprise systems across our family of business units. This role serves as a Level II escalation resource, working beyond frontline troubleshooting to administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, endpoint management, and identity/access systems that keep the business running. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with the initiative to automate recurring work, strengthen documentation, and build the capability of the broader support team. This role partners closely with IT leadership and business stakeholders across the organization to keep core systems secure, available, and performing to standard. **Responsibilities** * Contribute to Level I support and serve as an escalation resource for issues beyond frontline troubleshooting, resolving complex hardware, software, network, and systems problems. * Administer and maintain core enterprise systems, including Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive), Entra ID, and Single Sign\-On/identity federation, ensuring availability, security, and performance across all business units. * Support identity and access management for assigned systems, assisting with SSO, MFA, and Conditional Access configuration, and handling user/group provisioning across core systems. * Support endpoint management and device lifecycle through MDM tooling (e.g., JAMF), ensuring consistent configuration, security posture, and compliance across company devices. * Contribute to infrastructure project execution, including system migrations, platform upgrades, and new technology integrations, partnering with IT leadership to scope and deliver on time. * Monitor system health and performance proactively, using available tooling to catch and remediate issues before they escalate into outages or tickets. * Develop automation (PowerShell, Power Automate, scripting) to streamline provisioning, system administration, and recurring operational work. * Partner with Security to apply patching, respond to vulnerability findings, and support endpoint security tooling (e.g., Huntress, Rapid7\) across the environment. * Support disaster recovery execution for assigned systems, assisting with backup testing, validating recovery procedures, and maintaining runbooks. * Build and maintain system\-level documentation, including configuration standards, architecture notes, and technical runbooks, to support consistency and reduce single\-person dependencies. * Provide technical guidance to the Support Specialist team on advanced troubleshooting, helping build team capability and reduce recurring escalation volume over time. * Recommend system enhancements in collaboration with IT and business stakeholders, tying technical decisions back to reliability and user experience. * Provide occasional on\-site support and coverage during company events or after\-hours as needed, including occasional travel to Collectivus Holdings locations. **Key KPIs / Metrics** * Escalation Resolution Time: Average time to resolve issues escalated from Level I support. * Escalation Closure Rate: Percentage of escalated issues resolved without further escalation to senior engineering, vendor, or outside support. * Core System Uptime/Availability: Uptime percentage for owned systems (Microsoft 365, Entra ID/SSO, endpoint management). * Access \& Provisioning Turnaround Time: Average time to complete SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, and system\-level user/group provisioning requests. * Provisioning Accuracy Rate: Percentage of access/identity changes completed without error or rework. * Device Compliance Rate: Percentage of MDM\-managed devices meeting configuration and security standards. * Patch \& Vulnerability Remediation Time: Average time to remediate flagged vulnerabilities or apply required patches within SLA. * Project Task Completion Rate: Percentage of assigned infrastructure project tasks/milestones completed on schedule. * Recurring Issue Rate: Frequency of repeat incidents tied to owned systems, indicating opportunities for permanent fixes. * Automation Impact: Number of automation workflows/scripts delivered and estimated hours saved. * Backup \& DR Validation Completion Rate: Percentage of scheduled backup tests/DR exercises completed successfully for assigned systems. * Documentation Currency: Percentage of owned systems with up\-to\-date runbooks, configuration standards, and technical documentation. * After\-Hours/On\-Call Response Compliance: Adherence to on\-call rotation and responsiveness during off\-hours incidents. **Skills \& Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent work experience. * 3\+ years of experience in systems administration, IT support, or infrastructure engineering, with direct experience administering Microsoft 365 and Entra ID. * Hands\-on experience with identity and access management, including SSO, MFA, and Conditional Access. * Experience with MDM/endpoint management tooling (e.g., JAMF) across a mixed device environment. * Working knowledge of PowerShell and Power Automate, or comparable scripting/automation tools. * Familiarity with endpoint security and vulnerability management tooling (e.g., Huntress, Rapid7\). * Experience supporting disaster recovery activities, including backup testing and runbook maintenance. * Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical documentation. * Ability to mentor junior support staff and communicate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to participate in an on\-call rotation and respond to incidents after hours. * Willingness to travel occasionally to Collectivus Holdings locations as needed. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: IT Security Engineer II
jobs.description: Overview: The Security Engineer II is a mid\-level individual contributor responsible for implementing, administering, and maintaining the security controls that protect Sprouts' stores, systems, and data. Working across areas such as email, identity, endpoint, data, cloud, and network security, the role operates assigned security platforms following architectures, policies, and standards established by senior security engineers and architects. The role executes approved changes, responds to assigned security incidents and requests, performs audit\-related security controls, and serves as an escalation point for Security Analysts and the Service Desk. Responsibilities include a mix of recurring operational activities, compliance support, incident response, and project\-based implementation work. Within established procedures, the Security Engineer II independently manages alert triage, remediation of compliance issues, and routine changes or exception requests within approved authority levels. ***The role reports to our Store Support Office in Phoenix, AZ, with a hybrid work arrangement requiring in\-office presence Tuesday through Thursday.*** Essential Functions: Security Engineering \& Implementation* Implement and modify enterprise security controls across the network, endpoint, cloud, identity, email, and data protection domains, to designs and standards set by the Security Engineer III and the IT Security Architect. * Assess systems and security tooling, including Microsoft Azure workloads, against hardening baselines and CIS benchmarks; determine the remediation required; and implement approved changes. * Configure proof\-of\-concept environments for security technologies under evaluation, run the agreed validation testing, and document capabilities, limitations, and results. * Prepare and implement approved security platform changes through the enterprise change\-management process, including test plans, rollback procedures, and post\-implementation validation. Security Operations \& Threat Management* Analyze security alerts and logs across email, endpoint, identity, network, and data protection tooling, including CrowdStrike NG\-SIEM, and determine disposition against the documented severity matrix. * Handle assigned security incidents and requests in ServiceNow through documented response procedures and approval limits: scope the event, coordinate containment and remediation, capture evidence, and document the outcome. Serve as the escalation point for security incidents and requests raised by the Security Analyst I and the Service Desk, and escalate decisions that fall outside those limits to the Security Engineer III or the Manager. * Troubleshoot and restore security tooling, including agents, connectors, log feeds, and data integrations: diagnose failures, remediate coverage gaps, and escalate faults that require a platform change by the owning team. * Use and adapt the team's existing PowerShell and Python scripts, saved queries, and scheduled reports for recurring work in this role's scope, with support from senior engineering staff where needed, and identify manual work that would benefit from a durable integration. Identity, Endpoint \& Data Protection* Administer identity security controls in Okta and Microsoft Entra ID within approved policy, including SSO and SAML application assignment, SCIM provisioning, MFA enrollment and factor resets, conditional access group assignment, and access request fulfillment. * Manage endpoint security agent health, coverage, and compliance across CrowdStrike Falcon, BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management, Microsoft Intune, Kandji, and Tanium: investigate compliance failures, determine remediation, apply approved policy, and assess exception requests against documented criteria. * Analyze data loss prevention, email security, and information protection alerts in Microsoft Purview, Proofpoint, and Netskope, act on them within documented response procedures, and approve quarantine release, safe\-list, and exception requests within documented approval limits. * Manage credential, certificate, key, and secrets records in the enterprise vault; execute scheduled rotation and recovery verification; and conduct privileged, service, and user access reviews on the published schedule, tracking exceptions to closure. Security Governance, Risk \& Compliance* Execute recurring security control activities on schedule, including tool health checks, access and configuration reviews, policy audits, and key rotations, and compile the control evidence used in SOX IT general controls, PCI DSS, and NIST CSF reviews. * Run scheduled vulnerability assessments using CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight and related tooling, analyze the findings, determine remediation priority with system owners, and report status and aging findings. * Complete vendor, supplier, and third\-party security reviews; assess findings against the review criteria; escalate risks that require a mitigation deci  another secure email gateway, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC administration * CrowdStrike Falcon * BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management, or equivalent privileged access and endpoint privilege management tooling * Microsoft Purview * AI and large language model security, including application discovery and data\-egress controls * SIEM and security monitoring platforms * Microsoft Intune, Kandji, and Tanium * Windows Server administration * Windows 10/11 endpoint management * ServiceNow (ITSM and SecOps) * PowerShell and Python scripting * Network security technologies, including firewalls, NAC, and Zero Trust concepts * Producing control evidence for SOX IT general controls, PCI DSS, or NIST CSF reviews * Retail, grocery, or other multi\-site operational environments **Preferred Certifications*** One professional\-level security certification, such as CompTIA Security\+, CompTIA CySA\+, (ISC)² SSCP, a GIAC certification, or Microsoft SC\-200 or AZ\-500 * A vendor certification on any of the platforms listed above * ITIL 4 knowledge No certification is required for this role. **Core Competencies*** Communication * Customer Focus * Driving for Results * Positive Approach Benefits: In addition to a rewarding career, Sprouts offers a comprehensive program to help support you and your family. These programs include:* Competitive pay * Sick time plan that you can use to support you or your immediate families health * Vacation accrual plan * Opportunities for career growth * 15% discount for you and one other family member in your household on all purchases made at Sprouts * Flexible schedules * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * 401(K) Retirement savings plan with a generous company match * Company paid life insurance * Contests and appreciation events throughout the year full of prizes, food and fun! Eligibility requirements may apply for the following benefits:* Bonus based on company and/or individual performance * Affordable benefit coverage, including medical, dental and vision * Health Savings Account with company match * Pre\-tax Flexible Spending Accounts for healthcare and dependent care * Company paid short\-term disability coverage * Paid parental leave for both mothers and fathers * Paid holidays **Get Paid Every Day!** Sprouts Farmers Market offers DailyPay \- if you’re hired as an eligible employee, you’ll be able to **transfer the money you’ve already earned at no extra cost, and get it the next business day, for free**. We offer DailyPay so you don’t have to wait for payday to access the money you’ve already worked for. With DailyPay, you can see how much you’ve made every day and you can transfer your money any time before payday. You can learn more by visiting **https://www.dailypay.com/partners/sprouts\-farmers\-market/****.** Why Sprouts: **Grow with us!** If you have a passion for inspiring people and a flair for fresh food, consider applying for a job at Sprouts! With a focus on customer service, our neighborhood grocery stores offer high\-quality, farm fresh produce, natural meats, plenty of scoop\-your\-own bulk goods and much more in a fun, friendly, old\-fashioned farmer’s market setting. Come grow your career in healthy living with a fast\-paced, rapidly growing company and teams that pride themselves on empowering others along their journey. *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of the work being performed by people assigned to this work. This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and requirements. Sprouts’ management reserves the right to amend and change duties, responsibilities, and requirements to meet business and organizational needs as necessary.* *Sprouts will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance.* *California Residents: We collect information in accordance with California law, please see* *here* *for more information.*

jobs.title: IT Support Engineer Level 1 Healthcare
jobs.description: Starling Oncology (NASDAQ: STLN) is advancing oncology by delivering highly specialized, value\-based cancer care in the community setting. Formerly known as The Oncology Institute, Starling Oncology offers cutting\-edge, evidence\-based cancer care to a population of approximately 2\.1 million patients, including clinical trials, transfusions, and other care delivery models traditionally associated with the most advanced care delivery organizations. With more than 400 employed and network clinicians and over 100 clinics and network locations of care across five states and growing, Starling Oncology is changing oncology for the better. For more information, visit www.starlingoncology.com. Join an oncology practice where your technical expertise directly supports compassionate, life\-changing patient care. As an IT Coordinator, you will play a vital role in keeping critical systems secure, reliable, and efficient so clinicians and staff can focus on delivering exceptional cancer care. In return, we offer meaningful work with real impact, close collaboration with healthcare professionals, opportunities to grow your skills in a highly specialized environment, and the chance to help advance innovation in a mission\-driven organization. **JOB PURPOSE AND SUMMARY:** ---------------------------- The IT Support Engineer I provides secure, reliable support for endpoints, identity, connectivity, Microsoft 365, and business and clinical applications. The role resolves incidents, protects PHI, documents work, and supports service improvement, automation, cloud operations, and security within approved controls. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** ------------------------------------------ * Provide Level 1 and developing Level 2 technical and customer support through approved ticketing, phone, chat, remote, and onsite channels. * Research, diagnose, resolve, document, and escalate hardware, software, account, application, and connectivity issues. * Set up, secure, maintain, and retire Windows workstations, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and conferencing equipment. * Support Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, groups, licensing, and authorized account lifecycle tasks. * Provide first\-line support for assigned business and clinical applications while following privacy, downtime, and patient\-safety procedures. * Document and track incidents, requests, assets, troubleshooting history, customer communication, and resolution details. * Create and maintain knowledge articles, user guides, SOPs, and runbooks. * Perform approved entry\-level Azure, monitoring, backup, security, remediation, reporting, scripting, automation, and data\-quality tasks. * Protect PHI, PII, credentials, and confidential information; recognize and escalate security or privacy events. * Assist with projects, implementations, migrations, clinic openings, go\-lives, planned maintenance, vendor coordination, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities. * Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve service, controls, standardization, and automation. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** ------------------------------------- * Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, identity, Microsoft 365, connectivity, applications, and user workflows. * Working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune concepts, MFA, role\-based access, networking, and secure remote support. * Ability to use logs and diagnostic tools, document findings, and distinguish symptoms from probable root causes. * Foundational knowledge of Azure, cloud operations, monitoring, backup, scripting, automation, APIs, JSON, and cybersecurity principles. * Understanding of HIPAA\-aligned PHI handling, least privilege, secure sharing, auditability, and healthcare downtime procedures. * Clear communication, sound prioritization, accountability, teamwork, and willingness to learn. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING:** --------------------------------------------------- * High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in IT, cybersecurity, cloud computing, health informatics, or a related field preferred. * Two or more years of IT service desk, desktop support, or technical support experience; relevant internships, military experience, labs, or applied projects may be considered. * Experience with ticketing systems, Windows, Microsoft 365, user accounts, endpoints, peripherals, connectivity, and defined escalation and change procedures. * Ability to support scheduled onsite, implementation, maintenance, go\-live, or after\-hours activities as needed. Relevant certifications or applied experience in service management, Microsoft 365, networking, endpoint management, identity, cloud, security, automation, or healthcare IT are preferred. **PHYSICAL WORKING REQUIREMENTS:** ---------------------------------- The position involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk, extensive computer use, and phone or virtual interaction. The role may require travel between supported locations and occasional lifting, moving, or installation of office technology equipment weighing up to 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

Grow your career with a rapidly growing company that invests in its people and their ability to drive real progress.** **Senior Full Stack .NET Developer** We are seeking a highly experienced **Senior Full Stack .NET Developer** to design, build, enhance, and support secure, scalable, cloud\-native business applications. You will help establish technical standards, mentor other developers, and partner closely with product owners, business stakeholders, QA, DevOps, and security teams. **Responsibilities** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain modern web applications using .NET, C\#, Angular, SQL Server, and Microsoft Azure. * Build and maintain RESTful APIs, backend services, integration layers, and user\-facing Angular applications. * Apply secure coding practices, authentication and authorization patterns, and enterprise security standards throughout the application stack. * Design efficient data models, database schemas, queries, and performance\-tuning strategies for SQL Server. * Troubleshoot complex production issues involving application code, database performance, cloud infrastructure, integrations, and deployment processes. **Required Qualifications** **Modern .NET and C\#** * Extensive professional experience developing enterprise applications using **recent versions of .NET and C\#**. * Strong understanding of object\-oriented design, SOLID principles, dependency injection, asynchronous programming, exception handling, logging, and performance optimization. * Experience building and maintaining **ASP.NET Core** web APIs, background services, worker processes, and service\-oriented applications. * Experience designing API contracts, Core** * Strong experience using **Entity Framework Core** for database access, migrations, data modeling, and repository/service\-layer patterns. * Ability to diagnose and improve EF Core performance issues, including inefficient queries, excessive database round trips, tracking behavior, eager versus lazy loading, and query projections. * Strong understanding of transactional behavior, Functions, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Monitor, and Azure API Management or equivalent services. * Experience implementing cloud\-native patterns infrastructure, networking, identity, and configuration issues in Azure environments. * Experience with Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Bicep, ARM templates, Terraform, or similar jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- **Working Title: Senior Systems / Cloud Engineer** **Job Class: Information Technology Specialist 4** **Agency: Attorney General's Office** * **Job ID**: 97403 * **Location**: St. Paul * **Telework Eligible**: Yes, hybrid * **Full/Part Time**: Full\-Time * **Regular/Temporary**: Unlimited * **Who May Apply**: Open to all qualified job seekers * **Date Posted**: 10/01/2026 * **Closing Date**: 10/15/2026 * **Hiring Agency/Seniority Unit**: Attorney General's Office / Attorney General\-MAPE * **Division/Unit**: Attorney Gen. / IT Infrastructure * **Work Shift/Work Hours**: Day Shift * **Days of Work**: Monday \- Friday * **Travel Required**: No * **Salary Range:** $37\.72 \- $62\.21 / hourly; $78,759 \- $129,894 / annually * **Classified Status**: Classified * **Bargaining Unit/Union**: 214 \- MN Assoc of Professional Empl/MAPE * **FLSA Status**: Exempt \- Professional * Designated in Connect 700 Program for Applicants with Disabilities: Yes ### **The work you'll do is more than just a job.** At the State of Minnesota, employees play a critical role in developing policies, providing essential services, and working to improve the well\-being and quality of life for all Minnesotans. The State of Minnesota is committed to equity and inclusion, and invests in employees by providing benefits, support resources, and training and development opportunities. **Job Summary** --------------- The Minnesota Attorney General’s Office (AGO) is seeking a highly skilled Senior Systems / Cloud Engineer to join our IT Division. In this senior level role, you will provide advanced engineering, administration, and lifecycle management of the AGO’s cloud and on\-premises infrastructure. You will independently design, implement, monitor, and troubleshoot systems that support critical AGO operations, including Azure cloud services, identity and access management, virtualization platforms, servers, storage, backups, monitoring, and disaster recovery readiness. This role plays a key part in ensuring secure, stable, and high performing systems by conducting complex technical analysis, leading modernization and resiliency improvements, and serving as an escalation point for cross platform incidents. You will directly contribute to the strategic advancement of AGO technical infrastructure while maintaining strong communication and customer service relationships with end\-users, IT colleagues, and agency partners. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Design, engineer, configure, and administer the AGO's cloud and on premises infrastructure, including Azure, AWS, Windows Server, virtualization platforms (VMware/Hyper V), storage systems, and identity services. * Implement and maintain governance, security baselines, monitoring, logging, alerting, and access policies across infrastructure to ensure compliant, reliable, and secure operations. * Lead modernization and architecture improvements by planning and executing cloud migrations, resiliency enhancements, lifecycle management, and platform upgrades. * Manage and optimize backup, replication, and disaster recovery configurations using Azure and Veeam to ensure recoverability of critical AGO systems. * Serve as a senior technical escalation point for high complexity incidents involving servers, cloud services, identity platforms, storage, virtualization, and backups; conduct root cause analysis and lead remediation efforts. * Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, CLI, Infrastructure as Code principles, and cloud APIs to improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and enhance operational reliability. * Monitor infrastructure performance by building dashboards, establishing baselines, identifying early degradation, and implementing proactive performance tuning or corrective actions. * Maintain and enhance directory services, identity integrations (Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA), certificates, and related security components supporting AGO's hybrid environment. * Coordinate closely with security, application, and networking teams to ensure that infrastructure changes, cloud configurations, and system updates align with AGO and statewide security standards. * Evaluate emerging technologies, platform updates, and industry best practices, and apply relevant advancements to AGO infrastructure to support ongoing modernization and efficiency. * Plan and execute high impact infrastructure changes or migrations that require senior level judgment, careful risk assessment, and cross team communication. * Provide technical leadership by contributing to architectural discussions, mentoring IT staff, and communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. This position is eligible for a hybrid work environment (combination of required in\-office work and optional telework) after successful completion of onboarding and training. **Qualifications** ------------------ ### **Minimum Qualifications** * Degree in inform .mn.gov/careers. ### **Contact** If you have questions about this position, contact Brooke Seekins at brooke.seekins@ag.state.mn.us or 651\-300\-7025\. To receive consideration as a Connect 700 Program applicant, apply online, email the Job ID\#, the Working Title and your valid Proof of Eligibility Certificate by the closing date to Brooke Seekins at brooke.seekins@ag.state.mn.us. #### **Working together to improve the state we love.** What do Minnesota's State employees have in common? * A sense of purpose in their work * Connection with their coworkers and communities * Opportunities for personal and professional growth #### **Benefits** As an employee, you'll have access to one of the most affordable health insurance plans in Minnesota, along with other benefits to help you and your family be well. #### **Your benefits may include:** * Paid vacation and sick leave * 12 paid holidays each year * Low\-cost medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug plans + Fertility care, including IVF + Diabetes care + Dental and orthodontic care for adults and children * 6 weeks paid leave for parents of newborn or newly adopted children * Pension plan that provides income when you retire (after working at least three years) * Employer paid life insurance to provide support for your family in the event of death * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance that can provide income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury * Tax\-free expense accounts for health, dental, and dependent care * Resources that provide support and promote physical, emotional, social, and financial well\-being #### **Support to help you reach your career goals:** * Training, classes, and professional development * Federal Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program (Some positions may qualify for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. For more information, visit the Federal Student Aid website at studentaid.gov) #### **Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for work/life support:** * A voluntary confidential program that helps employees and their families with life challenges that may impact overall health, personal well\-being, or job performance * Common sources of stress can be addressed through the EAP: mental health, relationship challenges (personal and work), grief and loss, finances, and legal issues * Daily Living/Convenience Services: Chore services, home repair, trip planning, child/elder care **Programs, resources and benefits eligibility varies** based on type of employment, agency, funding availability, union/collective bargaining agreement, location, and length of service with the State of Minnesota. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYERS** Minnesota state agencies are equal opportunity, affirmative action, and veteran\-friendly employers. State agencies are committed to creating a workforce that reflects the diversity of the state and strongly encourages persons of color and Indigenous communities, members of the LGBTQIA2S\+ community, individuals with disabilities, women, and veterans to apply. The varied experiences and perspectives of employees strengthen the work we do together and our ability to best serve Minnesotans. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and disabilities related to pregnancy or childbirth), gender identity, gender expression, marital status, familial status, age, sexual orientation, status regarding public assistance, disability, veteran status or activity in a local Human Rights Commission or any other characteristic protected by law. **APPLICANTS WITH DISABILITIES** Minnesota state agencies make reasonable accommodations to their employees and applicants with disabilities. If you have a disability and need assistance in searching or applying for jobs with the State of Minnesota, call the Careers Help Desk at 651\-259\-3637 or email careers@state.mn.us and let us know the support you need.

This role requires fluency in modern AI technology and terminology — large language models (LLMs), retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic AI, prompt engineering, machine learning operations (MLOps)/large language model operations (LLMOps), and responsible AI practices — to credibly partner with COE architects and data scientists while advocating for business needs. jobs.title: Project Manager / Business Analyst – Healthcare Interoperability & Claims (837/835/276/277, Medicare
jobs.description: **Job Title**: Project Manager / Business Analyst – Healthcare Interoperability \& Claims (837/835/276/277, Medicare \& Medicaid) **Location**: Remote (United States) **Employment Type**: Contract, Long\-Term (W2\) **Pay Rate**: $30–$60/hr (W2\), based on experience **Posted by**: TAP Innovations, LLC **Overview** TAP Innovations is placing a senior Project Manager / Business Analyst with a client building a cloud\-based healthcare platform for skilled nursing and senior living operators. The platform covers the clinical record, healthcare data exchange, and the full medical billing cycle. This is a hands\-on role for someone who can run delivery and write the requirements. It is not a generalist PM seat. The client intends this to be a long\-term engagement. **What You'll Do** \- Plan and run delivery of interoperability and claims features: scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, and release readiness. \- Run sprint ceremonies and backlog grooming with a distributed engineering team. \- Coordinate clearinghouse onboarding, payer and EDI enrollment, and trading partner testing. \- Report status to client leadership: what is on track, what is at risk, and what decision is needed. \- Perform current\-state and gap analysis of billing, claims, and data\-exchange workflows in skilled nursing and senior living. \- Turn payer rules, companion guides, and Medicare/Medicaid policy into user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and data mappings. \- Define requirements across the claim lifecycle: eligibility (270/271\), authorization (278\), claim submission (837I/837P), acknowledgements (TA1, 999, 277CA), claim status (276/277\), and remittance (835\). \- Specify Medicare logic (Part A skilled stays, PDPM/HIPPS, consolidated billing, Part B, Medicare Advantage) and Medicaid logic (state variation, patient liability, managed Medicaid). \- Define coordination of benefits for dual\-eligible residents, plus denial management and A/R requirements (CARC/RARC, timely filing, aging). \- Gather requirements for Health Information Exchange (HIE) and apply Health Information Management (HIM) principles. \- Work with engineers on FHIR, HL7 v2, and C\-CDA data flows, and on the code sets that join clinical and billing data. \- Contribute to solution design with engineering:
