Working in close partnership with other leaders, this role translates business and execution needs into practical operating mechanisms \- from program lifecycle and governance to workflows, data, tools, automation, and reporting. The role will also connect with other PMOs and enterprise functions to leverage existing capabilities where they fit, rather than recreating them locally. Location Preferred location: Rochester, NY area. This position will begin as a remote role and will transition to a hybrid schedule and relocation options will be considered on a case\-by\-case basis. Candidates MUST be located in one of the following areas if they are able to travel to Rochester frequently and maintain a strong on\-site presence with the engineering, manufacturing, and leadership teams. Canada: Ottawa, Montreal, Toronto, Kingston, Mississauga. East coast, US (New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Maine, New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Vermont, Rhode Island, Connecticut, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, or Florida) **Job Requirements** -------------------- ### **Operating Model \& Process Architecture** * Define and implement scalable operating models, processes, governance, and execution frameworks across products, manufacturing, and factory programs. * Clarify roles, ownership, decision rights, dependencies, and cross\-functional interactions. * Streamline processes by eliminating bottlenecks, duplication, and unnecessary complexity. * Establish common operating standards while allowing flexibility across program types. * Develop dashboards and reporting to support leadership decision\-making and track strategic initiatives. ### **Systems, Tools \& Automation** * Lead the strategy and evolution of systems supporting program planning, execution, reporting, resource management, and collaboration. * Partner with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into scalable system solutions. * Improve efficiency through automation, integration, and reduction of manual processes. * Establish data standards and reliable sources of truth for program visibility and decision\-making. * Evaluate and implement AI\-enabled tools and technologies that improve execution. ### **Standards, Governance \& Execution Excellence** * Develop and maintain program management standards, playbooks, templates, and best practices. * Standardize approaches for planning, risk management, change control, governance, and executive reporting. * Drive continuous improvement using program data, lessons learned, and execution insights. * Balance strong governance with a practical, business\-focused approach. ### **Enterprise \& PMO Integration** * Collaborate with enterprise PMOs and process owners to align tools, systems, and practices. * Evaluate and leverage existing enterprise capabilities while adapting to business needs. * Represent the organization in cross\-functional governance and process forums. * Drive resource forecasting and expenditure visibility to support planning and decision\-making. ### **Team Leadership \& Adoption** * Build and lead a high\-performing team focused on processes, systems, automation, analytics, and PMO infrastructure. * Define team capabilities, development plans, and staffing strategies to support growth. * Drive adoption through training, coaching, documentation, and partnership with stakeholders. * Foster a culture of simplicity, accountability, continuous improvement, and measurable business impact. **What your background should look like** ----------------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Operations, Information Systems, Program Management, or a related discipline; advanced degree is a plus. * Significant experience in Program Management, PMO leadership, business operations, process engineering, systems implementation, or a similar execution\-enablement role. * Demonstrated experience designing and implementing cross\-functional operating models, processes, workflows, and governance in a distributed, multi\-cultural, complex organization. * Experience selecting, implementing, configuring, or improving systems and tools that support program or business execution. * Strong systems thinking and ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, processes, and scalable solutions. * Demonstrated ability to influence across functions and drive change without relying on direct authority. * Experience building, leading, and developing capable teams. * Strong written, verbal, facilitation, and executive communication skills. Highly Preferred * Experience in hardware, optics, semiconductor, electronics, industrial technology, manufacturing, or another complex product\-development environment. * Experience supporting new product introduction, equipment development, industrialization, factory launch, or high\-volume manufacturing ramp. * PMP certified and exposure to ISO and other processes related to manufacturing * Experience working in both fast\-growth environments and large enterprises, with a demonstrated ability to balance speed with scalable discipline. * Experience using platforms like Asana, JIRA, SharePoint, Databricks, Planisware etc. * Experience integrating or harmonizing processes across multiple PMOs, business units, or functional organizations. * Familiarity with modern project/program management, workflow, analytics, automation, collaboration, and enterprise platforms. **Competencies** ---------------- SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers) **ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY** TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come **only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com**. jobs.title: DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **TISTA** is seeking a **DevSecOps Engineer** to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management DevSecOps program. This role will partner with VA stakeholders and Agile delivery teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements supporting supply chain and logistics solutions. The DevSecOps Engineer / Security Specialist is the hands\-on pipeline security engineer for TISTA's prime contract performance on the Department of Veterans Affairs Supply Chain Management DevSecOps (SCMDSO) task order supporting VA's supply chain and logistics Product Line. Where the Cyber Security Architect / Policy Lead defines the security architecture, policy interpretation, and Guardrails\-as\-Code standard, and the Engineer Solution Lead owns the platform and pipeline infrastructure, the DevSecOps Engineer / Security Specialist makes security real inside every build. This position embeds automated security scanning, software bill of materials generation, container and configuration hardening, secrets management, and vulnerability remediation tracking into the CI/CD pipelines used by every Scrum Team, and produces the security evidence that keeps every product's Authority to Operate current. At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do. **TISTA** associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account \& Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short\-term \& Long\-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more! Responsibilities: * Embed automated "Guardrails\-as\-Code" into all CI/CD pipelines, enforcing security scans (SAST/DAST), SBOM generation, and strict policy gates that block builds with critical vulnerabilities. * Manage secrets, cryptographic code signing, and artifact integrity while maintaining hardened, compliant container images and automating configuration drift detection. * Triage and resolve security vulnerabilities within strict deadlines (5 days for Critical, 10 days for High), ensuring zero unaccepted high\-level risks reach production. * Automate the collection of security evidence to support Continuous Assessment and Authorization (ATO) and ensure all systems meet VA and FedRAMP compliance standards. * Implement Zero Trust architecture, strict access controls, logging, and comprehensive cloud security measures across VA Enterprise Cloud, AWS, and Azure environments. * Mentor development teams on secure coding practices, guide security design reviews, and rigorously validate the safety of AI\-generated code and test scripts. * Drive security incident response efforts—including rapid component isolation, forensics, and strict 1\-hour reporting windows—and participate in after\-hours escalation rotations. * Support business growth by contributing DevSecOps strategies to proposals, tracking pipeline security performance metrics, and interviewing technical talent to build a strong team bench. * Advance corporate thought leadership by developing reusable pipeline security templates, leading internal cybersecurity communities, and supporting corporate quality assessments. Qualifications: * 7\+ years in IT security or DevSecOps, including at least 4 years integrating continuous security controls into CI/CD pipelines for federal Agile/SAFe programs. * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience managing automated pipeline security, including SAST/DAST, container scanning, secrets management, and generating SBOMs (e.g., SPDX, CycloneDX). * Proven ability to automate infrastructure hardening and configuration compliance using tools like Ansible and Terraform to meet strict DISA STIG and CIS benchmarks. * Strong background supporting NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Authority to Operate (ATO) processes, including managing POA\&Ms and automating continuous control evidence collection. * Extensive experience implementing robust cloud security controls across AWS, Azure, and the VA Enterprise Cloud, covering IAM, encryption, and network segmentation. * Skilled in tracking, triaging, and remediating security vulnerabilities within strict deadlines while partnering directly with developers to resolve findings. * Proficient in setting up comprehensive security monitoring and logging (e.g., Splunk) as well as strict identity and access controls (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, mutual TLS, ICAM/PIV). * Capable of guiding secure coding practices across multiple languages (Java, .NET, Python, legacy MUMPS) and embedding automated Section 508 accessibility testing into build pipelines. * Highly preferred experience includes securing VA supply chain systems, protecting HL7/FHIR healthcare APIs, managing one\-hour incident responses, and validating AI\-generated code. **Certifications*** ISC2 CISSP, or Security\+ * AWS Solutions Architect Associate or AWS Developer Associate, or Azure Solutions Architect or Azure Developer Associate Red Hat Certified. * Specialist in Ansible Automation or Red Hat Certified Architect. **Education*** Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. * Master's degree preferred. **Clearance:** * Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Background Investigation; ability to obtain a VA PIV credential. **Location:** * Rockville, MD / Remote (CONUS). * Travel: Up to 10%. **Pay Range:*** The suggested pay for this position ranges from $161,00 to $176,000\. * The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. * Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses. * TISTA associates are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits plan! More information can be found here: https://tistatech.com/working\-at\-tista/

This role will partner with VA stakeholders and Agile delivery teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements supporting supply chain and logistics solutions. The Engineer Solution Lead is the platform and integration engineering authority for TISTA's prime contract performance on the Department of Veterans Affairs Supply Chain Management DevSecOps (SCMDSO) task order supporting VA's supply chain and logistics Product Line. This is a designated Key Personnel position that VA requires be maintained for the life of the contract, and any substitution must be coordinated with the Contracting Officer, VA Program Manager, and CORs with equal or greater qualifications. Where the Solution Technical Lead owns application code and Scrum Team technical direction, the Engineer Solution Lead owns everything the applications run on and connect through: the enterprise integration platform, container hosting in the VA Enterprise Cloud and VA Platform One, environment provisioning, infrastructure as code, cloud migration execution, disaster recovery and continuity of operations, and application performance monitoring and observability**.** At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. Qualifications: * 12\+ years of IT engineering experience, with at least 5 years leading platform, cloud, and integration teams on large federal IT programs within Agile/SAFe environments. * 5\+ years of hands\-on expertise building and operating secure, multi\-tenant containerized platforms using OpenShift, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (Ansible, Terraform). * 5\+ years managing enterprise integration platforms (e.g., InterSystems IRIS), handling API management, service orchestration, and healthcare data standards like HL7, FHIR, and EDI. * Proven track record of leading end\-to\-end cloud migrations into federal environments (AWS, Azure, VA Enterprise Cloud), managing everything from initial build\-out to failover testing. * Deep expertise in resilience engineering legacy VistA systems) and managing bi\-directional interfaces with major platforms like Oracle Health EHR and iFAMS. * Strong operational leadership capabilities, including managing major incident responses, leveraging AI\-assisted SDLC/AIOps tools, and mentoring cross\-functional engineering teams. **Certifications*** Red Hat Certified Specialist or Architect in OpenShift Administration. * AWS **Education*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related field. * Master's degree preferred. **Clearance:** * Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Background Investigation; ability to obtain a VA PIV credential. **Location:** * Rockville, MD / Remote (CONUS). * Travel: Up to 10%. **Pay Range:*** The suggested pay for this position ranges from $171,00 to This role will partner with VA stakeholders and Agile delivery teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements supporting supply chain and logistics solutions. The UI/UX/IXD Designer owns human centered design across the product line for TISTA's prime contract performance on the Department of Veterans Affairs Supply Chain Management DevSecOps (SCMDSO) task order supporting VA's supply chain and logistics Product Line. 2\.0 (Level A and AA) accessibility standards, utilizing assistive technologies like JAWS, NVDA, and axe to ensure compliance. * Experienced in writing plain\-language content, establishing jobs.title: VistA Kernel and FileMan Specialist
jobs.description: Overview: TISTA is seeking a **VistA Kernel and FileMan Specialist** to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Supply Chain Management DevSecOps program. This role will partner with VA stakeholders and Agile delivery teams to translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements supporting supply chain and logistics solutions. The VistA Kernel \& FileMan Specialist is the VistA platform, configuration, and patch distribution authority for TISTA's prime contract performance on the Department of Veterans Affairs Supply Chain Management DevSecOps (SCMDSO) task order supporting VA's supply chain and logistics Product Line. Where the MUMPS Engineer / SME writes and remediates supply chain module code, this position owns the VistA foundation those modules run on: Kernel, FileMan, menu trees, security keys, institution and division configuration, TaskMan, parameters, and the FORUM and National Patch Module release process. The Specialist ensures that every legacy patch, table update, integration touchpoint, and site deprovisioning action is configured, distributed, and verified correctly across VistA instances without disrupting frontline logistics or clinical users. At TISTA, you’ll do meaningful, mission‑driven work that improves lives alongside teammates you trust and leaders who are transparent and supportive. We invest in your learning and internal mobility so you can build a career that keeps advancing. We’re proud to serve and hire Veterans, and we put people first in everything we do. **TISTA** associates enjoy above Industry Healthcare Benefits, Remote Working Options, Paid Time Off, Training/Certification opportunities, Healthcare Savings Account \& Flexible Savings Account, Paid Life Insurance, Short\-term \& Long\-term Disability, 401K Match, Tuition Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program, Paid Holidays, Military Leave, and much more! Responsibilities: * Administer and support VistA Kernel components (such as menus, security keys, and TaskMan) and FileMan data dictionaries while configuring RPC Broker and HL7 interfaces for system integrations. * Manage the complete patch distribution lifecycle through FORUM and the National Patch Module, which includes building, verifying, and sequencing KIDS patches to prevent deployment collisions. * Enable modern system coexistence by safely exposing VistA data for integration platforms, and securely manage legacy decommissioning by deprovisioning site access and archiving configurations. * Enforce strict VA security standards (VA Handbook 6500\) by managing least\-privilege access, remediating vulnerability scans, and maintaining version control and regression tests for all changes. * Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies by providing accurate effort estimates for project planning and supporting 90\-day post\-deployment hypercare, including after\-hours escalation. * Serve as the critical human\-in\-the\-loop expert to review, validate, and correct AI\-generated KIDS builds, regression tests, and configuration changes before they are deployed. * Support business growth by identifying new modernization opportunities, contributing technical VistA expertise to proposals, and tracking delivery metrics for past performance narratives * Mentor new developers and analysts on VistA concepts, conduct technical interviews for new hires, and build comprehensive training materials to strengthen the team's talent bench. * Advance corporate thought leadership by creating reusable VistA runbooks and decommissioning playbooks, leading legacy modernization communities, and supporting quality audits like CMMI and ISO. Qualifications: * 6\+ years of hands\-on experience administering VistA systems, focusing heavily on Kernel (user access, menus, TaskMan) and FileMan (data dictionaries, APIs). * 3\+ years managing patch workflows through FORUM and the National Patch Module, including building, testing, and tracking KIDS patch installations. * Expertise in configuring VistA site parameters, RPC Broker, and HL7 interfaces to connect legacy VistA systems with modern external platforms. * Deep knowledge of VA supply chain and logistics packages (such as IFCAP, GIP, and AEMS/MERS) and their specific integration points. * Ability to read and write light MUMPS (M) and InterSystems ObjectScript to verify system builds, review code routines, and troubleshoot production issues. * Experience managing legacy system coexistence and decommissioning, including securely exposing VistA data via REST/JSON and carefully deprovisioning local user access. * Strong commitment to VA security standards (VA Handbook 6500\), managing PIV\-linked access, conducting security audits, and remediating vulnerabilities. * Proficient in Agile/SAFe practices and tooling (Jira, ServiceNow, GitHub, Databricks) for issue tracking, configuration baselines, and data migration support. * Highly preferred background includes coordinating national patch releases, integrating systems like Nuvolo and Oracle Health EHR, and validating AI\-generated VistA builds with human\-in\-the\-loop oversight. **Certifications:*** Completion of VA VistA Kernel and FileMan training, or equivalent documented VistA technical training. * SAFe Practitioner (SP) or SAFe Agilist (SA). **Education:*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent additional years of VistA Kernel and FileMan experience. **Clearance:** * Tier 2 / Moderate Risk Background Investigation; ability to obtain a VA PIV credential. **Location:** * Rockville, MD / Remote (CONUS). * Travel: Up to 10%. **Pay Range:*** The suggested pay for this position ranges from $128,00 to $143,000\. * The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. * Also, certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses * TISTA associates are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits plan! More information can be found here: https://tistatech.com/working\-at\-tista/

jobs.title: Fire Captain
jobs.description: **We Are Seeking** ------------------ ***This job posting is a promotional opportunity, open only to internal employees of the Gilbert Fire and Rescue Department. External applications will not be considered for this position.*** Team Gilbert is a high\-performing, collaborative team of innovators who do important work that makes our community better every day. With every job we fill, our focus is on providing best\-in\-class service to our citizens while offering opportunities for professional growth and a rewarding, innovative work environment. Team Gilbert has an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated professional to serve as a **Fire Captain**. The **Fire Captain** reports to a Fire Battalion Chief. The primary function of this position is to perform the duties of a firefighter and supervise and direct the emergency response activities at incident scenes. In addition, a Fire Captain supervises a work unit, organizes and plans required training, performs administrative activities in support of operations, and performs special assignments. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Supervises firefighters by prioritizing and assigning work in adherence to the daily schedule. Shifts priorities as needed. Evaluates firefighter's performance and the performance of the equipment during emergency response operations. Prepares and maintains reports and recommendations for department management. Recommends discipline of assigned personnel as appropriate. * Responds to emergency calls by determining equipment and personnel to be deployed and provides input in determining the route taken to emergency scene; directs the work of firefighters, supervising and participating in the laying of hose lines, placement of ladders and other equipment, direction of water, ventilation of buildings, rescue efforts and salvage operations. * Supervises the inspection and maintenance of fire and emergency response equipment. Inspects equipment to ensure efficient operating condition and readiness. Assists in cleaning and maintaining equipment after completion of emergency response operations, as needed. Supervises, tests and participates in minor repairs of apparatus and equipment. Performs fire inspections. * Reviews, implements, and administers operating policies and procedures and monitors compliance. Maintains a healthy and safe working environment. * Supervises and reviews the preparation and maintenance of activity reports. Responds to inquiries and information requests. * Participates in training sessions related to fire suppression and equipment techniques, emergency medical care, hazardous material containment, incident command, leadership training and other related topics. Participates in physical training activities. * Other duties as assigned. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** Knowledge of: * Current safety principles for effective incident mitigation * Supervisory principles and practices * Modern firefighting methods and prevention practices * Applicable fire code * Basic math and science principles and practices * Emergency response communication equipment and systems * Modern office equipment Skill in: * Supervising, monitoring and evaluating staff * Solving complex problems * Applying critical analyses * Providing leadership * Managing time effectively * Making decisions utilizing good judgment * Utilizing a computer and relevant software applications * Communication and interpersonal skills as applied to interaction with coworkers, supervisors, the general public, etc. sufficient to exchange or convey information and to receive work direction **Physical Demands and Working Conditions** Very Heavy Work: Exerting in excess of 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or in excess of 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or in excess of 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects. Positions in this class typically require: climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, fingering, grasping, feeling, talking, hearing, seeing, and repetitive motions. Incumbents may be subjected to operating a motor vehicle, moving mechanical parts, electrical currents, vibrations, fumes, odors, dusts, gases, poor ventilation, chemicals, oils, extreme temperatures, inadequate lighting, workspace restrictions, intense noises, travel, and environmental conditions such as disruptive people, imminent danger, and a threatening environment. **About You** ------------- At Team Gilbert, we promote innovative, forward\-thinking problem solvers who love what they do. You are someone who effectively exceeds customer needs by building productive relationships and taking responsibility for customer satisfaction and loyalty. You actively participate as a member of the team to move the team toward the completion of goals and produce quality outcomes. You are committed to our safety philosophy, and you take great pride in proactively managing time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently while accomplishing objectives and achieving goals beyond what is required. In addition to possessing the ability to live out our core and functional values daily, candidates must possess the following requirements: **Time Requirements** **(****The following must be true by the time of completion/graduation of the 2026/2027 Captains Promotional Academy)** * Minimum six (6\) years of full\-time fire suppression experience. Four (4\) of the six (6\) years must be with Gilbert Fire and Rescue. * One year of credit may be awarded for current engineer position or completion of an acting captain packet. This one\-year credit may be used to reduce the six\-year minimum only, and not the four\-year Gilbert Fire and Rescue requirement. **Education Requirements** * A minimum of 60 college credit hours that includes the following classes: + Firefighting tactics and strategy + Firefighting, Safety and Building Construction + Supervisory training for firefighters * Successful completion of the GFR Captains Academy satisfies the specific education class requirements. * An Associate's degree in Fire Science satisfies educational requirements. Educational equivalents may be considered by email request for an educational equivalent review by the Operations Division Chief and the Promotional Labor Representative co\-chair before the submission of the application for the position. All review decisions are final. **Licensing and Certification Requirements** * Valid Arizona Firefighter I and Firefighter II certification * Emergency Medical Technician certification * CPR certification * Hazardous Materials First Responder certification * Valid Arizona driver's license Depending on assignment, the following may also be required: * Paramedic certification * Advanced Cardiac Life Support certification * Pediatric Advanced Life Support certification **Application Requirements** The following documents are required and should be attached as part of your application: * Captain \& Battalion Chief Recommendation Letter * Your most recent Annual Review **Why Team Gilbert?** --------------------- **To view the slide show presentation above, click** **here****.** **We Are Here to Help!** ------------------------ Gilbert is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. If any reasonable accommodation is needed while participating in the application and interviewing process, please contact our People Team (Human Resources) at 480\-503\-6823\. Requests should be made as early as possible to allow time to arrange the accommodation. Gilbert provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Civil Engineer II
jobs.description: About Us: TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level. TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader. We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications. Overview: TRC is seeking a motivated Civil Engineer II to support the planning, design, analysis, and delivery of civil engineering projects. This position will work as part of a multidisciplinary project team and perform engineering assignments under the direction and supervision of experienced engineers and licensed Professional Engineers (PEs). The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in civil engineering principles, effective problem\-solving and communication skills, and an interest in continuing to develop their technical and professional capabilities. Responsibilities: * Perform civil engineering calculations, analyses, and design assignments under the direction of senior engineering staff. * Assist with the preparation of engineering plans, specifications, technical reports, calculations, cost estimates, and other project deliverables. * Develop and modify engineering drawings, plans, and design documents using applicable design and drafting software. * Review drawings, specifications, and other technical documents for accuracy and consistency. * Support engineering design activities related to site development, grading, drainage, utilities, transportation, water resources, or other civil infrastructure projects, as applicable. * Conduct field investigations, site visits, inspections, data collection, and documentation as required. * Analyze engineering data and assist with developing technical solutions to project challenges. * Coordinate with engineers, designers, technicians, project managers, clients, contractors, and other project stakeholders. * Assist with permitting, regulatory coordination, and preparation of supporting documentation. * Support project managers with project schedules, budgets, deliverables, and technical documentation. * Apply applicable engineering codes, standards, specifications, and established design practices. * Participate in project and client meetings and communicate technical information clearly and professionally. * Maintain accurate project files, calculations, and engineering documentation. * Follow company quality assurance/quality control and health and safety procedures. * Continue developing technical knowledge and professional skills toward Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. * Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline from an accredited institution. * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification or successful completion of the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE) examination. * 2–5 years of relevant civil engineering experience. * Working knowledge of fundamental civil engineering principles and practices. * Ability to perform engineering calculations and analyze technical information. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, plans, specifications, and technical documents. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. * Experience with or ability to learn applicable engineering design and drafting software. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. * Ability and willingness to travel to project sites as needed. Preferred Qualifications: * Previous internship, co\-op, or professional experience in civil engineering or infrastructure projects. * Experience with AutoCAD, Civil 3D, MicroStation, or other applicable engineering design software. * Familiarity with applicable federal, state, and local engineering standards and regulations. * Field experience related to civil engineering, construction, or infrastructure projects. * Demonstrated interest in pursuing Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. **Benefits**\***:** TRC offers a competitive benefit package consisting of:* Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance. * 401k package that includes both traditional and Roth IRA options and Company match. * Paid time off contingent upon full time or part time status and level of seniority (ranging from 15 to 25 days per year). * All full\-time employees enjoy a minimum of 8 Paid Holidays per year. * TRC ensures that all employees, including those that work part\-time, receive paid sick, family, and disability leave in accordance with the laws of their state of residence. * These benefits are applicable to US employees depending on their employment status (full time, part time, or temporary). TRC offers jurisdiction specific benefit packages for International and Puerto Rico employees. **Compensation**: In accordance with local law, the below salary range is applicable for the job and location associated with this requisition. Compensation will vary based upon experience, education, skill level, geographical location, and other compensable factors. **Other Compensation:** Employee may be eligible for participation in the Company’s annual Discretionary Bonus Program which is contingent on Company, Business Segment, and Individual performance against Key Performance Indicators which vary by year and employee. Disclaimers: TRC is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. The complete job description and application are available on TRC’s career site. TRC accepts applications for this position on an ongoing, rolling basis and reserves the right to cancel this posting at any time. Salary Range: USD $75,000\.00 \- USD $89,440\.00 /Yr.

jobs.description: **What to Expect** Consider before submitting an application: This position is expected to start around January 2027 and continue through the entire Spring term (ending approximately May 2027 or later, if available). We ask for a minimum of 12 weeks, Full \- Time (40 hours/week) and on\-site, for most internships. Our internship program is for students who are actively enrolled in an academic program. Recent graduates seeking employment after graduation and not returning to school should apply for full\-time positions, not internships. International Students: If your work authorization is through CPT, please consult your school on your ability to work 40 hours per week before applying. You must be able to work 40 hours per week on\-site. Many students will be limited to part\-time during the academic year. About the Team We are looking for a motivated Data Engineering Intern to join our growing Data Engineering \& Business Intelligence team, helping build, maintain, and improve the pipelines and services that power analytics across Tesla's product lines, including Vehicles, Semi, Robotaxi, and Optimus. You'll work across our data warehouse, our internal API platform, and our AI Agent Analytics layer, using tools such as Apache Airflow, SQL Server, Vertica, Trino, Python/FastAPI, and LLM\-powered analytics agents. **What You'll Do*** Support development of LLM\-based analytics agents, translating business metric requests into accurate SQL, structured configs, and clear documentation * Assist in building and maintaining ETL/ELT jobs orchestrated via Apache Airflow * Write and optimize SQL across SQL Server (T\-SQL), Vertica, and Trino for dimension/fact table loads and reporting views * Help build and extend internal Python APIs (FastAPI), including database connectors, caching, and async endpoints * Support incremental/CDC\-style loading patterns for fact and dimension tables * Collaborate with data analysts and stakeholders to translate business questions into data models and metrics * Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot job failures, and help improve reliability * Document pipelines, data flows, and metric definitions clearly for other engineers and analysts **What You'll Bring*** Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field (or equivalent experience) with a gradtuation date between May 2027\-June 2028 * Strong foundation in SQL \- writing, debugging, and optimizing queries (joins, CTEs, window functions) * Solid understanding of Python, including basic API development concepts (REST, async/await a plus) * Basic knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts and workflow orchestration (Airflow or similar) * Familiarity with at least one relational database (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Vertica, etc.) * Experience working with LLMs is a plus — e.g. prompt engineering, building or integrating with LLM\-based agents/tools, or using LLM APIs in a project * Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Eagerness to learn modern data engineering practices and take on increasingly complex tasks #### **Benefits** As a full\-time Tesla Intern, you will be eligible for: * Medical plans \> plan options with $0 payroll deduction * Family\-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits * Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans. jobs.title: Infrastructure, Applications, and Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!** *We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.* **JOB SUMMARY:** The Texas Rangers are seeking an experienced Infrastructure, Applications, and Data Platform Engineer to join our team! This role is responsible for the design, administration, security, optimization, and strategic evolution of the organization's core infrastructure, identity services, enterprise applications, databases, and data platforms. This position combines infrastructure engineering, database administration, application management, and data platform engineering. The individual will serve as the organization's primary technical owner for SQL Server environments, Amazon Web Services Relational Database Service, PostgreSQL, Tableau reporting platforms, and, secondarily, application integrations, data governance, and business\-critical systems. This position is highly hands\-on and requires strong troubleshooting skills, project leadership, documentation discipline, and a commitment to operational excellence. Responsibilities build upon the organization's existing infrastructure engineering functions, including SQL Server support, application lifecycle management, and technology project implementation. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF POSITION INCLUDE, BUT ARE NOT LIMITED TO THE FOLLOWING:** * Serve as the primary database administrator for Microsoft SQL Server environments. Design, implement, and maintain highly available and secure database platforms. * Manage: * SQL Server installations and upgrades * PostgreSQL * Amazon Web Services Relational Database Service * Google Cloud Platform Databases * Database patching and lifecycle management * Backup and recovery strategies * Disaster recovery planning * Performance tuning and optimization * Replication and high\-availability technologies * Monitor database performance, availability, storage consumption, and growth. * Develop database maintenance plans and operational standards. * Implement database security controls, auditing, encryption, and compliance requirements. * Support data integration, ETL processes, and application data services. * Assist with enterprise data architecture initiatives and modernization projects. * Collaborate with application owners and business stakeholders to improve data availability and usability. * Administer and support Tableau Server and Tableau environments. * Develop governance standards for enterprise reporting and analytics. * Support Tableau data sources, dashboards, extracts, and integrations. * Serve as technical owner for assigned enterprise applications. * Manage application infrastructure, integrations, and backend systems. * Coordinate vendor relationships, support escalations, and software upgrades. * Monitor application performance, availability, and system health. * Maintain application authentication and identity integrations. * Troubleshoot application and database\-related issues. * Maintain application architecture documentation and support procedures. * Document solution designs, architecture diagrams, and operational guides. * Guide customers and internal teams in implementing secure, scalable, and cost\-efficient solutions * Provide application and security guidance and management of critical platforms to business stakeholders * Act as 3rd\-level support and troubleshooting for business and baseball systems * Design end\-to\-end cloud\-based solutions leveraging SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS technologies. * Administer and maintain Windows Server environments. * Administer and maintain VMware or other virtual environments * Manage: * File Services * VMware ESXi / vCenter * Develop infrastructure standards, diagrams, and technical documentation. * Participate in infrastructure modernization and technology refresh initiatives. * Work closely with the organization's cybersecurity consultants to maintain secure technology platforms. * Ensure compliance with security policies, governance standards, and regulatory requirements. * Support vulnerability remediation efforts. * Participate in risk assessments and security reviews. * Assist with incident response investigations involving identity, data, or applications. * Implement monitoring and auditing controls across infrastructure and data platforms. * Other duties as assigned. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * Associate's degree or higher in a related technical field. * 3\-5 years of related experience required. * Experience with: * SQL Server * Windows Server * File Services * VMware or Hyper\-V virtualized infrastructure * Performance tuning and optimization * Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud * Strong knowledge of database administration, performance tuning, and security. * Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills. * Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication abilities. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects. * Knowledge of ITIL processes and enterprise IT operations. The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of the job. *If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!* Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details** --------------- Location: Hartford, CT Category: Information Technology Employment Type: Full time Job Ref: R2627291\-168 Software Engineer \- IE08DE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. We are seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer to join our Middle Office team within HIMCO IT. This role is critical in partnering with technology and investment professionals to deliver innovative solutions that meet dynamic information and automation needs. You will build systems that empower Portfolio Managers, Traders, and Analysts to make informed investment and financial decisions. **What You’ll Do** As a Full Stack Engineer, you will work on a diverse range of initiatives, including: * Developing interactive web applications and batch processing systems * Integrating and enhancing vendor platforms * Applying object\-oriented design principles and leveraging AI\-driven solutions to improve efficiency This is an exciting opportunity for someone passionate about solving business problems through creative, technology\-driven solutions. You’ll collaborate closely with business and technical teams, deliver impactful systems, and contribute to mission\-critical projects. **Our Technology Stack** * **Languages \& Frameworks:** C\#, ASP.NET MVC, HTML5, CSS, Python * **Tools:** Microsoft Visual Studio * **Cloud:** AWS * **Database:** MS SQL Server 2019 * **Architecture:** RESTful APIs, Microservices * **Scheduling:** CA AutoSys * **Methodology:** Agile Scrum * **ETL:** SSIS * **AI**: Copilot **Key Responsibilities** * Develop a strong understanding of the investment industry and related business processes * Participate in project planning, clarify requirements, and engage with clients and analysts * Design, develop, and maintain applications following disciplined software development practices * Implement quality assurance principles and ensure solutions meet business needs * Provide ongoing maintenance and support for applications * Handle support issues within your area of expertise **Requirements** * 3\+ years of experience developing systems with .NET, C\#, and solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience integrating and supporting vendor systems * Exposure to investment domain * Familiarity with ETL tools * AWS cloud implementation experience * Python development experience *This role will have a Hybrid work schedule, with the expectation of working in an office 3 days a week* *Candidates must be authorized to work in the US without company sponsorship. The company will not support the STEM OPT I\-983 Training Plan endorsement for this position.* *As a condition of your employment for HIMCO, you will be required to affirm to HIMCO’s Code of Ethics and understand that you will be required to comply with the disclosure of accounts, holdings and pre\-clearance of trades for the accounts of you and your household family members as more fully described in the Code of Ethics Key Points. If you will be deemed to be a “Covered Associate” under HIMCO’s Pay to Play Policy, you will also need to disclose all political contributions that you have given within the past 2 calendar years.* **Compensation** The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short\-term or annual bonuses, long\-term incentives, and on\-the\-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $88,000 \- $132,000 Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age

jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.description: **Tech Lead** The Luxury Pergola · Noblesville, Indiana (in office, full\-time on site; no remote or hybrid; no visa sponsorship) · Full\-time **About The Luxury Pergola** We design and manufacture custom\-engineered aluminum louvered pergolas in Noblesville, Indiana, and sell them nationwide, direct to homeowners and through dealers. Our software is the business: a quoting engine that engineers every structure to the wind and snow loads at the customer's address and produces permit\-ready drawings in minutes, a configurator with true\-scale AR, an online kit store, dealer and installer portals, and the tools our sales team runs on. We built all of it ourselves, and we build fast with AI\-assisted development. **The role** You are the final technical check on everything we ship. You own the platform end to end: website, quoting engine, dealer and installer portals, sales tools, internal tools. You manage our full\-stack developer. In 2027 you ship the dealer engine and the website rebuild while making sure no system depends on one person, including you. Most of your week is code. **What you'll build in 2027** * Per\-channel testing infrastructure so every site change ships as a measured experiment * Address\-based engineering constraints in the configurator * Trade login with full engineering and permit package; storefront changes for the retail buyer * Dealer engine: lead routing, installer certification and audit records, scorecards, pricing compliance * Project gallery and brand site with our creative team * Documentation and cross\-training that gets every critical system to two people who can ship on it **What you'll own** * Architecture, code review, and release for all products and internal tools * Reliability of the quoting engine, which the company's revenue runs through * Integrations: Shopify, NetSuite, Zoho CRM, Klaviyo, Stripe, and building\-code hazard data * Security, access, backups, and customer data handling * Build\-versus\-buy decisions and oversight of contractors * Management and growth of the full\-stack developer; hiring when the queue justifies it **Who you are** * 6\+ years shipping full\-stack web software, at least 2 as the person other people's code went through before release * You have run a revenue\-critical system: on call, the incident, the fix, the postmortem * You use AI coding tools every day and hold their output to the same standard as your own: reviewed, tested, documented * You have integrated with an ERP, a CRM, and an e\-commerce platform, and you know where each one lies to you * You write documentation people use; you would rather leave a runbook than be indispensable * Pragmatic about stack, biased to shipping, comfortable being the last check Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Health insurance * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Link to something you built and shipped, and a short note. * We are adding address\-based building\-code constraints to a product configurator. Outline how you would source the data, structure it, and roll it out without hurting current conversion. Ability to Commute: * Noblesville, IN 46060 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: Overview: **\*This role is located in our Orlando, FL office, and requires four days per week on‑site.\*** The RMR Group is seeking a Senior Software Developer to design, develop, and maintain modern, scalable applications. This role is designed for a developer who pairs "end\-to\-end" hands\-on experience with a passion for **AI\-augmented engineering**. Solid experience with multi\-layered web application development is required. The ideal candidate doesn't just write code; they leverage AI development tools to accelerate the SDLC—from architectural prototyping to automated testing—while collaborating closely with IT and business stakeholders to deliver high\-impact solutions for the real estate industry. Responsibilities: * **Architect \& Develop:** Design, build, and maintain full\-stack applications using Clean Architecture and modern engineering practices (TDD, SOLID). * **AI\-Augmented Engineering:** Proactively use AI\-assisted tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor) to accelerate coding, refactor legacy logic, and automate documentation. * **Cloud\-Native Design:** Participate in architectural design sessions to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, and optimized for the Azure ecosystem. * **Agile Collaboration:** Work within Agile teams to translate business requirements into high\-performance features, participating in code reviews and sprint planning. * **Innovation:** Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies, identifying opportunities for automation and the integration of Generative AI within business workflows. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field. * 5\+ years of hands‑on full‑stack development experience. * Backend Expertise: C\#, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, microservices, Python, and modern frameworks. * Frontend Expertise: Strong experience with modern frameworks (specifically React or Blazor), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS. * Strong experience with SQL Server and Azure cloud services. * Proficiency with Git, CI/CD, and DevOps tooling. * Advanced comfort using AI coding assistants to drive efficiency \- experience in "prompt engineering" for code generation and debugging is highly valued. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts to non\-technical business users. * Real estate industry experience a plus. Total Rewards: The RMR Group offers an extensive total rewards package to ensure that your benefits align with your needs. Employees who work at least 21 hours per week are eligible to participate in The RMR Group’s benefits plans, including: * Health Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * Life \& Disability Insurance * Health Savings Account (HSA) \& Flexible Spending Plans (FSA) * 401(k) Plan with Employer Match * Holidays, Vacation \& Sick Time * Parental Leave * Tuition Assistance * Matching Gift Program * Wide Array of Voluntary, Employee\-Paid Benefits to choose from including Critical Illness \& Accident Insurance, Identity Theft Protection \& Pet Insurance **The estimated base compensation range for this position is $138,000 to $158,000 per year. RMR considers several components including an individual's skills, qualifications, experience, internal equity, and market data.** Company Overview: The RMR Group (Nasdaq: RMR) is a leading U.S. alternative asset management company, unique for its focus on commercial real estate (CRE) and related businesses. RMR’s vertical integration is strengthened by nearly 900 real estate professionals in more than 30 offices nationwide who manage approximately $40 billion in assets under management and leverage more than 35 years of institutional experience in buying, selling, financing and operating CRE. RMR benefits from a scalable platform, a deep and experienced management team and a diversity of real estate strategies across its clients. RMR has been recognized by The Boston Globe as a “Top Place to Work”, by the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) as an “ENERGY STAR Partner of the Year” and ranked by the Building Owners and Managers Association (BOMA) as having one of the highest number of BOMA 360 designated properties in its portfolio. RMR is headquartered in Newton, MA and was founded in 1986\. RMR’s mission is to create long term value for our clients by managing their investments and assets “like we own it” – an approach that consistently and repeatedly generates opportunities for all our employees, investors and stakeholders. We are guided by six core values:* Integrity at Our Core. * Perform Passionately and Effectively. * Inspired Thinking. * Like We Own It. * Power of We. * Mutual Respect. Visit our website to learn more about what makes The RMR Group a rewarding place to build a career. Follow RMR on LinkedIn and Instagram @thermrgroup. The RMR Group is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applications will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. For our EEO Policy Statement, please click here. If you’d like more information on your EEO rights under the law, please click here.

jobs.description: **Work Schedule** First Shift (Days)**Environmental Conditions** Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards, Cleanroom: no hair products, jewelry, makeup, nail polish, perfume, exposed piercings, facial hair etc... allowed, Laboratory Setting, Office, Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.), Will work with hazardous/toxic materials**Job Description** As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific Beam Technologies Thermal Field Emitter Engineering team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. DESCRIPTION: Join our manufacturing engineering team and make a meaningful impact on advanced technology and processes. As an Engineer II in Manufacturing Engineering, you'll support continuous improvement, ensure quality standards, and optimize production processes while collaborating with cross\-functional teams. Lead technical projects and provide manufacturing support to help deliver innovative solutions that enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. You will participate in new product introductions, process improvements, and equipment optimization initiatives. Using data\-driven approaches and lean methodologies, you'll identify opportunities to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and maintain the highest quality standards. Work closely with operations, quality, maintenance, R\&D, and other teams to implement sustainable solutions that drive manufacturing excellence. REQUIREMENTS: * Advanced Degree with no prior experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of manufacturing engineering experience in regulated industries * Preferred Fields of Study: Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Industrial, or related field) * Relevant technical certifications or apprenticeships are valued * Strong knowledge of GMP, ISO standards, and regulatory requirements * Experience with lean manufacturing principles and continuous improvement methodologies * Proficient in statistical analysis, root cause investigation, and problem\-solving techniques * Strong project management abilities and experience leading cross\-functional initiatives * Experience with engineering documentation, specifications, and change control processes * Expertise with CAD software, manufacturing systems, and data analysis tools * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Ability to work in cleanroom environments and comply with required PPE/gowning procedures * Available to work flexible hours and provide on\-call support as needed * Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite and manufacturing software systems * Experience with automation, controls, and process validation preferred * Knowledge of equipment qualification and calibration processes * Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities * Ability to mentor and train manufacturing personnel * Must be able to occasionally lift up to 50 lbs with assistance

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - GenAI / Agentic AI
jobs.description: Tiger Analytics is looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineer** with Gen AI experience to join our fast\-growing advanced analytics consulting firm. Our employees bring deep expertise in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for multiple Fortune 500 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. We are looking for top\-notch talent as we continue to build the best global analytics consulting team in the world. **Role Overview:** We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of client problem\-solving and hands\-on AI engineering. You'll partner directly with clients and engineering teams to turn complex business challenges into production\-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions — owning the journey from first conversation to live deployment. **Requirements** * Partner directly with clients to understand complex business problems and translate them into GenAI and Agentic AI solutions. * Design, build, deploy, and scale LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and multi\-agent workflows. * Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data, APIs, databases, and business applications. * Deploy, operate, and scale solutions in production cloud environments. * Troubleshoot and optimize production systems for performance, scalability, reliability, security, and cost. * Collaborate closely with architects, ML engineers, developers, and client stakeholders in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments. **Qualifications:** **Engineering Foundation** * 7\+ years in software engineering, application development, ML engineering, or AI engineering. * Strong Python programming skills. * Solid grasp of APIs, system design, databases, cloud\-native applications, and production deployments. * JavaScript/TypeScript experience is a plus. **GenAI / Agentic AI Expertise** * Proven experience building and deploying end\-to\-end GenAI and/or Agentic AI solutions. * Hands\-on experience with LLMs — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and open\-source models. * Hands\-on experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, tool/function calling, and AI agents. * Experience with agent orchestration, multi\-agent systems, or agentic workflows. * Familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or similar. * Working knowledge of MCP, A2A, or similar agent integration protocols. **Cloud \& Production** * Hands\-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or GCP — including targeted expertise in: * **AWS Stack:** Designing workflows via Amazon Bedrock (Claude, Llama), deploying scalable RAG using OpenSearch Serverless (Vector Engine), and configuring Bedrock Guardrails for client VPCs. * **Azure Stack:** Deploying enterprise LLMs via Azure OpenAI Service (PTU optimization), building hybrid RAG systems with Azure AI Search, and orchestrating flows using Azure AI Foundry and Semantic Kernel. * **GCP Stack:** Scaling applications within Vertex AI, managing production pipelines, structuring enterprise RAG with Vertex AI Vector Search \+ BigQuery, and building agentic flows with Gemini APIs. * Exposure to LLM evaluation, observability, monitoring, guardrails, or LLMOps. **The FDE Mindset** * Strong customer\-facing communication and sharp problem\-solving instincts. * Comfortable operating independently, navigating ambiguity, and moving fast from problem solution production. * Equally at home with business and technical stakeholders. **Benefits** This position offers an excellent opportunity for significant career development in a fast\-growing and challenging entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of individual responsibility. ***Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.***

Our employees bring deep expertise in Machine Learning, Data Science, and AI. We are the trusted analytics partner for multiple Fortune 500 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner. We are looking for top\-notch talent as we continue to build the best global analytics consulting team in the world. **Role Overview:** We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives at the intersection of client problem\-solving and hands\-on AI engineering. You'll partner directly with clients and engineering teams to turn complex business challenges into production\-grade GenAI and Agentic AI solutions — owning the journey from first conversation to live deployment. **Requirements** * Partner directly with clients to understand complex business problems and translate them into GenAI and Agentic AI solutions. * Design, build, deploy, and scale LLM applications, RAG systems, AI agents, and multi\-agent workflows. * Integrate AI solutions with enterprise data, APIs, databases, and business applications. * Deploy, operate, and scale solutions in production cloud environments. * Troubleshoot and optimize production systems for performance, scalability, reliability, security, and cost. * Collaborate closely with architects, ML engineers, developers, and client stakeholders in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments. **Qualifications:** **Engineering Foundation** * 7\+ years in software engineering, application development, ML engineering, or AI engineering. * Strong Python programming skills. * Solid grasp of APIs, system design, databases, cloud\-native applications, and production deployments. * JavaScript/TypeScript experience is a plus. **GenAI / Agentic AI Expertise** * Proven experience building and deploying end\-to\-end GenAI and/or Agentic AI solutions. * Hands\-on experience with LLMs — OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and open\-source models. * Hands\-on experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, tool/function calling, and AI agents. * Experience with agent orchestration, multi\-agent systems, or agentic workflows. * Familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Google ADK, or similar. * Working knowledge of MCP, A2A, or similar agent integration protocols. **Cloud \& Production** * Hands\-on experience with at least one major hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or GCP — including targeted expertise in: * **AWS Stack:** Designing workflows via Amazon Bedrock (Claude, Llama), deploying scalable RAG using OpenSearch Serverless (Vector Engine), and configuring Bedrock Guardrails for client VPCs. * **Azure Stack:** Deploying enterprise LLMs via Azure OpenAI Service (PTU optimization), building hybrid RAG systems with Azure AI Search, and orchestrating flows using Azure AI Foundry and Semantic Kernel. * **GCP Stack:** Scaling applications within Vertex AI, managing production pipelines, structuring enterprise RAG with Vertex AI Vector Search \+ BigQuery, and building agentic flows with Gemini APIs. * Exposure to LLM evaluation, observability, monitoring, guardrails, or LLMOps. **The FDE Mindset** * Strong customer\-facing communication and sharp problem\-solving instincts. * Comfortable operating independently, navigating ambiguity, and moving fast from problem solution production. * Equally at home with business and technical stakeholders. **Benefits** This position offers an excellent opportunity for significant career development in a fast\-growing and challenging entrepreneurial environment with a high degree of individual responsibility. ***Tiger Analytics provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, marital status, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.***

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Java/Polygot
jobs.description: **Location:** Remote. Candidates must currently reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, or Virginia. **Employment type:** Full\-time **Work authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship **About Tivly** Tivly is one of the largest marketplaces for commercial insurance in the United States, connecting business owners looking to protect their businesses with insurance carriers that fit their needs. Since 2009, Tivly has established a network of over 200 trusted carriers, agents, and brokers serving a wide range of businesses. **About the Role** The Principal Engineer is a highly hands\-on technical leadership role at Tivly, responsible for designing, building, and scaling the core software systems that power our technology platform. Reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer, this role helps define Tivly's technical direction and drives system architecture decisions. You'll apply modern engineering practices, from microservices architecture and API development to multi\-language (polyglot) solutions, to improve performance, reliability, and scalability across our products. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a commitment to mentoring engineers. The goal is high\-quality, maintainable software that supports business growth and innovation. **What You'll Do** *Architecture \& Technical Direction* * Own the architecture and design of distributed systems serving millions of insurance leads and transactions. * Evaluate new technologies and frameworks to enhance performance and maintainability. * Contribute to strategic technology roadmap planning and cross\-team alignment. *Hands\-On Engineering* * Lead by example through hands\-on coding, technical reviews, and system optimization. * Support cross\-functional development in multiple languages (e.g., Java, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript, Go). * Ensure security, reliability, and compliance within all engineering deliverables. *Collaboration \& Mentorship* * Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and Data teams on scalable API integrations and microservices. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, fostering a high\-performing and collaborative environment. *Additional Responsibilities \& Metrics* * Perform other related duties, ad hoc tasks, and special projects as assigned to support departmental and organizational goals. * Consistently meet and maintain the established metrics and performance standards. Your direct supervisor and the organization set these standards and update them periodically to match changing business needs. **What You Bring** * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant time in backend or platform roles. * Advanced proficiency in Java, plus hands\-on experience with at least one additional language such as Kotlin, Python, Go, or TypeScript. * Proven track record designing, building, and scaling distributed systems and microservice\-based architectures in a high\-traffic environment. * Strong experience with RESTful APIs, event\-driven architectures, and integrating with internal and external services. * Deep understanding of system performance, reliability, and observability (profiling, logging, metrics, alerting). * Practical experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker), and orchestration (Kubernetes). * Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and code quality practices. * Experience working closely with Product, DevOps, and Data teams to ship features and platform capabilities. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered. **Core Competencies** * **Technical Leadership:** Guides architecture decisions, sets engineering standards, and influences cross\-team technical direction. * **Systems Design \& Architecture:** Designs scalable, resilient distributed systems and microservice\-based platforms. * **Polyglot Programming:** Expert in Java, with the ability to work effectively in multiple languages (e.g., Kotlin, Python, Go, TypeScript). * **Cloud\-Native Engineering:** Builds and operates services on modern cloud platforms using containers, orchestration, and CI/CD. * **Performance \& Reliability:** Optimizes systems for latency, throughput, availability, and observability. * **API \& Integration Design:** Crafts clear, secure, and maintainable APIs and integrations with internal and external systems. * **Security \& Compliance Mindset:** Incorporates security, privacy, and compliance requirements into architecture and implementation. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partners effectively with Product, DevOps, and Data teams to deliver business outcomes. * **Strategic Thinking:** Aligns technical decisions and roadmaps with broader company and product strategy. **Benefits** We support our team with comprehensive benefits that promote health, balance, and financial well‑being, including: * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Sick Time * Flexible Scheduling (Flex Time) * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) for health and dependent care * Company‑paid Short‑ and Long‑Term Disability * No‑cost mental, emotional, and physical well‑being support through the First Stop Health app * 401(k) with 4% company match * Pay for designated holidays without having to work **Inclusion: It's Simple, We All Belong** Tivly celebrates diversity and equality! We are committed to building a team with a diverse variety of experiences, talents, and perspectives. We believe that creating a culture where everyone can fit in and belong has a positive influence on our communities and our customers. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. Creating a culture of equality isn't just the right thing to do; it's what Tivly chooses to do. Applicant information collected during the hiring process will be used solely to assess qualifications, verify eligibility for employment, and make hiring decisions. Applicant data will be stored securely and retained only for as long as necessary to complete the recruitment process and meet legal, regulatory, and record‑keeping requirements, after which it will be deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data retention policies.
