jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer (React / Next.js + WordPress)
jobs.description: **About Clickode Media** Clickcode Media is also a B2B web development and digital agency serving mid\-to\-large enterprise clients. We build and maintain websites across WordPress, headless CMS, React/Next.js, and modern page builders. Our team is lean, remote\-first, and quality\-driven. You will work on live client projects from day one — not internal demos or test environments. **Role Summary** We are looking for a Full Stack Web Developer who is genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack — WordPress and PHP on the backend, and React/Next.js with clean HTML/CSS/JS on the frontend. You are not a specialist in one area. You are an agency developer who moves fluidly across stacks, picks up existing codebases quickly, and delivers without constant supervision. This is an agency role. You will work across multiple client accounts simultaneously, each with its own stack, design system, and pace. The ability to context\-switch, read existing code fast, and deliver clean work under real\-world constraints matters more here than depth in any single framework. **What You Will Do** **WordPress \& PHP Backend/ Python** * Build and maintain WordPress websites — custom themes, child themes, and ACF\-driven templates * Write custom PHP for theme functions, hooks, filters, and plugin extensions * Develop and configure plugins, contact forms, CRM integrations, and REST API connections * Work with page builders — Elementor, Bricks, Breakdance — including custom CSS and dynamic data * Basic Python scripting for automation, data processing, or server\-side utilities **React \& Next.js Frontend** * Build React components and Next.js pages for headless or hybrid CMS setups * Consume REST and GraphQL APIs and render data cleanly on the frontend * Manage routing, state, and data fetching in Next.js (SSR, SSG, and ISR as appropriate) * Convert Figma designs into responsive, production\-ready React components **HTML / CSS / JavaScript** * Write semantic, accessible HTML and clean, maintainable CSS from scratch when needed * Build responsive layouts across breakpoints without relying on builders * Write vanilla JavaScript for custom interactions, DOM manipulation, and API calls * Optimise frontend performance — Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, asset compression **Hosting, Domains \& Infrastructure** * Set up and manage hosting environments — cPanel, Kinsta, Digital Ocean, OVH * Configure domains, DNS records, SSL certificates, and email authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC) * Set up staging environments, deployment workflows, and backup verification * Apply security best practices — HTTP headers, file permissions, malware scanning **Figma to Web** * Convert Figma designs into accurate, pixel\-aligned web pages independently * Identify design inconsistencies or implementation gaps and flag them proactively **AI \& Productivity** * Use AI tools — Claude, GitHub Copilot, or similar — actively in your daily workflow * Apply AI\-assisted development for code generation, debugging, and documentation tasks * Stay current with tools and techniques relevant to agency web development * Manage WordPress databases, migrations, and staging\-to\-production deployments * Implement security hardening, performance optimisation, and backup systems **You Are a Great Fit If** * You have 2–3 years of full stack web development experience, ideally in a digital agency * WordPress is second nature to you — themes, plugins, hooks, the database, and the ecosystem * You can write PHP confidently — custom functions, WP REST API, and plugin logic * You know React and Next.js well enough to build and maintain production\-grade components and pages * Your HTML and CSS are clean without a framework — you don't need a page builder to lay out a page * You understand JavaScript beyond jQuery — ES6\+, async/await, fetch, and DOM APIs * You have worked with at least one page builder deeply — Elementor, Bricks, or Breakdance * You can consume a REST or GraphQL API on the frontend without help * You understand hosting, DNS, SSL, and deployment well enough to set up and troubleshoot independently * You use AI tools in your workflow already or are actively willing to learn * You work well remotely, manage your own time, and communicate clearly on status and blockers **Nice to Have** * Experience with Webflow or Framer as additional no\-code/low\-code build tools * Familiarity with headless CMS platforms — Craft CMS, Contentful, Sanity, or similar * Exposure to GraphQL schema design or API\-first CMS setups * Experience with n8n, Zapier, or workflow automation tools * Basic understanding of technical SEO — schema markup, meta, sitemaps, redirects * Exposure to Docker, VPS management, or server\-side Linux configuration * Git\-based deployment workflows and version control best practices **Our Stack** **Backend / CMS** WordPress, PHP, Craft CMS, Fast API **Frontend** React, Next.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Vue, Nuxt.Js **Page Builders** Elementor, Bricks, Breakdance, Webflow, Framer **Hosting** Kinsta, Digital Ocean, OVH, cPanel **Design Handoff** Figma **DevOps** Git, SSH, Docker (basic), Traefik **AI Tools** Claude, Cursor, and others **What We Offer** * Fully remote role — work from anywhere in India * Real enterprise client work from day one across a variety of stacks and industries * A small, no\-politics team where your output is visible and valued * Genuine exposure to both WordPress/PHP and modern JS ecosystems — you will grow on both sides * Active use of AI tools — we build with AI, not around it * Room to grow into a senior or lead developer role as the agency scales **Remote \- Full\-Time \- 2–3 Yrs \- WordPress \+ PHP \- React / Next.js \- B2B Agency** Pay: Up to $6,000\.00 per month Benefits: * Flexible schedule Application Question(s): * How many years of experience do you have in web development? * What is your experience with WordPress — themes, PHP, plugins, and page builders? Describe in detail. * What is your experience with Full Stack development: PHP/ React / Next.js/ Python/ Node.js/ Vue.JS \& Databases ? Which ones and at what depth? Have you used these in a live project? * Have you used Elementor, Bricks, Webflow, Breakdance, or any other page builder? Which ones and at what depth? * Can you write code independently — PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript? Rate your confidence in each out of 10\. * Have you converted a Figma design into a working webpage? Describe your process. * Do you have experience with hosting, DNS, SSL, or server configuration? Give an example. * Please share links to past work — live websites, GitHub, or portfolio. * Tell us about one project you are most proud of — what you built, your role, and the stack used. * Which AI tools have you used in your development workflow? (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, etc.) How do you use them? * Are you comfortable working fully remotely and managing your own deadlines? Can you work from your own PC or do you need one provided? What is your current availability — full\-time, part\-time, or freelance? * What is your expected monthly salary? * In your own words, what makes you a strong fit for this role? What do you look forward to in this role? Anything else you'd like us to know? * If you are leaving your current job, may we know why? Experience: * Development: 1 year (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Consultant - Software Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges, building scalable systems, and leading by example? At Torq, we help clients build intelligent, efficient, and modern software systems. While we occasionally use AI tools where they make sense, we're focused on delivering real business value through engineering excellence — clear architecture, maintainable code, and pragmatic problem\-solving. We're looking for Software Engineers who love to build, are excited to architect solutions, mentor teammates, and own delivery from start to finish. If you're a builder at heart, comfortable with ambiguity, and love working on meaningful projects that make an impact — you'll fit right in. **What You Could Be Doing** While every project we work on is different, below is a high\-level overview of some of the responsibilities/hats you may wear: * Design and build scalable, production\-grade software systems — backend APIs, platforms, integrations, services * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions * Rapidly prototype ideas, validate concepts, and iterate quickly * Use modern development tools (including AI assistants like Copilot or Claude) to improve productivity — when it makes sense * Own technical architecture decisions and help shape engineering direction * Write clean, well\-tested code, and lead by example in code reviews and design * Mentor teammates and contribute to a strong engineering culture * Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **What You Bring to the Table** When you join our team, you're a consultant first. This means there are core skills we expect out of each of our team members. These include: * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Proven ability to lead the design and implementation of complex systems * Hands\-on experience with AI dev tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) * You're still hands\-on — comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging code regularly * Solid knowledge of backend technologies (Python, Java, Node.js, .NET, etc.) * Familiarity with frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, etc.) * Rapid prototyping tools (Replit, v0\.dev, Bolt, etc.) * Experience working in agile, cross\-functional environments * Comfort navigating ambiguity and working on fast\-moving projects * Strong communication and collaboration skills * Consulting mindset — solutions\-focused, adaptable, and client\-oriented **Bonus Points for Experience With:** We welcome engineers from diverse technical backgrounds — we care more about your ability to think, build, and lead, than ticking every box on a tool list. * Prior consulting, pre\-sales engineering, or client\-facing experience * Designing and scaling distributed systems, real\-time or event\-driven architectures * Working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes) * Building and consuming RESTful APIs, GraphQL, or other service architectures * Infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform, Pulumi) or DevOps tooling * Building CI/CD pipelines and automating development workflows * Test automation frameworks (e.g. Cypress, Playwright, Selenium) * Open\-source contributions or participation in engineering communities **Benefits and Other Fun Stuff** We ask our consultants to be superstars, so we treat them like it. Even better, our perks are designed for employees by our employees. We do this because we believe in delivering a compelling benefits package that puts you at the heart of our rewards. * Competitive Salary – your bank account will be smiling * Unlimited PTO – we're serious about that work\-life balance thing * Best\-in\-class health/vision/dental benefits – your health is our priority * Generous 401K options – take care of your future with us * Paid Parental Leave \- supporting you during life's biggest milestones * Opportunity to be a key player at a highly reputable, fast\-growing consulting firm * High degree of internal mobility and diverse project opportunities *The salary range for this position considers multiple factors influencing compensation decisions, such as skillset, previous experience, certifications, and various business \& organizational requirements. Being hired at or near the top of the range for this role is uncommon, as compensation determinations rely on individual circumstances. Currently, the base salary range is estimated to be between $110,000 and $135,000\.* *Torq is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.* * *Note: No visa sponsorship is available for this position, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer.*

jobs.title: Senior Consultant - Software Engineer
jobs.description: Are you an experienced software engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges, building scalable systems, and leading by example? At Torq, we help clients build intelligent, efficient, and modern software systems. While we occasionally use AI tools where they make sense, we're focused on delivering real business value through engineering excellence — clear architecture, maintainable code, and pragmatic problem\-solving. We're looking for Senior and Lead Software Engineers who are still hands\-on, love to build, and are excited to architect solutions, mentor teammates, and own delivery from start to finish. If you're a builder at heart, comfortable with ambiguity, and love working on meaningful projects that make an impact — you'll fit right in. **What You Could Be Doing** While every project we work on is different, below is a high\-level overview of some of the responsibilities/hats you may wear: * Design and build scalable, production\-grade software systems — backend APIs, platforms, integrations, services * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business needs into technical solutions * Rapidly prototype ideas, validate concepts, and iterate quickly * Use modern development tools (including AI assistants like Copilot or Claude) to improve productivity — when it makes sense * Own technical architecture decisions and help shape engineering direction * Write clean, well\-tested code, and lead by example in code reviews and design * Mentor teammates and contribute to a strong engineering culture * Communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders **What You Bring to the Table** When you join our team, you're a consultant first. This means there are core skills we expect out of each of our team members. These include: * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Proven ability to lead the design and implementation of complex systems * Hands\-on experience with AI dev tools (Copilot, Claude, Cursor, etc.) * You're still hands\-on — comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging code regularly * Solid knowledge of backend technologies (Python, Java, Node.js, .NET, etc.) * Familiarity with frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, etc.) * Rapid prototyping tools (Replit, v0\.dev, Bolt, etc.) * Experience working in agile, cross\-functional environments * Comfort navigating ambiguity and working on fast\-moving projects * Strong communication and collaboration skills * Consulting mindset — solutions\-focused, adaptable, and client\-oriented **Bonus Points for Experience With:** We welcome engineers from diverse technical backgrounds — we care more about your ability to think, build, and lead, than ticking every box on a tool list. * Prior consulting, pre\-sales engineering, or client\-facing experience * Designing and scaling distributed systems, real\-time or event\-driven architectures * Working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes) * Building and consuming RESTful APIs, GraphQL, or other service architectures * Infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform, Pulumi) or DevOps tooling * Building CI/CD pipelines and automating development workflows * Test automation frameworks (e.g. Cypress, Playwright, Selenium) * Open\-source contributions or participation in engineering communities **Benefits and Other Fun Stuff** We ask our consultants to be superstars, so we treat them like it. Even better, our perks are designed for employees by our employees. We do this because we believe in delivering a compelling benefits package that puts you at the heart of our rewards. * Competitive Salary – your bank account will be smiling * Unlimited PTO – we're serious about that work\-life balance thing * Best\-in\-class health/vision/dental benefits – your health is our priority * Generous 401K options – take care of your future with us * Paid Parental Leave \- supporting you during life's biggest milestones * Opportunity to be a key player at a highly reputable, fast\-growing consulting firm * High degree of internal mobility and diverse project opportunities *The salary range for this position considers multiple factors influencing compensation decisions, such as skillset, previous experience, certifications, and various business \& organizational requirements. Being hired at or near the top of the range for this role is uncommon, as compensation determinations rely on individual circumstances. Currently, the base salary range is estimated to be between $110,000 and $150,000\.* *Torq is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.* * *Note: No visa sponsorship is available for this position, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer.*

jobs.title: Principal Consultant - Software Engineer
jobs.description: Are you a deeply technical leader who thrives on solving high\-impact problems, scaling systems, and guiding engineering teams through hands\-on leadership? At Torq, we work with forward\-thinking organizations to design and deliver modern, scalable software solutions. We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help lead these efforts — someone who combines architectural depth, technical breadth, and the ability to mentor and influence other engineers. This is a role for engineers who’ve moved beyond being great individual contributors — and now amplify their impact through teams, design patterns, strategic guidance, and strong technical leadership. **What You Could Be Doing** In this role, you’ll work closely with engineering teams, technical leaders, and business stakeholders to: * Define and lead technical direction across complex systems, projects, or client engagements * Architect scalable, fault\-tolerant solutions that solve real business problems * Work hands\-on with modern cloud\-native technologies — AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and more * Design and deliver APIs and service architectures that enable fast, stable delivery and long\-term maintainability * Set and uphold high engineering standards — reliability, testability, performance, and security * Guide multiple teams through ambiguous technical challenges and trade\-offs * Collaborate with cross\-functional partners (product, design, business) to align engineering with business needs * Coach, mentor, and elevate other engineers — sharing knowledge and driving best practices * Act as a trusted advisor for clients — bringing credibility, clarity, and calm to high\-stakes situations * Identify emerging technologies and evaluate their application in real\-world systems * Occasionally prototype ideas or lead technical spikes to de\-risk and accelerate delivery **What You Bring to the Table** You're a proven technical leader with experience guiding teams and delivering complex software in production environments. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Demonstrated leadership of teams or multiple teams — setting direction, coaching others, and owning outcomes * Deep experience building and operating distributed systems, microservices, or high\-scale platforms * Expertise in modern cloud environments — AWS, Azure, or GCP — and cloud\-native design patterns * Strong working knowledge of containerization, orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD) * Proven experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and service\-layer architectures * Experience with backend languages like Python, Java, Node.js, or .NET — and the ability to pick up new stacks * Comfort working in agile environments with cross\-functional teams * Consulting mindset: you bring clarity to chaos, ask the right questions, and know how to deliver value * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you influence through clarity, not control **Bonus Points for Experience With:** We value engineers who combine technical strength with humility, curiosity, and the ability to lead through collaboration. (Not required, but highly valued — especially if you’ve worked in consulting or client\-facing roles.) * Designing real\-time, event\-driven, or data\-intensive systems * Infrastructure\-as\-Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Pulumi) * Strong understanding of software reliability engineering (SRE) practices — observability, alerting, incident response * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g. Copilot, Claude, Cursor) * Open\-source contributions or experience building internal frameworks / libraries * Prior consulting or pre\-sales engineering experience — especially with complex stakeholder environments * Experience influencing technical roadmaps, org\-wide standards, or platform strategy **Benefits and Other Fun Stuff** We’re a fast\-growing consulting firm with a reputation for technical excellence and a healthy, supportive culture. Our projects are diverse, our teams are collaborative, and our engineers are trusted to own the outcomes. * Competitive Salary – your bank account will be smiling * Unlimited PTO – we’re serious about that work\-life balance thing * Best\-in\-class health/vision/dental benefits – your health is our priority * Generous 401K options – take care of your future with us * Paid Parental Leave \- supporting you during life's biggest milestones * Opportunity to be a key player at a highly reputable, fast\-growing consulting firm * High degree of internal mobility and diverse project opportunities *The salary range for this position considers multiple factors influencing compensation decisions, such as skillset, previous experience, certifications, and various business \& organizational requirements. Being hired at or near the top of the range for this role is uncommon, as compensation determinations rely on individual circumstances. Currently, the base salary range is estimated to be between $140,000 and $170,000\+* *Torq is an Equal Opportunity Employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.* * *Note: No visa sponsorship is available for this position, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States for any employer.*

jobs.title: Powertrain Senior Design Engineer
jobs.description: Join our Team as a **Powertrain Senior Design Engineer!** **The Role:** We're seeking a passionate and dedicated **Powertrain Senior Design Engineer** to help shape the next generation of electric forklifts. In this role, you'll take the lead on developing powertrain systems and components, with a focus on performance, durability, and innovation. It requires a detail\-oriented individual with excellent communication skills and technical knowledge. The ideal candidate will be an energetic and adaptive person that contributes strong technical expertise to a fast\-paced engineering team. **What You'll Be Doing:** * Design, develop, and release new and enhanced forklift models, OEM components, and system options. * Develop, validate, and enhance powertrain components to meet product performance and durability requirements. * Create, manage and execute development schedule for powertrain\-related systems to meet project deadlines. * Collaborate cross\-functionally with teams to ensure safety, manufacturability, cost, quality and delivery of new products. * Analyze FEA reports and partner with CAE engineers to validate component strength. * Work with the testing group to define prototype test plans, pass/fail criteria, and evaluation procedures. * Work with electrical engineering team to specify system parameters and performance targets for control system design. * Manage part, assembly, and drawing revisions using CAD and PLM systems. * Ensure drawing quality by verifying design intent, quality control characteristics, dimensions, tolerances and clarity * Author technical specifications for powertrain component suppliers. * Maintain accurate engineering documentation, including Bills of Materials and Engineering Change Instructions. * Uphold a strong commitment to safety and alertness in all work activities. * Perform additional duties as assigned. **What We're Looking For:** * Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering; graduate degree preferred. * 5\+ years in New Product Development engineering, including 3\+ years focused on powertrain design for mobile equipment or 1 full product design cycle. * Proficiency with 3D CAD and PLM software; CATIA V5 preferred. * Proficient in electric vehicle powertrain systems design of gears, motors, bearings, castings, axles, seals, and brakes. * Familiarity with geartrain design and AC electrical power systems preferred. * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Ability to work effectively with cross\-cultural and cross\-functional teams. **What Sets You Apart:** * Hands\-on mindset \- you're not afraid to roll up your sleeves, whether it's for an oil change or a DIY project. * A passion for innovation \- share examples in your portfolio along with your resume. **Where and When You'll Work:** * This is an in\-person role located at our Columbus, IN office—ideal for those who thrive in a hands\-on, team\-oriented environment. **What Your Total Compensation \& Benefits Package will look like:** **Salary** \- $106,000 \- $155,000 **Relocation:** This role may be eligible for relocation assistance. **World Class Benefits:** * Competitive Salary * Performance Bonus * Generous Paid Time Off and 13 Paid Holidays * Affordable Medical plans and no\-cost Dental \& Vision options * 100% 401(k) match up to 6% * Company\-Paid Life Insurance, Short\-Term Disability, and Long\-Term Disability * Tuition Assistance Program * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with access to mental health care, legal support, and financial guidance * Recognition and Kaizen (continuous improvement) Reward Programs * Meaningful opportunities for personal and professional development * Onsite Fitness Center \& Occupational Health Clinic * Best in class work culture! **Big Name \| Big Opportunities \| Life is Better at Toyota** Toyota Material Handling North America (TMHNA), the industry leader in forklift sales, comprises two main brands: Toyota Material Handling and The Raymond Corporation. We believe investing in the best people, products, and processes will fuel our future success, and we will always be driven by our foundational principles of “respect for people” and “continuous improvement”. With opportunities across North America, we are confident you will find the right position within TMHNA that can help you build a long, fulfilling career. **Learn more here:** https://www.toyotaforklift.com/careers **Follow us on Social Media:** Working at Toyota Material Handling \| Glassdoor Additional Details : Toyota Material Handling North America will pursue visa sponsorship for this position, as needed, for eligible candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer
jobs.description: **About** **Tray.ai** Tray.ai is the enterprise orchestration platform for data and AI. We unify AI agent building (Merlin Agent Builder), MCP governance (Agent Gateway), integration across 700\+ apps, and automation on a single platform, so enterprises can stop wrangling AI and start orchestrating it. Our platform also includes Helix, the governed runtime for AI\-built apps. Business teams build real, working apps fast with AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex — Helix takes them from prototype to production with a single command, running on Tray's managed runtime with enterprise SSO, managed authentication (no hardcoded secrets), a live registry of every app and its owner, and per\-app cost and usage visibility. It's how teams build with AI at speed without IT losing control. Companies like Cisco, Airbnb, FedEx, CrowdStrike, and Capital One trust Tray.ai to power their most critical processes. We've been named a Gartner Visionary for iPaaS three years running, a Pioneer in the 2026 Gartner Emerging Market Magic Quadrant for No\-Code Agent Builders, and included in the Gartner 2026 Hype Cycle for Agentic AI. **The Role** As a Senior Sales Engineer at Tray.ai, you are the technical strategist and trusted advisor in every deal. You partner with Enterprise Account Executives to run the technical sale end\-to\-end, discovery, solution design, demos, POCs, and the technical close, across our orchestration and AI platform, on our largest and most complex opportunities. This is not an order\-taking role. We need someone who owns the technical thread, moves deals forward without being asked, and brings a strong point of view on how to win. As our platform evolves, that increasingly means helping technical buyers think through how they'd build and ship their own use cases and, when it moves the deal, building them. We're looking for a seasoned SE who has done this at enterprise scale and is still hungry to build. You've run long, multi\-stakeholder cycles, earned the trust of IT and architecture leaders, and won deals where the technical decision was the deciding one. But you haven't settled into one way of working: you're leaning hard into AI, you still build things yourself, and you want to help define how a new category gets sold. **What You'll Do** **Own the technical sale.** Lead discovery to deeply understand a prospect's challenges, technical environment, and success criteria before opening the product. Design and deliver tailored demos that lead with business outcomes. Architect solutions on Tray's platform that solve real problems. Build and execute POCs with clear success criteria and stakeholder alignment. Drive the technical close: anticipate objections, remove blockers, and write technical close plans. **Be a strategic deal partner.** Proactively identify what each deal needs to win and execute without being asked. Influence deal strategy alongside AEs rather than just answering technical questions. Multi\-thread across IT, security, architecture, and business stakeholders, and bring the technical owner and the business sponsor to a shared answer. Own follow\-through on every technical commitment within agreed timeframes, and keep AEs and stakeholders informed proactively. **Help buyers build what's next.** Help technical and business buyers reason through their own use cases and build working examples when it accelerates the deal. As our platform evolves toward letting teams generate applications with AI, you'll translate that shift into clear value for both engineers and executives. **Build and share expertise.** Stay current on AI agents, LLMs, MCP, and the rapidly evolving automation landscape. Contribute reusable assets and learnings that elevate the SE org. Represent Tray externally through workshops, webinars, events, and content. **Raise the bar for the team.** Act as a senior voice in the SE org: mentor newer SEs, share what's working in the field, and help shape our demo, POC, and technical close playbooks. Feed what you hear from customers back to Product to influence where the platform goes next. **What We're Looking For** We're hiring for four traits above all else: **Consultative.** You have a strong bedside manner, you earn trust quickly, make people feel heard, and guide rather than pitch. **Technical breadth.** You cover a lot of ground. You don't need to be a deep expert in any one domain, but you naturally demonstrate range across APIs, cloud, data, integration, and AI, and you can go a level deeper than the buyer on demand. **AI early adopter.** You're clearly leaning into AI. You use these tools yourself, you have opinions, and you can speak credibly about agents, LLMs, and where the technology is going. **Proactive.** You take ownership of delivery and go above and beyond to help people get there. You see what's needed and do it without being told. Supporting strengths: * Confident, adaptable presenter who can shift between technical builders, IT leaders, and the C\-suite, and who keeps composure when a demo or a question goes sideways. * Strong discovery instincts, you ask the right questions before reaching for a solution. * Genuine learning agility. We're moving toward new, fast\-changing ways of building software; your experience matters, but how fast you can pick something new up matters just as much. * Organized and reliable, you track commitments and never make someone chase you. **Experience** A typical fit has 6\+ years in a customer\-facing technical role, with at least 4 years in pre\-sales, solutions engineering, or solutions architecture selling into enterprise IT. You've owned the technical sale on complex, six\- and seven\-figure deals with long cycles, multiple stakeholders, and formal POCs, and you have a track record of winning them. Experience with SaaS, iPaaS, integration, automation, or AI platforms is a strong plus. You're senior, not set in your ways. We'll look for evidence that you still build things yourself, including with AI coding tools, that you run real discovery rather than the standard demo, and that the four traits above are obviously present. Strong backgrounds in forward\-deployed engineering, technical consulting, or founding a technical product are welcome too, if they include a clear record of selling into enterprise IT. **Salary** The on target total compensation for this role is $200,000\-$240,000 annually. Our salary range is based on paying competitively for our size, industry, and location of the role, and are one part of many other compensation, benefit and reward opportunities we provide, including stock options. Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company. The range above is a good faith estimate based on the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be less or more experienced than this job description as posted. For this reason, the actual salary may vary from the estimate provided above. **Location** Although Tray.ai is a remote\-first organization, this Senior Sales Engineer will be supporting our West coast clients and San Francisco\-based Enterprise Account Executives. Due to the nature of this work, we are prioritizing candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area. **Privacy Policy** To review Tray.ai's Privacy Policy, please visit https://tray.io/privacy

jobs.title: Security Engineer, GRC
jobs.description: **Treasure AI:** Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers. Powered by AI, Treasure AI is shaped by human creativity and always\-on through continuous, context\-driven action. Furthermore, Treasure AI employees are enthusiastic, data\-driven, and customer\-obsessed. We are a team of drivers—self\-starters who take initiative, anticipate needs, and proactively jump in to solve problems. Our actions reflect our values of honesty, reliability, openness, and humility. **Your Role:** Treasure AI is hiring a Security Engineer, GRC to architect, build, and automate the systems that power our Trust \& Assurance (T\&A) program. The right person for this role gets frustrated by manual compliance work — not because it's beneath them, but because they know it doesn't have to exist. This role sits at the intersection of security engineering and GRC. You will design, operate, and maintain the systems that make compliance continuous, visible in real\-time, and GRC insights actionable. You will treat the GRC platform as a programmable surface, extend it via APIs and agent workflows, and integrate it with the rest of Treasure AI's tech stack. You will work closely with GRC Specialists, taking program requirements and translating them into technical implementations — automations, integrations, dashboards, guardrails, and tooling. You will also work directly with Security, IT, Engineering, and Product teams to embed compliance into the systems and pipelines they already use. AI fluency is a baseline expectation. You will use agentic tools to accelerate your own work and will build AI\-powered automations into GRC workflows — from evidence ingestion to questionnaire response to executive reporting. **Responsibilities \& Duties:** * Build AI agent workflows (using Claude, MCP integrations, or similar) to automate repeatable GRC tasks. * Configure and maintain the technical configuration and extension of our GRC platform — architect data relationships, configure control workflows, build custom rules, and extend the platform via APIs and webhooks rather than relying on the default UI. * Build automated executive readout workflows so monthly and quarterly GRC reporting is a 30\-minute review, not a multi\-day build. * Design and operate automated evidence collection pipelines and continuous control monitoring — pulling signals directly from source systems in real time so drift is surfaced before audit time, not during it. * Translate controls into testable, codified checks. Identify gaps in compliance coverage across CI/CD pipelines and IaC (Terraform) and contribute compliance logic where gaps exist. * Embed lightweight compliance checkpoints into design review workflows, ensuring control\-relevant changes are flagged before deployment. * Support FAIR\-informed quantitative risk modeling with data pipelines and tooling that make risk scenarios computable rather than narrative\-only. * Build and maintain automation for the TPRM lifecycle — vendor intake, risk scoring, questionnaire distribution, evidence analysis, and remediation tracking — using AI\-assisted tooling to reduce per\-vendor manual effort. * Build tooling and dashboards that give the GRC Specialist and business stakeholders a continuous view of privileged access, access exceptions, and open remediation items — replacing point\-intime UAR reports with an always\-on IGA posture. * Build and maintain automation across the customer trust surface — AI\-assisted questionnaire response pipelines, RFP contribution workflows, and trust center content management — so customer assurance accelerates deals rather than bottlenecking them. * Build automation across the security awareness and training lifecycle — detecting end\-user risk signals or policy violations to improve the culture of security. **Required Qualifications:** * At least 3\+ years in Security Engineering, DevSecOps, Technical GRC, or a closely adjacent function — with a demonstrably strong engineering track record in automation and tooling, not just program ownership. * Strong coding foundation: proficient in Python and/or TypeScript, comfortable calling REST APIs, handling JSON/YAML payloads, building webhooks, and shipping integrations from scratch without hand\-holding or assistance. You treat Jira, Confluence, Slack, and similar enterprise tools as systems to integrate with, not just UIs to click through. * Hands\-on experience building automation and integrations in enterprise environments — not just configuring OOTB features, but writing code to extend or connect systems. * Practical hands\-on experience with a modern GRC platform (Vanta, anecdotes, Drata, Secureframe, or similar) — you've configured custom workflows, written rules, and used the APIs; not just the UI. * Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001/17/18, ISO 42001 and HIPAA — enough to read a control and determine how to test it programmatically. * Demonstrated experience shipping AI\-assisted automation: agent workflows, prompt pipelines, LLM\-integrated integrations, or similar. Comfort with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent). * Familiarity with the AWS security control surface (IAM, CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty) and how to consume compliance signals via API; working knowledge of CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions or similar) and IaC (Terraform or equivalent) — you understand where compliance checks can be embedded in a deployment pipeline. * Strong collaboration and written communication skills — able to work across multiple Security domains, IT, Engineering, Legal/Privacy, and GTM, and able to write clear technical documentation. **Travel Requirements:** Annual team on\-site in the US/CAN (total travel: \<10%) **Perks and Benefits (US):** Our benefit package showcases our culture of care and empathy with * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision plans and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Competitive compensation packages * Company paid life insurance 3x salary * Company paid short\- and long\-term disability coverage * Retirement planning (401K) with 4% company match * Restricted Stock Units (RSU) * Flexible Time Off (FTO) * Up to 26 weeks paid parental leave including a post\-partum night nurse * Comprehensive support and access to care for everyone, everywhere through Carrot \- our global reproductive health and family\-building benefit. **Our Dedication to You:** We value and promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our business and at all levels. Success comes from acknowledging, welcoming, and incorporating diverse perspectives. Diverse representation alone is not the desired outcome. We also strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages growth, ownership of your role, and achieving innovation in new and unique ways. Your voice will be heard, and we will help amplify it. **Agencies and Recruiters:** We cannot consider your candidate(s) without a contract in place. Any resumes received without having an active agreement will be considered gratis referrals to us. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation! This description captures the core of the role today. As we adopt AI and new ways of working, responsibilities may evolve, and we encourage team members to take initiative, lean into change, and help expand the impact of their role beyond what’s listed here.

jobs.title: Software Engineer II - Capacity & Efficiency Engineering
jobs.description: **About the Role and Team** As a Software Engineer II on CEE, you will build the systems that decide how much infrastructure Uber needs, where it runs, and what it costs. Our capacity planning platform turns business demand forecasts into resource plans, targets, and quotas across compute, storage, and data infrastructure, so engineering teams can ship without over\-provisioning and Finance can trust the numbers. The problems here are messy and the systems are global. Demand is uncertain, cost attribution spans many systems, and plans get revised every forecast cycle. You'll need to make smart decisions with imperfect information, own your work end\-to\-end, and stay calm when a planning deadline or a high\-load production pipeline is on the line. We are looking for engineers who think in systems, pride themselves on robust monitoring and data correctness, and believe the best solutions are built through candid feedback and cross\-functional collaboration. If you're energized by challenges and motivated to move the real world, this is where you'll grow. **What You'll Do*** Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality code for the capacity planning stack, including resource demand\-to\-supply forecasting models, plan\-of\-record pipelines, and the services that publish and manage capacity and spend plans. The scope ranges from features of moderate complexity to projects with multiple dependencies. * Build and scale the data pipelines that join business demand, resource consumption, and cost attribution, balancing technical debt and shifting planning cycles while keeping long\-term impact in mind. * Improve the accuracy and explainability of capacity forecasts and models, and validate changes by backtesting against historical data. * Own the software lifecycle end\-to\-end, from drafting design docs to debugging production issues and managing incidents independently, including keeping planning pipelines correct and on time around forecast deadlines. * Collaborate across disciplines, including Product, Data Science, Finance, and infrastructure platform owners, to translate ambiguous requirements into simple, elegant system designs. * Champion engineering best practices by providing quality code reviews, writing comprehensive tests and data\-quality checks, and improving system performance. * Navigate internal complexity and stakeholder inquiries to unblock dependencies and ensure the reliability of our production environment. **Basic Qualifications*** 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend development, distributed systems, or data engineering. * Proficiency in one or more object\-oriented or functional programming languages (e.g., Go, Java, Python, or C\+\+). * Experience with data modeling, query optimization, and translating customer problems into system design. * Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent experience) in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. * Experience writing tests to verify functionality and establishing monitoring systems to ensure code stability. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience with forecasting, optimization, or statistical modeling, and with turning a model into a reliable production system. * Familiarity with capacity planning, resource quotas or scheduling, or cost showback or chargeback systems. * Proficiency with Big Data frameworks (e.g., Spark, Flink) or real\-time data streaming (e.g., Kafka). * Experience identifying and reducing code\-level technical debt in high\-load distributed systems. * Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment on engineering trade\-offs for complex features and to make progress in high\-ambiguity environments. * Background in mentoring new team members and contributing to engineering culture. * Strong communication skills, with a track record of translating complex technical concepts for diverse stakeholders. For San Francisco, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For Sunnyvale, CA\-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $171,000 per year \- USD $190,000 per year. For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award \& other types of comp. All full\-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook \- it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves \- we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in\-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full\-time in\-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Location:** United States (remote or hybrid) · Reports to: VP of Engineering · Type: Full\-time About the role Universal Background Screening is modernizing its platform with Orion, a cloud\-based background\-screening platform. It runs alongside long\-standing legacy systems while clients migrate. We're looking for a hands\-on Senior Development Manager to be the first line of technical response in U.S. hours. You'll log in, investigate, debug and find the root cause of production issues quickly, then drive them to resolution with our global engineering teams. You'll also lead and grow U.S. engineering capability so that Orion can be supported end to end from the United States. This is a player\-coach role. You'll spend real time in logs, dashboards, code and data, and you'll build the processes and people that make production support predictable. What you'll do Production support and root\-cause analysis (primary focus) Act as the U.S.\-hours technical lead for Orion production issues. Triage, reproduce, and investigate through logs, metrics, traces, queries and code. Perform root\-cause analysis and deliver a clear diagnosis, workaround or fix path fast, even when the permanent fix is built by another team. Hand off well\-documented findings to global engineering teams, so fixes start from evidence, not from scratch. **Own incident communication:** keep tickets current (status, workaround, fix, target release) and keep stakeholders informed until closure. Lead post\-incident reviews and drive the follow\-up actions that prevent repeats. Engineering leadership Lead, mentor and grow U.S.\-based engineers, and build their ability to support Orion independently. That includes knowledge transfer, runbooks and training. Partner with engineering leaders and teams across time zones on priorities, handoffs and escalations. **Help define and run the support model:** triage ownership, escalation paths, on\-call rotation and U.S./global handoffs. Delivery and quality Work with Product, Program Management and Scrum to turn business needs into clear, prioritized, well\-scoped work. **Support predictable two\-week sprint delivery and releases:** release readiness, verification, and rollback when needed. **Champion engineering discipline:** code review, testing, ticket hygiene, documentation and secure coding. Identify recurring issues and technical debt, and make the case for fixing root causes. Platform knowledge Become an expert in Orion's architecture, integrations and data flows, including how Orion interacts with legacy systems during migration. Keep architecture, runbooks and troubleshooting guides current in Confluence. What you'll bring Required 8\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years leading engineers or teams, while staying hands\-on. Strong production debugging and root\-cause analysis in distributed, cloud\-hosted systems. C\# / .NET (.NET 6\+), including REST APIs and service\-to\-service integration. **SQL and relational databases (MySQL and/or SQL Server):** query analysis, performance tuning, data investigation. **Observability tools:** centralized logging (e.g. ELK/Elasticsearch), metrics and alerting (e.g. Grafana), and log\-driven diagnosis. **Containers and cloud:** Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS (e.g. RDS). **Integrations and security basics:** JSON/XML APIs, OAuth 2\.0/JWT, certificates, TLS. **Source control and delivery:** Git branching workflows (e.g. GitFlow), CI/CD pipelines, code quality gates (e.g. SonarQube). **Agile tooling:** Jira and Confluence. **Excellent written communication:** clear incident updates, RCAs and handoffs to distributed teams. Comfort working with teams across time zones, with some flexibility for early\-morning overlap and occasional evening release windows. Nice to have Experience modernizing or migrating from legacy platforms (e.g. classic ASP, VB, older monoliths) to modern services. Background screening, HR tech or other regulated data (FCRA, PII handling). Experience with ATS or HRIS integrations. MongoDB, load testing (e.g. JMeter) or test automation (e.g. Playwright). Practical use of AI\-assisted development and debugging tools, with sound review practices. Experience building on\-call programs, runbooks and incident\-management processes. What success looks like **First 30 days:** access to all environments and tools; you know the Orion architecture, key integrations and the support process; you shadow and then lead triage of live issues. **First 60?90 days:** you independently triage and root\-cause most U.S.\-hours production issues, with clear handoffs and current tickets; the first runbooks are in place; you're training other U.S. engineers. **Ongoing:** faster time to diagnosis, fewer repeat incidents, predictable releases, and a U.S. team that can support Orion end to end.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor, Nutrition Specialist (Las Vegas, NV)
jobs.description: The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment. If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775\) 784\-1495 or jobs@unr.edu . **Job Description** The Department of Nutrition within the College of Agriculture, Biotechnology and Natural Resources at the University of Nevada, Reno invites applications for a tenure\-track Assistant Professor, Nutrition Specialist position focused on improving nutritional health and well\-being of school\-age children and adolescents throughout Nevada. This is a full\-time, 12\-month appointment supported by both Extension and the Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, and reports to the Department of Nutrition Chair. **This position is located in Las Vegas, NV.** The Nutrition Specialist will serve communities across the state through innovative Extension programming, collaborative research, and engagement with diverse audiences dedicated to improving youth health outcomes. This position offers a unique opportunity to combine Extension teaching and program leadership, applied research, and community partnership to address critical public health challenges, including nutrition\-related health disparities, food insecurity, and the social determinants of health that influence children and families. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative scholar who is passionate about improving the nutritional health of children and adolescents through innovative research, evidence\-based Extension programming, and strong community partnerships. They will have the vision to build a nationally recognized program that addresses food insecurity, health disparities, and the social determinants of health while making a measurable impact on Nevada's youth and families. **Position Overview** The Nutrition Specialist will develop, deliver, and evaluate evidence\-based educational programs and interventions that support healthy nutrition behaviors among children and adolescents. The successful candidate will build a nationally recognized program of scholarship that advances understanding of factors affecting youth nutrition and contributes to meaningful improvements in community health. Research and scholarly activities may include: * Developing innovative nutrition interventions that produce measurable outcomes. * Investigating dietary risk behaviors and factors that influence nutrition and health. * Examining the impact of food insecurity and other social determinants of health on children and families. * Exploring the perspectives and roles of community stakeholders, including parents, guardians, teachers, healthcare providers, and community organizations. Translating research findings into practical, community\-based solutions that improve health outcomes. * **Key Responsibilities** Extension Education, Policy, Programming, and Outreach * Develop and implement evidence\-based nutrition education programs for school\-age youth, families, and community partners. * Collaborate with schools, community organizations, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders to address nutrition\-related health concerns. * Lead and support policy, systems, and environmental approaches to improve access to healthy foods and create sustainable conditions that support positive nutrition and health outcomes. * Evaluate program effectiveness and demonstrate measurable impacts on participants and communities. * Provide leadership in statewide nutrition programming and initiatives. * Supervise, mentor, and support programmatic staff, students, and/or volunteers involved in nutrition education and outreach efforts; foster a collaborative, high\-performing team environment that advances program goals and impacts. Travel throughout Nevada to support Extension programming and partnerships. * Research and Scholarship * Establish and sustain an impactful research agenda related to children's nutritional health and well\-being. * Secure extramural funding to support research and Extension activities. * Publish scholarly work in peer\-reviewed journals and disseminate findings through professional presentations and Extension publications. * Integrate research findings into Extension programming to enhance community impact. Provide mentorship and academic guidance to graduate and undergraduate students, including participation on graduate committees, supervision of student research projects, and support for experiential learning opportunities aligned with Extension and research objectives. * Service * Contribute to university, Extension, professional, and community service activities. Participate in interdisciplinary collaborations that support the university's land\-grant mission. * **Required Qualifications** * Ph.D. in Nutrition, Public Health, Community Heal future powered by knowledge. Founded in 1874 as Nevada’s original land\-grant university, the University serves more than 23,000 undergraduate and graduate students from all 50 states and 63 countries. Classified by the Carnegie® Classification of Institutions of Higher Education as an R1 (“Very High Research”) university, it is also recognized in the Carnegie® Community Engagement classification. The University is also ranked by U.S. News \& World Report among the “Best National Universities” and “Best National Public Universities.” It also ranks in the top tier of the WSJ/Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the New York Times’ “Top Colleges for Economic Diversity.” Since 2009, nearly $1 billion has been has invested in advanced labs, facilities, and residence halls on the main campus. The University is home to Nevada’s first medical school – the University of Nevada, Reno School of Medicine and the Wayne L. Prim Campus at Lake Tahoe, where education, research, and creative work thrive in a stunning mountain setting. The University delivers on its original land\-grant mission with outreach across the state through the University of Nevada, Reno Extension, Nevada Agricultural Experiment Station, Nevada Bureau of Mines and Geology, Nevada Small Business Development Center, the Nevada Seismological Laboratory, and Wolf Pack Athletics. The main campus is in Reno, Nevada, a burgeoning global technology hub with a vibrant midtown and downtown. Found where the high desert of the Great Basin meets the High Sierra and Lake Tahoe, the beautiful, 290\-acre main campus is also a Nevada State Arboretum. The University’s physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025\. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as “University Village,” to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty. Collaborating with world\-renowned organizations, the University fosters innovation through initiatives such as the Digital Wolf Pack partnership with Apple, which ensures equitable access to technology for students, providing new incoming freshman or transfer students with an iPad Air and accessories. Google’s TechWise initiate is an 18\-month program that fully supports undergraduate students in becoming entry\-level software engineers by graduation. Nevada was selected from a competitive pool of 489 applicants from across the United States and its territories. Nevada’s Tech Hub will strengthen America’s lithium batteries, critical elements and other electric vehicle materials industry sectors within the state. Through its commitment to high\-impact education, world\-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that’s transforming Nevada’s communities and businesses, the University continues its 150\-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world. The University recognizes that diversity promotes excellence in education and research. The inclusive and engaged community on campus recognizes the added value that students, faculty, and staff from different backgrounds bring to the educational experience. Today, the University delivers on its original land\-grant mission of access to education and knowledge by investing in the academics, facilities, support, engagement and vibrant campus life that promote our diverse students’ cognitive growth and academic achievement – all while remaining one of the best values in American higher education. For more information, please visit the University’s website . **University of Nevada, Reno** ------------------------------

With 11 undergraduate and 13 graduate programs, over 20 research centers and a faculty community that boasts one of the highest number of National Academy of Engineering members among U.S. universities, Texas Engineering has launched some of the nation’s most accomplished leaders and pioneered world\-changing solutions in virtually every industry, from space exploration to energy to health care. Major companies with Austin campuses, such as Dell, National Instruments, Apple, IBM, Samsung, Google and many others, continue to recruit Cockrell School students at a remarkable rate, launching thousands of successful careers and developing Texas Engineers into industry leaders. **Purpose** ----------- The Senior Human Resources Coordinator oversees HR functions for a designated department and provides guidance on recruitment, compensation, and performance management. Monitors timekeeping reports to ensure staff timesheets are completed in a timely manner. * Administrator over the unpaid affiliate program by reviewing assignments for accuracy and ensuring compliance with appropriate documentation and export controls policy and procedures. jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ As a comprehensive institution of the University System of Georgia, Valdosta State University (VSU) is a welcoming, aware, and vibrant community founded on and dedicated to serving our communities' rich and diverse heritages. Through excellence in teaching, basic and applied research, and service, VSU provides rigorous programs and opportunities that enrich our students, our university, and our region. As such, the VSU mission consists of three interrelated parts that includes a student mission, university mission and regional mission. The university is equally dedicated to the core values of community, including a commitment to practice civility, integrity and citizenship. As members of this community and proud Blazers we strive to uphold these core values for the advancement of the University, as stated in the Blazer Creed and reflected in our commitment to the University System of Georgia's Core Values. **Blazer Creed** Valdosta State University is a learning environment based on trust and mutual respect in which open dialogue, vigorous debate, and the free exchange of ideas are welcome. The University is equally dedicated to the core values of community, including a commitment to practice **civility, integrity,** and **citizenship.** As members of this community, and proud Blazers, we will strive to uphold these core values for the advancement of the University. **Civility** \- A Blazer shows courtesy and compassion as well as respect for the dignity of every human being. **Integrity** \- Each Blazer is responsible for his or her own actions, and our community is stronger when we contemplate the context of our decisions and uphold the principles of trust and honesty. **Citizenship** \- Every Blazer has an interest in the well\-being of the community, and, therefore, a duty to stay informed, to make positive contributions, and to offer support to those who need help. As a Blazer, we pledge to uphold the core principles of **Civility, Integrity,** and **Citizenship**. **Job Summary** --------------- Develop, implement and maintain model structures and applications created and/or supplied by other programmers. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Typical Allocation of Duties****:** **Programming Assistance \- 30%** Provide assistance with programming projects that support the development, implementation, and maintenance of model structures and applications that support the mission of the university. **Review and test \- 30%** Review program specifications to confirm logic and time estimates with senior programmers. Test programs to ensure compliance with specifications. **Professional Development \- 30%** Develop proficiency in programming and other tools used in the development of applications and model structures through professional development and training opportunities. **Project documentation \- 10%** Complete and maintain project documentation. **Supervisor Expectations****:** * Working knowledge of JavaScript and familiarity with fundamental programming concepts, including variables, data types, conditional logic, loops, arrays, objects, functions, and error handling. * Familiarity with conversational AI and generative AI concepts, including chatbots, prompts, intents, context, and integrating AI services with business applications. * Experience working with databases and SQL is preferred, particularly the ability to retrieve, manipulate, and understand structured business data. * Ability to work with APIs and data in structured formats, particularly JSON, and an understanding of how applications exchange information with other systems. * Demonstrated willingness and ability to learn new programming languages, development tools, AI technologies, and enterprise applications. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- **Required Experience** Associate's degree and one (1\) year of related work experience. **Proposed Salary** ------------------- $24\.16/hr ($50,255/annual) **USG Core Values** ------------------- The University System of Georgia is comprised of our 25 institutions of higher education and learning as well as the System Office. Our USG Statement of Core Values are Integrity, Excellence, Accountability, and Respect. Additionally, USG supports Freedom of Expression as stated in Board Policy 6\.5 Freedom of Expression and Academic Freedom found on\-line at https://www.usg.edu/policymanual/section6/C2653\. **Conditions of Employment** ---------------------------- Applicants are required to provide: * professional references with current contact information * documentation of academic credentials * employment history Please note that during the search process, VSU reserves the right to: * ask candidates who will serve in Positions of Trust to disclose criminal record history during the initial screening process and prior to a conditional offer of employment, * view social media outlets, and * remove job postings without additional notification. Employment is contingent upon: * successful completion of a background check investigation, including a criminal background check * reference checks Employment may also be contingent upon the job\-based requirements if applicable for your position: * satisfactory credit check * successful completion of a Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) * pre\-employment drug testing * confirmation of credentials After initial hiring, employees will be required to successfully complete all of the following training: * New employee orientation * VSU¿s Annual Compliance Training: + USG Ethics Policy + Conflict of Interest/Outside Activities Policy + Drug Free Workplace + Sexual Misconduct and Title IX + Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) + Motor Vehicle Policy + Workers Compensation (new hires) + Georgia Open Records Act (new hires) * USG Cybersecurity Training (required twice yearly) + Job\-specific training such as: FMLA and Worker¿s Compensation, Budget Manager training, Purchasing Training (ePro \& PCard), and Defensive Driving **Equal Employment Opportunity** -------------------------------- Valdosta State University is an equal opportunity educational institution. It is not the intent of the institution to discriminate against any applicant for admission or any student or employee of the institution based on the age, sex, race, religion, color, national origin, disability, or sexual orientation of the individual. **Background Check** -------------------- * Position of Trust \+ Credit **Accommodations** ------------------ If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings, apply for a job on this site, or participate in the search process as a result of your disability. Applicants who anticipate requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future are encouraged to contact Human Resources early in the recruitment process with questions regarding sponsorship eligibility. **Clery Disclosure** -------------------- The Jeanne Clery Campus Safety Act requires institutions of higher education to publish an Annual Security and Fire Safety Report (ASFSR).
